## Load Prepared data

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

load(paste0(processed_data_path, "BD_Tau_TBI_Processed.RData"))
load(paste0(processed_data_path, "BD_Tau_SCI_Processed.RData"))

###=============================
### TBI (serum)
###=============================

tbi_serum_demo <- read_excel("~/Desktop/Projects/2025_05_19_TBI_SCI_BDTau/Processed_Data/Combined BD-Tau TBI SCI Controls_Confirmed_Sep_30_2025.xlsx", sheet = 1) %>%
  mutate(Group = case_when(!is.na(Group) ~ Group,
                            GCS >= 3 & GCS <= 8 ~ "Severe",
                            GCS >= 12 & GCS <= 15 ~ "Mild",
                            GCS > 8 & GCS < 12 ~ "Moderate",
                            TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         GCS_Group = case_when(GCS %in% c(3, 4) ~ "GCS 3-4",
                               GCS >= 5 & GCS <= 8 ~ "GCS 5-8",
                               GCS >= 12 & GCS <= 15 ~ "Mild",
                               GCS > 8 & GCS < 12 ~ "Moderate",
                               TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value = 2*mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value,
         mean_serum_First_Digit_24Hr = trunc(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value),
         mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort = ifelse(is.na(Group), "TBI", paste0(Group, " TBI"))
  ) 

# calculate the rate per day
# use the first available measure per day as the anchor

DT <- as.data.table(tbi_serum_demo)
DT[, rowid := .I]
DT[, day_idx := floor(as.numeric(serum_Raw_Day_Value))]

anchors <- DT[order(Subject.ID, day_idx, serum_Raw_Day_Value),
              .(anchor_time  = first(serum_Raw_Day_Value),
                anchor_serum = first(serum_BDTau)),
              by = .(Subject.ID, day_idx)]

DT[, target_prev_day := day_idx - 1L]

setkey(anchors, Subject.ID, day_idx)
setkey(DT,      Subject.ID, target_prev_day)
DT_merged <- anchors[DT, roll = Inf]  # columns from both now merged

DT_merged[, delta_vs_prevday :=
            ifelse(!is.na(anchor_serum),
                   serum_BDTau - anchor_serum, NA_real_)]

DT_merged[, serum_rate_per_day :=
            ifelse(!is.na(anchor_serum) &
                     (serum_Raw_Day_Value > anchor_time),
                   (serum_BDTau - anchor_serum) /
                     (serum_Raw_Day_Value - anchor_time),
                   NA_real_)]

setorder(DT_merged, rowid)
setorder(DT, rowid)

DT[, `:=`(
  anchor_day_idx       = DT_merged$day_idx,
  anchor_time          = DT_merged$anchor_time,
  anchor_serum         = DT_merged$anchor_serum,
  delta_vs_prevday     = DT_merged$delta_vs_prevday,
  serum_rate_per_day   = DT_merged$serum_rate_per_day
)]

DT[, c("rowid", "target_prev_day") := NULL]

# calculate the rate by baseline

baseline <- DT[order(Subject.ID, serum_Raw_Day_Value),
               .(baseline_time  = first(serum_Raw_Day_Value),
                 baseline_serum = first(serum_BDTau)),
               by = Subject.ID]

DT <- baseline[DT, on = "Subject.ID"]

# Calculate delta and rate from baseline
DT[, delta_vs_baseline := serum_BDTau - baseline_serum]

DT[, serum_rate_vs_baseline := 
     ifelse(serum_Raw_Day_Value > baseline_time,
            (serum_BDTau - baseline_serum) / (serum_Raw_Day_Value - baseline_time),
            NA_real_)]

tbi_serum_demo <- tibble::as_tibble(DT)

###=============================
### Control
###=============================

cntr <- read_excel("~/Desktop/Projects/2025_05_19_TBI_SCI_BDTau/Processed_Data/Combined BD-Tau TBI SCI Controls_Confirmed_Sep_30_2025.xlsx", sheet = 3) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = "Control")

### Extract Demo

tbi_demo <- tbi_serum_demo %>% 
  dplyr::select(Subject.ID, Study, GCS, GCS_Group, Group, Cohort, matches("Age"), Sex, matches("GOS"), 
                                      matches("Death"), Note_from_Email) %>% distinct()

sci_serum_demo <- sci_serum_demo %>% 
  mutate(Study = case_when(grepl("CP", Subject.ID) ~ "CP",
                           grepl("ST", Subject.ID) ~ "ST",
                           TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         Age_40_Recode = case_when(Age <= 40 ~ "<=40",
                                   Age > 40 ~ ">40",
                                   TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         Age_65_Recode = case_when(Age <= 65 ~ "<=65",
                                   Age > 65 ~ ">65",
                                   TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         Group = "SCI",
         Cohort = "SCI",
         Location_Group = case_when(grepl("C", Location) ~ "Cervical",
                                    grepl("L", Location) ~ "Lumbar",
                                    grepl("T", Location) ~ "Thoractic",
                                    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) 

sci_demo <- sci_serum_demo %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject.ID, Study, Group, Cohort, matches("Age"), Coenrolled, Sex, Location, Location_Group,
         ASIA, In_Hospital_Dead, Death_06) %>% distinct()

### Generate BL

tbi_serum_demo_BL <- tbi_serum_demo %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID) %>%
  arrange(serum_Raw_Day_Value, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_serum_BDTau)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

sci_serum_demo_BL <- sci_serum_demo %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID) %>%
  arrange(serum_Raw_Day_Value, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_serum_BDTau)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Integrate Control/TBI/SCI together, focusing on *Serum* only

### Table 1

```{r [Serum] Integrated Cohorts Demographic Table 1, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# ls(pattern = "_BL$")
library(ExclusionTable)

# ============================================
# Exclude samples with missing in demographic or BD-tau measurements
# ============================================

# TBI

tbi_serum_demo_BL_ex_id <- 
  exclusion_table(tbi_serum_demo_BL,
                  exclusion_criteria = c("is.na(Sex)",
                                         "is.na(Age)",
                                         "is.na(GCS)",
                                         "is.na(Group)",
                                         "is.na(serum_BDTau)",
                                         "!is.na(Note_from_Email)"),
                  labels_exclusion   = c("Missing Sex",
                                         "Missing Age",
                                         "Missing GCS",
                                         "Missing GCS-based Grouping",
                                         "Missing serum BD-tau",
                                         "Email confirmed exclusion"),
                  id = "Subject.ID",
                  keep_data = TRUE)

tbi_serum_demo_BL_ex_id$table_ex
tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned <- as.data.frame(tbi_serum_demo_BL_ex_id$dataset)

# SCI

sci_serum_demo_BL_ex_id <- 
  exclusion_table(sci_serum_demo_BL,
                  exclusion_criteria = c("is.na(Sex)",
                                         "is.na(Age)",
                                         "is.na(serum_BDTau)"),
                  labels_exclusion   = c("Missing Sex",
                                         "Missing Age",
                                         "Missing serum BD-tau"),
                  id = "Subject.ID",
                  keep_data = TRUE)

sci_serum_demo_BL_ex_id$table_ex
sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned <- as.data.frame(sci_serum_demo_BL_ex_id$dataset)

# Control

cntr_ex_id <- 
  exclusion_table(cntr,
                  exclusion_criteria = c("is.na(Sex)",
                                         "is.na(Age)",
                                         "is.na(serum_BDTau)"),
                  labels_exclusion   = c("Missing Sex",
                                         "Missing Age",
                                         "Missing serum BD-tau"),
                  id = "Subject.ID",
                  keep_data = TRUE)

cntr_ex_id$table_ex
cntr_cleaned <- as.data.frame(cntr_ex_id$dataset)

# ============================================
# Combined CNTL/TBI/SCI of BD-Tau
# ============================================

ls(pattern = "_cleaned$")

### Baseline 

intersect_vars <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  names(cntr_cleaned),
  names(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned),
  names(tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned)
))

serum_baseline_cleaned <- rbindlist(
  list(
    cntr_cleaned %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)),
    sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)),
    tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars))
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Control","SCI","Mild TBI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI"))) %>%
  mutate(Cohort2 = factor(case_when(Cohort %in% c("Control","SCI") ~ Cohort, 
                                    TRUE ~ "TBI"), 
                          levels = c("Control","SCI","TBI")))

baseline_tbl_by_Cohort <- serum_baseline_cleaned %>% 
  dplyr::select(Age, Sex, mean_serum_BDTau, Cohort) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = Cohort,
    type = list(all_continuous() ~ "continuous2"),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ c("{mean} ({sd})", "{median} ({p25}, {p75})"),
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 2,
      all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)
    ),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "(Missing)",
    label = list(Age ~ "Age (years)",
                 Sex ~ "Sex",
                 mean_serum_BDTau ~ "BD-Tau (pg/mL)")
  ) %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  add_overall() %>%
  add_p() %>%
  bold_labels()
```

### Baseline BD-Tau Visualization

```{r [Serum] Integrated Cohorts Baseline Box Visualization, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(gt) 
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

integrated_color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50",
  "A SCI" = "#007382",
  "B SCI" = "#019787",
  "C/D SCI" = "#82e1cd",
  "Mild TBI" = "#f8dda4",
  "Moderate TBI" = "#f9a03f",
  "Severe TBI" = "#d45113"
)

cntr_tbi_color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50", 
  "Moderate TBI" = "#f9a03f",
  "Severe TBI" = "#d45113"
  )

cntr_sci_color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50", 
  "A SCI" = "#007382",
  "B SCI" = "#019787",
  "C/D SCI" = "#82e1cd"
  )

integrated_3color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50",
  "SCI" = "#07668d",
  "TBI" = "#813405"
)

asia_a_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[!is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA == "A", ]$Subject.ID
asia_b_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[!is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA == "B", ]$Subject.ID
asia_cd_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[!is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA %in% c("C","D"), ]$Subject.ID

serum_df <- serum_baseline_cleaned %>%
  filter(Cohort %in% c("Control","SCI","Mild TBI","Moderate TBI","Severe TBI")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2), !is.na(mean_serum_log2_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = names(integrated_3color_palette))) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort3 = case_when(
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_a_ids  ~ "A SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_b_ids  ~ "B SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_cd_ids ~ "C/D SCI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cohort)
    ),
    Cohort3 = factor(
      Cohort3,
      levels = c("Control", "C/D SCI", "B SCI", "A SCI", "Mild TBI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")
    )
  )

# ==================================================
# General Control/SCI/TBI
# ==================================================

# get summary by cohort

serum_summary_by_cohort <- serum_df %>%
  group_by(Cohort2) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_BDTau = mean(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_BDTau = sd(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_BDTau = median(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25_BDTau = quantile(mean_serum_BDTau, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75_BDTau = quantile(mean_serum_BDTau, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_BDTau = min(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_BDTau = max(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

fc_tbi_sci <- serum_summary_by_cohort$median_BDTau[serum_summary_by_cohort$Cohort2 == "TBI"] /
              serum_summary_by_cohort$median_BDTau[serum_summary_by_cohort$Cohort2 == "SCI"]

fc_tbi_sci

fc_tbi_cntr <- serum_summary_by_cohort$median_BDTau[serum_summary_by_cohort$Cohort2 == "TBI"] /
              serum_summary_by_cohort$median_BDTau[serum_summary_by_cohort$Cohort2 == "Control"]

fc_tbi_cntr

fc_sci_cntr <- serum_summary_by_cohort$median_BDTau[serum_summary_by_cohort$Cohort2 == "SCI"] /
              serum_summary_by_cohort$median_BDTau[serum_summary_by_cohort$Cohort2 == "Control"]

fc_sci_cntr

# comparison

kw_res <- serum_df %>% kruskal_test(mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ Cohort2)

H <- unname(kw_res[["statistic"]])
df <- unname(kw_res[["df"]])
p <- unname(kw_res[["p"]]) 

H; df; p

dunn_res <- serum_df %>%
  dunn_test(mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ Cohort2, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj.sci = format(p.adj, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
  ) %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  arrange(group1, group2)

dunn_report <- dunn_res %>%
  dplyr::select(group1, group2, statistic, p, p.adj) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    z = statistic,
    p_raw = formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
    p_bonf = formatC(p.adj, format = "e", digits = 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(group1, group2, z, p_raw, p_bonf)

dunn_report

y_max <- max(serum_df$mean_serum_log2_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE)
step  <- 0.04 * y_max
dunn_res <- dunn_res %>%
  mutate(y.position = y_max + row_number() * step)

p_serum <- ggplot(serum_df, aes(x = Cohort2, y = mean_serum_log2_BDTau, fill = Cohort2, color = Cohort2)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.62, alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = 3, outlier.color = "red", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.2, shape = 1, alpha = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # median "tick"
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, size = 0.45, color = "black") +
  # palettes
  scale_fill_manual(values = integrated_3color_palette, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = integrated_3color_palette, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log2(BD-Tau)", title = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
  ) +
  # pairwise p-values (stars); hide non-sig if you want
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    dunn_res,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    step.increase = 0.0,
    bracket.size = 0.4,
    size = 6,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +
  # Omnibus p-value annotation at the top-right
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = max(dunn_res$y.position, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.8 * step,
    label = paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ", signif(kw_res$p, 3)),
    hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 3.6
  ) + 
  ylim(1,12.5)

dunn_res %>%
  mutate(
    p_formatted = ifelse(p < 0.001, 
                        format(p, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2),
                        sprintf("%.3f", p)),
    p.adj_formatted = ifelse(p.adj < 0.001,
                            format(p.adj, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2),
                            sprintf("%.3f", p.adj))
  ) %>%
  select(group1, group2, n1, n2, statistic, p_formatted, p.adj_formatted, p.adj.signif) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Group 1", "Group 2", "N1", "N2", "Statistic", "P-value", "Adjusted P", "Sig."),
    caption = "Pairwise Dunn's Test Results for Serum BD-Tau (log2) by Cohort",
    align = c('l', 'l', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c')
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "left"
  )
 
p_serum # FIGURE 1A
```

```{r [Serum/CSF MATCHED] Integrated Cohorts Baseline Box Visualization, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# ============================================
# Matched Serum/CSF Cohort Visualization
# ============================================

library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

# Color palette
integrated_color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50",
  "A SCI" = "#007382",
  "B SCI" = "#019787",
  "C/D SCI" = "#82e1cd",
  "B-D SCI" = "#82e1cd",
  "Mild TBI" = "#f8dda4",
  "Moderate TBI" = "#f9a03f",
  "Severe TBI" = "#d45113"
)

cntr_tbi_color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50", 
  "Moderate TBI" = "#f9a03f",
  "Severe TBI" = "#d45113"
  )

cntr_sci_color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50", 
  "A SCI" = "#007382",
  "B SCI" = "#019787",
  "C/D SCI" = "#82e1cd"
  )

integrated_3color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50",
  "SCI" = "#07668d",
  "TBI" = "#813405"
)

match_df <- match_baseline_cleaned %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2), !is.na(mean_serum_log2_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = names(integrated_3color_palette))) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort3 = case_when(
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_a_ids  ~ "A SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_b_ids  ~ "B SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_cd_ids ~ "C/D SCI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cohort)
    ),
    Cohort3 = factor(
      Cohort3,
      levels = c("Control", "C/D SCI", "B SCI", "A SCI", "Mild TBI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")
    ),
    Cohort4 = factor(case_when(
      Cohort3 %in% c("B SCI", "C/D SCI") ~ "B-D SCI",
      Cohort3 == "A SCI" ~ "A SCI",
      TRUE ~ Cohort3),
      levels = c("Control","B-D SCI","A SCI","Moderate TBI","Severe TBI"))
  )

csf_df <- csf_baseline_cleaned %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2), !is.na(mean_csf_log2_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = names(integrated_3color_palette))) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort3 = case_when(
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_a_ids  ~ "A SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_b_ids  ~ "B SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_cd_ids ~ "C/D SCI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cohort)
    ),
    Cohort3 = factor(
      Cohort3,
      levels = c("Control", "C/D SCI", "B SCI", "A SCI", "Mild TBI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")
    ),
    Cohort4 = factor(case_when(
      Cohort3 %in% c("B SCI", "C/D SCI") ~ "B-D SCI",
      Cohort3 == "A SCI" ~ "A SCI",
      TRUE ~ Cohort3),
      levels = c("Control","B-D SCI","A SCI","Moderate TBI","Severe TBI"))
  )

# ============================================
# DATA PREPARATION
# ============================================

# Filter to only complete cases for 2-group analysis
match_df_2group <- match_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2), 
         !is.na(mean_serum_log2_BDTau),
         !is.na(mean_csf_log2_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = c("SCI", "TBI")))

# Check sample sizes
cat("Sample sizes for 2-group analysis:\n")
print(table(match_df_2group$Cohort2))
cat("\n")

fc_df <- match_df_2group %>%
  group_by(Cohort2) %>%
  summarise(
    serum_median = median(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    csf_median   = median(mean_csf_BDTau,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    serum_FC = serum_median[Cohort2 == "TBI"] /
               serum_median[Cohort2 == "SCI"],
    csf_FC = csf_median[Cohort2 == "TBI"] /
               csf_median[Cohort2 == "SCI"],
    serum_log2FC = log2(serum_FC),
    csf_log2FC = log2(csf_FC)
  )

fc_df

# Filter for 5-group analysis
match_df_5group <- match_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort3),
         !is.na(mean_serum_log2_BDTau),
         !is.na(mean_csf_log2_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(Cohort3 = factor(Cohort3,
```

```{r Combine Serum/CSF together and save output}

# ============================================
# SERUM: Save Statistical Test Results
# ============================================

# Kruskal-Wallis results for Cohort2 (3 groups)
serum_kw_cohort2 <- serum_df %>% 
  kruskal_test(mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ Cohort2) %>%
  mutate(Analysis = "Serum - 3 Groups (Control/SCI/TBI)",
         Variable = "mean_serum_log2_BDTau")

# Dunn test results for Cohort2
serum_dunn_cohort2 <- serum_df %>%
  dunn_test(mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ Cohort2, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  mutate(Analysis = "Serum - 3 Groups (Control/SCI/TBI)",
         Variable = "mean_serum_log2_BDTau") %>%
  dplyr::select(Analysis, Variable, group1, group2, n1, n2, statistic, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif)

# Kruskal-Wallis results for Cohort3 (7 groups)
serum_kw_cohort3 <- serum_df %>% 
  kruskal_test(mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ Cohort3) %>%
  mutate(Analysis = "Serum - 7 Groups (Detailed)",
         Variable = "mean_serum_log2_BDTau")

# Dunn test results for Cohort3
serum_dunn_cohort3 <- serum_df %>%
  dunn_test(mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ Cohort3, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  mutate(Analysis = "Serum - 7 Groups (Detailed)",
         Variable = "mean_serum_log2_BDTau") %>%
  dplyr::select(Analysis, Variable, group1, group2, n1, n2, statistic, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif)

# Combine serum results
serum_kw_all <- bind_rows(serum_kw_cohort2, serum_kw_cohort3)
serum_dunn_all <- bind_rows(serum_dunn_cohort2, serum_dunn_cohort3)

# ============================================
# CSF: Save Statistical Test Results
# ============================================

# Kruskal-Wallis results for Cohort2 (2 groups: SCI/TBI only)
csf_kw_cohort2 <- csf_df %>% 
  kruskal_test(mean_csf_log2_BDTau ~ Cohort2) %>%
  mutate(Analysis = "CSF - 2 Groups (SCI/TBI)",
         Variable = "mean_csf_log2_BDTau")

# Dunn test results for Cohort2
csf_dunn_cohort2 <- csf_df %>%
  dunn_test(mean_csf_log2_BDTau ~ Cohort2, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  mutate(Analysis = "CSF - 2 Groups (SCI/TBI)",
         Variable = "mean_csf_log2_BDTau") %>%
  dplyr::select(Analysis, Variable, group1, group2, n1, n2, statistic, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif)

# Kruskal-Wallis results for Cohort3 (5 groups)
csf_kw_cohort3 <- csf_df %>% 
  kruskal_test(mean_csf_log2_BDTau ~ Cohort3) %>%
  mutate(Analysis = "CSF - 5 Groups (Detailed)",
         Variable = "mean_csf_log2_BDTau")

# Dunn test results for Cohort3
csf_dunn_cohort3 <- csf_df %>%
  dunn_test(mean_csf_log2_BDTau ~ Cohort3, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  mutate(Analysis = "CSF - 5 Groups (Detailed)",
         Variable = "mean_csf_log2_BDTau") %>%
  dplyr::select(Analysis, Variable, group1, group2, n1, n2, statistic, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif)

# Combine CSF results
csf_kw_all <- bind_rows(csf_kw_cohort2, csf_kw_cohort3)
csf_dunn_all <- bind_rows(csf_dunn_cohort2, csf_dunn_cohort3)

# ============================================
# COMBINED: All Results in One File
# ============================================

# Combine all Kruskal-Wallis results
all_kw_results <- bind_rows(serum_kw_all, csf_kw_all)

# Combine all Dunn test results
all_dunn_results <- bind_rows(serum_dunn_all, csf_dunn_all)

all_dunn_results %>%
  mutate(
    p_formatted = ifelse(p < 0.001, 
                        format(p, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2),
                        sprintf("%.3f", p)),
    p.adj_formatted = ifelse(p.adj < 0.001,
                            format(p.adj, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2),
                            sprintf("%.3f", p.adj))
  ) %>%
  select(group1, group2, n1, n2, statistic, p_formatted, p.adj_formatted, p.adj.signif) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Group 1", "Group 2", "N1", "N2", "Statistic", "P-value", "Adjusted P", "Sig."),
    caption = "Pairwise Dunn's Test Results for Serum BD-Tau (log2) by Cohort",
    align = c('l', 'l', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c')
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "left"
  )

library(writexl)

# Save to single Excel file with multiple sheets
write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Kruskal-Wallis" = all_kw_results,
    "Dunn_Pairwise" = all_dunn_results
  ),
  path = paste0(figures_path, "serum & csf combined_baseline_statistical_tests.xlsx")
)
```

```{r Serum BD-tau performance of TBI severity, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# ============================================
# Comprehensive ROC Analysis: TBI Subgroups
# ============================================

library(pROC)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(writexl)
library(patchwork)

serum_tbi_roc_data <- serum_baseline_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    log2_BDTau = log2(mean_serum_BDTau),
    z_log2_BDTau = as.numeric(scale(log2_BDTau))
  ) %>%
  filter(Cohort %in% c("Mild TBI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort = factor(
      Cohort,
      levels = c("Mild TBI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")
    )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_serum_BDTau), !is.na(Cohort))

# Check sample sizes
cat("\n=== SAMPLE SIZES (AFTER EXCLUDING MILD TBI) ===\n")
print(table(serum_tbi_roc_data$Cohort))
cat("\n")

# ============================================
# ROC FUNCTION
# ============================================

perform_roc <- function(data, group1, group2, predictor = "mean_serum_BDTau") {
  library(dplyr)
  library(pROC)
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(cohort %in% c(group1, group2)) %>%
    mutate(outcome = ifelse(cohort == group2, 1, 0)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[predictor]]), !is.na(outcome))
  
  roc_obj <- roc(
    response  = df$outcome,
    predictor = df[[predictor]],
    levels    = c(0, 1),
    direction = "<"
  )
  
  coords_best <- coords(roc_obj, "best", ret = "all", best.method = "youden")
  
  # Handle multiple optimal thresholds
  if (is.matrix(coords_best)) coords_best <- as.data.frame(coords_best)
  if (nrow(coords_best) > 1) {
    max_sens_idx <- which.max(coords_best$sensitivity)
    coords_best  <- coords_best[max_sens_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  thr <- as.numeric(coords_best$threshold)
  
  # With direction = "<", higher predictor values indicate outcome==1,
  # so classify as positive if predictor >= threshold
  pred_pos <- ifelse(df[[predictor]] >= thr, 1, 0)
  
  tp <- sum(pred_pos == 1 & df$outcome == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  fp <- sum(pred_pos == 1 & df$outcome == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  tn <- sum(pred_pos == 0 & df$outcome == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  fn <- sum(pred_pos == 0 & df$outcome == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  sensitivity <- if ((tp + fn) > 0) tp / (tp + fn) else NA_real_
  specificity <- if ((tn + fp) > 0) tn / (tn + fp) else NA_real_
  ppv         <- if ((tp + fp) > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else NA_real_
  npv         <- if ((tn + fn) > 0) tn / (tn + fn) else NA_real_
  
  # Add these to coords output
  coords_best$ppv <- ppv
  coords_best$npv <- npv
  coords_best$sensitivity_check <- sensitivity
  coords_best$specificity_check <- specificity
  
  auc_val <- auc(roc_obj)
  ci_val  <- ci.auc(roc_obj)
  
  list(
    roc = roc_obj,
    coords = coords_best,
    auc = auc_val,
    ci = ci_val,
    n_group1 = sum(df$outcome == 0),
    n_group2 = sum(df$outcome == 1),
    confusion = c(TP = tp, FP = fp, TN = tn, FN = fn)
  )
}

# Create 3-group classification
```

```{r Serum BD-tau performance of Control/TBI/SCI, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# Helper to automate section creation
library(pROC)
library(rsample)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

run_pairwise_roc_section <- function(data, cohort_var, pairs, section_label, biomarker_var = "mean_serum_BDTau") {
  purrr::map_dfr(pairs, function(pair) {
    df <- data %>%
      rename(cohort = {{cohort_var}}) %>%
      filter(cohort %in% c(pair[1], pair[2])) %>%
      mutate(outcome = ifelse(cohort == pair[2], 1, 0)) %>%
      drop_na(all_of(biomarker_var), outcome)

    if (length(unique(df[[biomarker_var]])) <= 1) {
      return(tibble(
        Section = section_label,
        Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
        N_Reference = sum(df$outcome == 0),
        N_Positive = sum(df$outcome == 1),
        AUC = NA, CI_Lower = NA, CI_Upper = NA, Cutpoint = NA,
        NPV = NA, PPV = NA, Sensitivity = NA, Specificity = NA,
        Accuracy = NA, AUC_CV_Mean = NA, AUC_CV_SD = NA,
        AUC_Boot_Mean = NA, AUC_Boot_SD = NA,
        AUC_Boot_Lower = NA, AUC_Boot_Upper = NA
      ))
    }

    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(df$outcome, df[[biomarker_var]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")

    coords_best <- tryCatch({
      pROC::coords(roc_obj, "best", best.method = "youden", ret = "all")
    }, error = function(e) NULL)

    # Binary prediction
    pred <- if (!is.null(coords_best)) ifelse(df[[biomarker_var]] >= coords_best[["threshold"]], 1, 0) else rep(NA, nrow(df))
    TP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    ACC <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)

    # Cross-validation with class check
    set.seed(42)
    folds <- rsample::vfold_cv(df, v = 5, strata = outcome)
    auc_cv <- map_dbl(folds$splits, function(split) {
      val_data <- rsample::assessment(split)
      if (length(unique(val_data$outcome)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
      roc_cv <- pROC::roc(val_data$outcome, val_data[[biomarker_var]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
      pROC::auc(roc_cv)
    }) %>% na.omit()

    # Bootstrapping with class check
    set.seed(42)
    auc_boot <- replicate(1000, {
      boot_idx <- sample(1:nrow(df), replace = TRUE)
      boot_data <- df[boot_idx, ]
      if (length(unique(boot_data$outcome)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
      roc_boot <- pROC::roc(boot_data$outcome, boot_data[[biomarker_var]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
      pROC::auc(roc_boot)
    }) %>% na.omit()

    tibble(
      Section = section_label,
      Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
      N_Reference = sum(df$outcome == 0),
      N_Positive = sum(df$outcome == 1),
      AUC = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
      CI_Lower = pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)[1],
      CI_Upper = pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)[3],
      Cutpoint = coords_best[["threshold"]],
      NPV = coords_best[["npv"]],
      PPV = coords_best[["ppv"]],
      Sensitivity = coords_best[["sensitivity"]],
      Specificity = coords_best[["specificity"]],
      Accuracy = ACC,
      AUC_CV_Mean = mean(auc_cv),
      AUC_CV_SD = sd(auc_cv),
      AUC_Boot_Mean = mean(auc_boot),
      AUC_Boot_SD = sd(auc_boot),
      AUC_Boot_Lower = quantile(auc_boot, 0.025),
      AUC_Boot_Upper = quantile(auc_boot, 0.975)
    )
  })
}
```

```{r Serum BD-tau perforamnce of Control/TBI/SCI adjusted for sex and age, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# =============================================
# Adjusted Logistic ROC: BD-Tau ~ Age + Sex
# =============================================

# Helper to automate section creation

run_pairwise_roc_section <- function(data, cohort_var, pairs, section_label,
                                     n_folds = 5, n_boot = 1000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  purrr::map_dfr(pairs, function(pair) {
    df <- data %>%
      rename(cohort = {{cohort_var}}) %>%
      filter(cohort %in% pair) %>%
      mutate(
        outcome = as.numeric(cohort == pair[2]),
        Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
      ) %>%
      drop_na(z_log2_BDTau, Age, Sex, outcome)
    
    if (length(unique(df$outcome)) < 2 || length(unique(df$Sex)) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        Section = section_label,
        Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
        AUC = NA, CI_Lower = NA, CI_Upper = NA,
        N_Reference = sum(df$outcome == 0),
        N_Positive = sum(df$outcome == 1),
        Cutpoint = NA, NPV = NA, PPV = NA,
        Sensitivity = NA, Specificity = NA,
        Accuracy = NA,
        AUC_CV = NA, SD_CV = NA,
        AUC_Boot = NA, CI_Lower_Boot = NA, CI_Upper_Boot = NA
      ))
    }
    
    # Fit full model
    model <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_BDTau + Age + Sex, data = df, family = binomial())
    prob <- predict(model, type = "response")
    
    # Full ROC
    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(df$outcome, prob, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
    ci_vals <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)
    
    # Best cutpoint
    coords_best <- pROC::coords(roc_obj, "best", ret = "all", best.method = "youden")
    if (is.data.frame(coords_best) && nrow(coords_best) > 1) {
      coords_best <- coords_best[which.max(coords_best$sensitivity), ]
    }
    thr <- as.numeric(coords_best[["threshold"]])
    pred <- ifelse(prob >= thr, 1, 0)
    
    TP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 1)
    TN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 0)
    FP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 0)
    FN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 1)
    
    ## --------- Cross-validation ---------
    folds <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = nrow(df)))
    aucs_cv <- map_dbl(1:n_folds, function(i) {
      train <- df[folds != i, ]
      test <- df[folds == i, ]
      if (length(unique(train$outcome)) < 2 || length(unique(train$Sex)) < 2) return(NA)
      tryCatch({
        m_cv <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_BDTau + Age + Sex, data = train, family = binomial())
        prob_test <- predict(m_cv, newdata = test, type = "response")
        roc_cv <- pROC::roc(test$outcome, prob_test, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_cv))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    })
    
    ## --------- Bootstrapping ---------
    aucs_boot <- map_dbl(1:n_boot, function(i) {
      boot_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df)), replace = TRUE)
      df_boot <- df[boot_idx, ]
      if (length(unique(df_boot$outcome)) < 2 || length(unique(df_boot$Sex)) < 2) return(NA)
      tryCatch({
        m_boot <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_BDTau + Age + Sex, data = df_boot, family = binomial())
        prob_boot <- predict(m_boot, type = "response")
        roc_boot <- pROC::roc(df_boot$outcome, prob_boot, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_boot))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    })
    
    tibble(
  Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),

  AUC = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
  CI_Lower = ci_vals[1],
  CI_Upper = ci_vals[3],

  Sensitivity = coords_best[["sensitivity"]],
  Specificity = coords_best[["specificity"]],
  NPV = coords_best[["npv"]],
  PPV = coords_best[["ppv"]],
  Accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN),
  Cutpoint = thr,

  AUC_CV_Mean = mean(aucs_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
  AUC_CV_SD   = sd(aucs_cv, na.rm = TRUE),

  AUC_Boot_Mean  = mean(aucs_boot, na.rm = TRUE),
  AUC_Boot_SD    = sd(aucs_boot, na.rm = TRUE),
  AUC_Boot_Lower = quantile(aucs_boot, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
  AUC_Boot_Upper = quantile(aucs_boot, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
)
  })
}
```

```{r Matched Serum-CSF Diagnostic Performance, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=8.27, fig.height=11.69/2}
# ============================================
# ROC Analysis: Matched Cohort Only
# TBI vs SCI (Overall and Subgroups)
# INCLUDING MODERATE TBI
# Serum and CSF BD-Tau
# ============================================

library(pROC)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(writexl)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================
# PREPARE DATA - MATCHED COHORT ONLY
# ============================================

# Filter to matched cohort with complete data
match_roc_data <- match_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2), 
         !is.na(Cohort3),
         !is.na(mean_serum_BDTau),
         !is.na(mean_csf_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = c("SCI", "TBI")),
    Cohort3 = factor(Cohort3, 
                     levels = c("A SCI", "B SCI", "C/D SCI", 
                                "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")),
    log2_serum_BDTau = log2(mean_serum_BDTau),
    z_log2_serum_BDTau = as.numeric(scale(log2_serum_BDTau)),
    log2_csf_BDTau = log2(mean_csf_BDTau),
    z_log2_csf_BDTau = as.numeric(scale(log2_csf_BDTau))
  )

# Check sample sizes
cat("\n=== MATCHED COHORT SAMPLE SIZES (INCLUDING MODERATE TBI) ===\n")
cat("\n2-Group (Cohort2):\n")
print(table(match_roc_data$Cohort2))
cat("\n5-Group (Cohort3):\n")
print(table(match_roc_data$Cohort3))
cat("\n")

run_pairwise_roc_section <- function(data, cohort_var, pairs, section_label, biomarker_var = "mean_serum_BDTau") {
  purrr::map_dfr(pairs, function(pair) {
    df <- data %>%
      rename(cohort = {{cohort_var}}) %>%
      filter(cohort %in% c(pair[1], pair[2])) %>%
      mutate(outcome = ifelse(cohort == pair[2], 1, 0)) %>%
      drop_na(all_of(biomarker_var), outcome)
    
    if (length(unique(df[[biomarker_var]])) <= 1) {
      return(tibble(
        Section = section_label,
        Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
        N_Reference = sum(df$outcome == 0),
        N_Positive = sum(df$outcome == 1),
        AUC = NA, CI_Lower = NA, CI_Upper = NA, Cutpoint = NA,
        NPV = NA, PPV = NA, Sensitivity = NA, Specificity = NA,
        Accuracy = NA, AUC_CV_Mean = NA, AUC_CV_SD = NA,
        AUC_Boot_Mean = NA, AUC_Boot_SD = NA,
        AUC_Boot_Lower = NA, AUC_Boot_Upper = NA
      ))
    }
    
    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(df$outcome, df[[biomarker_var]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "auto")
    
    coords_best <- tryCatch({
      pROC::coords(roc_obj, "best", best.method = "youden", ret = "all")
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    # Binary prediction
    pred <- if (!is.null(coords_best)) ifelse(df[[biomarker_var]] >= coords_best[["threshold"]], 1, 0) else rep(NA, nrow(df))
    TP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    ACC <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
    
    # Cross-validation with class check
    set.seed(42)
    folds <- rsample::vfold_cv(df, v = 5, strata = outcome)
    auc_cv <- map_dbl(folds$splits, function(split) {
      val_data <- rsample::assessment(split)
      if (length(unique(val_data$outcome)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
      roc_cv <- pROC::roc(val_data$outcome, val_data[[biomarker_var]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
      pROC::auc(roc_cv)
    }) %>% na.omit()
    
    # Bootstrapping with class check
    set.seed(42)
    auc_boot <- replicate(1000, {
      boot_idx <- sample(1:nrow(df), replace = TRUE)
      boot_data <- df[boot_idx, ]
      if (length(unique(boot_data$outcome)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
      roc_boot <- pROC::roc(boot_data$outcome, boot_data[[biomarker_var]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
      pROC::auc(roc_boot)
    }) %>% na.omit()
    
    tibble(
      Section = section_label,
      Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
      N_Reference = sum(df$outcome == 0),
      N_Positive = sum(df$outcome == 1),
      AUC = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
      CI_Lower = pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)[1],
      CI_Upper = pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)[3],
      Cutpoint = coords_best[["threshold"]],
      NPV = coords_best[["npv"]],
      PPV = coords_best[["ppv"]],
      Sensitivity = coords_best[["sensitivity"]],
      Specificity = coords_best[["specificity"]],
      Accuracy = ACC,
      AUC_CV_Mean = mean(auc_cv),
      AUC_CV_SD = sd(auc_cv),
      AUC_Boot_Mean = mean(auc_boot),
      AUC_Boot_SD = sd(auc_boot),
      AUC_Boot_Lower = quantile(auc_boot, 0.025),
      AUC_Boot_Upper = quantile(auc_boot, 0.975)
    )
  })
}

    Sensitivity = sprintf("%.3f", Sensitivity),
    Specificity = sprintf("%.3f", Specificity)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Comparison, AUC, CI_Lower, CI_Upper, Sensitivity, Specificity,
                NPV, PPV, Accuracy, Cutpoint,
                AUC_CV_Mean, AUC_CV_SD, AUC_Boot_Mean, AUC_Boot_SD, AUC_Boot_Lower, AUC_Boot_Upper)

# ============================================
# CSF ROC ANALYSIS
# ============================================

run_pairwise_roc_section <- function(data, cohort_var, pairs, section_label, biomarker_var = "mean_csf_BDTau") {
  purrr::map_dfr(pairs, function(pair) {
    df <- data %>%
      rename(cohort = {{cohort_var}}) %>%
      filter(cohort %in% c(pair[1], pair[2])) %>%
      mutate(outcome = ifelse(cohort == pair[2], 1, 0)) %>%
      drop_na(all_of(biomarker_var), outcome)
    
    if (length(unique(df[[biomarker_var]])) <= 1) {
      return(tibble(
        Section = section_label,
        Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
        N_Reference = sum(df$outcome == 0),
        N_Positive = sum(df$outcome == 1),
        AUC = NA, CI_Lower = NA, CI_Upper = NA, Cutpoint = NA,
        NPV = NA, PPV = NA, Sensitivity = NA, Specificity = NA,
        Accuracy = NA, AUC_CV_Mean = NA, AUC_CV_SD = NA,
        AUC_Boot_Mean = NA, AUC_Boot_SD = NA,
        AUC_Boot_Lower = NA, AUC_Boot_Upper = NA
      ))
    }
    
    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(df$outcome, df[[biomarker_var]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "auto")
    
    coords_best <- tryCatch({
      pROC::coords(roc_obj, "best", best.method = "youden", ret = "all")
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    # Binary prediction
    pred <- if (!is.null(coords_best)) ifelse(df[[biomarker_var]] >= coords_best[["threshold"]], 1, 0) else rep(NA, nrow(df))
    TP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    ACC <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
    
    # Cross-validation with class check
    set.seed(42)
    folds <- rsample::vfold_cv(df, v = 5, strata = outcome)
    auc_cv <- map_dbl(folds$splits, function(split) {
      val_data <- rsample::assessment(split)
      if (length(unique(val_data$outcome)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
      roc_cv <- pROC::roc(val_data$outcome, val_data[[biomarker_var]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
      pROC::auc(roc_cv)
    }) %>% na.omit()
    
    # Bootstrapping with class check
    set.seed(42)
    auc_boot <- replicate(1000, {
      boot_idx <- sample(1:nrow(df), replace = TRUE)
      boot_data <- df[boot_idx, ]
      if (length(unique(boot_data$outcome)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
      roc_boot <- pROC::roc(boot_data$outcome, boot_data[[biomarker_var]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
      pROC::auc(roc_boot)
    }) %>% na.omit()
    
    tibble(
      Section = section_label,
      Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
      N_Reference = sum(df$outcome == 0),
      N_Positive = sum(df$outcome == 1),
      AUC = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
      CI_Lower = pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)[1],
      CI_Upper = pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)[3],
      Cutpoint = coords_best[["threshold"]],
      NPV = coords_best[["npv"]],
      PPV = coords_best[["ppv"]],
      Sensitivity = coords_best[["sensitivity"]],
      Specificity = coords_best[["specificity"]],
      Accuracy = ACC,
      AUC_CV_Mean = mean(auc_cv),
      AUC_CV_SD = sd(auc_cv),
      AUC_Boot_Mean = mean(auc_boot),
      AUC_Boot_SD = sd(auc_boot),
      AUC_Boot_Lower = quantile(auc_boot, 0.025),
      AUC_Boot_Upper = quantile(auc_boot, 0.975)
    )
  })
}
```

```{r Matched Serum-CSF Diagnostic Performance adjusted for sex and age, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}

### Serum

# =============================================
# Adjusted Logistic ROC: BD-Tau ~ Age + Sex
# =============================================

# Helper to automate section creation

run_pairwise_roc_section <- function(data, cohort_var, pairs, section_label,
                                     n_folds = 5, n_boot = 1000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  purrr::map_dfr(pairs, function(pair) {
    df <- data %>%
      rename(cohort = {{cohort_var}}) %>%
      filter(cohort %in% pair) %>%
      mutate(
        outcome = as.numeric(cohort == pair[2]),
        Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
      ) %>%
      drop_na(z_log2_serum_BDTau, Age, Sex, outcome)
    
    if (length(unique(df$outcome)) < 2 || length(unique(df$Sex)) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        Section = section_label,
        Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
        AUC = NA, CI_Lower = NA, CI_Upper = NA,
        N_Reference = sum(df$outcome == 0),
        N_Positive = sum(df$outcome == 1),
        Cutpoint = NA, NPV = NA, PPV = NA,
        Sensitivity = NA, Specificity = NA,
        Accuracy = NA,
        AUC_CV = NA, SD_CV = NA,
        AUC_Boot = NA, CI_Lower_Boot = NA, CI_Upper_Boot = NA
      ))
    }
    
    # Fit full model
    model <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_serum_BDTau + Age + Sex, data = df, family = binomial())
    prob <- predict(model, type = "response")
    
    # Full ROC
    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(df$outcome, prob, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
    ci_vals <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)
    
    # Best cutpoint
    coords_best <- pROC::coords(roc_obj, "best", ret = "all", best.method = "youden")
    if (is.data.frame(coords_best) && nrow(coords_best) > 1) {
      coords_best <- coords_best[which.max(coords_best$sensitivity), ]
    }
    thr <- as.numeric(coords_best[["threshold"]])
    pred <- ifelse(prob >= thr, 1, 0)
    
    TP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 1)
    TN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 0)
    FP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 0)
    FN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 1)
    
    ## --------- Cross-validation ---------
    folds <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = nrow(df)))
    aucs_cv <- map_dbl(1:n_folds, function(i) {
      train <- df[folds != i, ]
      test <- df[folds == i, ]
      if (length(unique(train$outcome)) < 2 || length(unique(train$Sex)) < 2) return(NA)
      tryCatch({
        m_cv <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_serum_BDTau + Age + Sex, data = train, family = binomial())
        prob_test <- predict(m_cv, newdata = test, type = "response")
        roc_cv <- pROC::roc(test$outcome, prob_test, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_cv))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    })
    
    ## --------- Bootstrapping ---------
    aucs_boot <- map_dbl(1:n_boot, function(i) {
      boot_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df)), replace = TRUE)
      df_boot <- df[boot_idx, ]
      if (length(unique(df_boot$outcome)) < 2 || length(unique(df_boot$Sex)) < 2) return(NA)
      tryCatch({
        m_boot <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_serum_BDTau + Age + Sex, data = df_boot, family = binomial())
        prob_boot <- predict(m_boot, type = "response")
        roc_boot <- pROC::roc(df_boot$outcome, prob_boot, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_boot))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    })
    
    tibble(
      Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
      
      AUC = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
      CI_Lower = ci_vals[1],
      CI_Upper = ci_vals[3],
      
      Sensitivity = coords_best[["sensitivity"]],
      Specificity = coords_best[["specificity"]],
      NPV = coords_best[["npv"]],
      PPV = coords_best[["ppv"]],
      Accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN),
      Cutpoint = thr,
      
      AUC_CV_Mean = mean(aucs_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_CV_SD   = sd(aucs_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      AUC_Boot_Mean  = mean(aucs_boot, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_Boot_SD    = sd(aucs_boot, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_Boot_Lower = quantile(aucs_boot, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_Boot_Upper = quantile(aucs_boot, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
}

        roc_cv <- pROC::roc(test$outcome, prob_test, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_cv))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    })
    
    ## --------- Bootstrapping ---------
    aucs_boot <- map_dbl(1:n_boot, function(i) {
      boot_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df)), replace = TRUE)
      df_boot <- df[boot_idx, ]
      if (length(unique(df_boot$outcome)) < 2 || length(unique(df_boot$Sex)) < 2) return(NA)
      tryCatch({
        m_boot <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_csf_BDTau + Age + Sex, data = df_boot, family = binomial())
        prob_boot <- predict(m_boot, type = "response")
        roc_boot <- pROC::roc(df_boot$outcome, prob_boot, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_boot))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    })
    
    tibble(
      Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
      
      AUC = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
      CI_Lower = ci_vals[1],
      CI_Upper = ci_vals[3],
      
      Sensitivity = coords_best[["sensitivity"]],
      Specificity = coords_best[["specificity"]],
      NPV = coords_best[["npv"]],
      PPV = coords_best[["ppv"]],
      Accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN),
      Cutpoint = thr,
      
      AUC_CV_Mean = mean(aucs_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_CV_SD   = sd(aucs_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      AUC_Boot_Mean  = mean(aucs_boot, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_Boot_SD    = sd(aucs_boot, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_Boot_Lower = quantile(aucs_boot, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_Boot_Upper = quantile(aucs_boot, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
}

# Section 1: Control vs SCI vs TBI
section1_csf_match_summary<- run_pairwise_roc_section(
```

### Longitudinal Spaghetti Visualization

```{r [Serum] Integrated Cohorts Longitudinal Visualization, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# ============================================
# Serum Cohort: Longitudinal Spaghetti Plots with Control
# Panel A: Control vs. SCI vs. TBI (3-group)
# Panel B: Control vs. Subgroups (Moderate/Severe TBI + ASIA SCI)
# Note: Control excluded from mixed-effects models
# ============================================

library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(data.table)

# ============================================
# PREPARE DATA - SERUM COHORT WITH CONTROL
# ============================================

# ASIA IDs for SCI subgroups
asia_a_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[
  !is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & 
    sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA == "A", ]$Subject.ID

asia_b_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[
  !is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & 
    sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA == "B", ]$Subject.ID

asia_cd_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[
  !is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & 
    sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA %in% c("C","D"), ]$Subject.ID

# Get intersection of variables
intersect_vars <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  names(cntr),
  names(sci_serum_demo),
  names(tbi_serum_demo)
))

serum_cleaned <- rbindlist(
  list(
    cntr %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)),
    sci_serum_demo %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)),
    tbi_serum_demo %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars))
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% serum_baseline_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Control", "SCI", "Mild TBI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")),
    # 3-group classification (exclude Mild TBI)
    Cohort3 = factor(
      case_when(
        Cohort == "Control" ~ "Control",
        Cohort == "SCI" ~ "SCI",
        Cohort %in% c("Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI") ~ "TBI",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ), 
      levels = c("Control", "SCI", "TBI")
    ),
    # Subgroup classification
    Cohort_Subgroup = case_when(
      Cohort == "Control" ~ "Control",
      !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_a_ids ~ "A SCI",
      !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_b_ids ~ "B SCI",
      !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_cd_ids ~ "C/D SCI",
      Cohort == "Moderate TBI" ~ "Moderate TBI",
      Cohort == "Severe TBI" ~ "Severe TBI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cohort)
    ),
    Cohort_Subgroup = factor(Cohort_Subgroup, 
                             levels = c("Control", "A SCI", "B SCI", "C/D SCI", 
                                        "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")),
    # Set Control timepoint to 0
    serum_First_Digit_12Hr = case_when(
      Cohort == "Control" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ serum_First_Digit_12Hr
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(time_since_baseline =
           serum_First_Digit_12Hr -
           min(serum_First_Digit_12Hr, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Cohort3) | !is.na(Cohort_Subgroup))  # Keep valid subjects

# Color palettes
color_3group <- c(
  "Control" = "black",
  "SCI" = "#07668d", 
  "TBI" = "#813405"
)

color_subgroup <- c(
  "Control" = "black",
  "A SCI" = "#007382",
  "B SCI" = "#019787",
  "C/D SCI" = "#82e1cd",
  "Moderate TBI" = "#f9a03f",
  "Severe TBI" = "#d45113"
)

# ============================================
# PANEL A: Control vs. SCI vs. TBI (3-group)
# ============================================

# Filter to first 12 timepoints (0-144 hours)
dd_3group <- serum_cleaned %>% 
  mutate(time_since_baseline = as.numeric(time_since_baseline)) %>%
  filter(time_since_baseline <= 12) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort3))

# Prepare plot data
plot_data_3group <- dd_3group %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_since_baseline), !is.na(serum_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = Cohort3,
    time_hours = as.numeric(as.character(time_since_baseline)) * 12,
    subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
  )

# Summarize mean ± SE
summary_3group <- plot_data_3group %>%
  group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean_val = base::mean(serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sd_val = stats::sd(serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n))

# Count unique subjects per group
group_counts_3group <- plot_data_3group %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject.ID, group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::count(group) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(group, " (N=", n, ")"))

# Mixed-effects model for statistics - EXCLUDE CONTROL
plot_data_3group_no_control <- plot_data_3group %>%
  filter(group != "Control")

lmm_3group <- lmer(serum_log2_BDTau ~ group * time_hours + (1 | subject), 
                   data = plot_data_3group_no_control)
anova_3group <- anova(lmm_3group)

cat("\n=== PANEL A: 3-GROUP MODEL (EXCLUDING CONTROL) ===\n")
print(anova_3group)
cat("\n")

# Per-timepoint statistics - EXCLUDE CONTROL
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

tp_pvals_3group <- plot_data_3group_no_control %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_hours), !is.na(group), !is.na(serum_log2_BDTau)) %>%
  group_by(time_hours) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    dat <- .x
    
    n_by_group <- dat %>% count(group, name = "n") %>%
      mutate(group = as.character(group))
    
    if (n_distinct(dat$group) < 2) {
      out <- tibble(p = NA_real_, test = "kruskal")
    } else {
      out <- tibble(
        p = kruskal.test(serum_log2_BDTau ~ group, data = dat)$p.value,
        test = "kruskal"
      )
    }
    
    out %>%
      bind_cols(
        n_by_group %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = n, names_prefix = "n_")
      )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

# Create plot - NO STATISTICS

    values = color_3group

    size = "none",
    shape = "none",
    linetype = "none"

  labs(
    title = NULL, # "Serum BD-Tau: Control vs. SCI vs. TBI",

    color = "Group",
    linetype = "Group"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
  )

tp_annot <- tp_pvals_3group %>%
  mutate(
    p_star = case_when(
      p_adj < 1e-4 ~ "****",
      p_adj < 1e-3 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 1e-2 ~ "**",
      p_adj < 5e-2 ~ "*",

    ),
    n_label = paste0("SCI n=", n_SCI, "\nTBI n=", n_TBI)
  )
```

```{r [Serum] Integrated Cohorts Longitudinal GAM, eval=FALSE, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(mgcv)

# Filter out Control and Mild TBI for GAM fitting
gam_models <- plot_data %>%
  filter(!group %in% c("Control", "Mild TBI")) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    # Count unique time points
    n_unique <- length(unique(.x$time_hours))
    
    # Only fit GAM if we have enough data
    if (n_unique >= 4) {
      k_value <- min(3, n_unique - 1)
      
      fit <- tryCatch({
        gam(as.formula(paste0(y_col, " ~ s(time_hours, k = ", k_value, ")")), data = .x)
      }, error = function(e) {
        # Fallback to linear model if GAM fails
        lm(as.formula(paste0(y_col, " ~ time_hours")), data = .x)
      })
      
      pred_data <- data.frame(
        time_hours = seq(min(.x$time_hours), max(.x$time_hours), length.out = 100)
      )
      pred <- predict(fit, newdata = pred_data, se.fit = TRUE)
      
      data.frame(
        time_hours = pred_data$time_hours,
        fit = pred$fit,
        se = pred$se.fit,
        lower = pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit,
        upper = pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit
      )
    } else {
      # Not enough points - just return the observed data
      .x %>%
        dplyr::select(time_hours, y = !!sym(y_col)) %>%
        mutate(fit = y, se = 0, lower = y, upper = y)
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Separate data for plotting
smooth_groups <- c("SCI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")
point_only_groups <- c("Control", "Mild TBI")

serum_smooth <- ggplot() +
  # GAM smooth curves with CI for selected groups
  geom_ribbon(data = gam_models, 
              aes(x = time_hours, y = fit, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = group), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(data = gam_models, 
            aes(x = time_hours, y = fit, color = group), 
            linewidth = 1.2) +
  # Points for groups with smooth curves
  geom_point(data = summary_df %>% filter(group %in% smooth_groups), 
             aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group), 
             size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  # Points only for Control and Mild TBI (with connecting line)
  geom_line(data = summary_df %>% filter(group %in% point_only_groups),
            aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group),
            linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = summary_df %>% filter(group %in% point_only_groups), 
             aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group), 
             size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Control" = "grey50",
    "SCI" = "#07668d",
    "Mild TBI" = "#eaa392",
    "Moderate TBI" = "#da674a",
    "Severe TBI" = "#6e3325"
  )) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "SCI" = "#07668d",
    "Moderate TBI" = "#da674a",
    "Severe TBI" = "#6e3325"
  )) +
  geom_text(
    data = tp_pvals,
    aes(x = time_hours, 
        y = max(c(gam_models$upper, summary_df$mean_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05, 
        label = significance_adj),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Serum BD-Tau Trajectories",
    subtitle = "GAM smooth for SCI/Moderate/Severe TBI; observed means for Control/Mild TBI",
    x = "Hours Post-Injury",
    y = "BD-Tau (pg/mL)",
    color = "Cohort",
    fill = "Cohort"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

pdf(paste0(figures_path, "serum_cntr_tbi_sci_smooth_trajectories.pdf"),
    height = 8.27/2, width = 11.69/2)
print(serum_smooth)
dev.off()
```

```{r [CSF] Integrated Cohorts Longitudinal Visualization, eval=FALSE, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

sci_csf_demo$Cohort <- sci_csf_demo$Cohort.y

intersect_vars <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  names(sci_csf_demo),
  names(tbi_csf_demo)
))

csf_cleaned <- rbindlist(
  list(
    sci_csf_demo %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)),
    tbi_csf_demo %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars))
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% csf_baseline_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("SCI","Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")))

### Draw longitudinal spaghetti plots

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

dd <- csf_cleaned %>% 
  mutate(csf_First_Digit_12Hr = as.numeric(csf_First_Digit_12Hr)) %>%
  filter(csf_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12 
         # | csf_First_Digit_12Hr == 180 | csf_First_Digit_12Hr == 360
  )

outcome_col <- "Cohort"
time_col <- "csf_First_Digit_12Hr"

y_col <- "csf_BDTau"
log_y_col <- "csf_log2_BDTau"

group_counts <- dd %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject.ID, !!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
  count(!!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(!!sym(outcome_col), " (N=", n, ")"))

custom_labels <- setNames(group_counts$label, group_counts[[outcome_col]])

labeller_fn <- function(values) {
  unname(custom_labels[as.character(values)])
}

# subset data
plot_data <- dd %>%
  filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(!!sym(outcome_col)),
    time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
    time_hours = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))) * 12,
    subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
  )

# fit the model on log-scale with random intercept per subject

formula <- paste0(log_y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data)
anova_result <- anova(lmm)
p_val <- anova_result["group", "Pr(>F)"]
p_text <- paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3))

# calculate per-time point p-values on log scale

tp_pvals <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(time_hours) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- try(lm(as.formula(paste0(log_y_col, " ~ group")), data = .x), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
      tibble(p = NA)
    } else {
      tibble(p = anova(model)[["Pr(>F)"]][1])
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    significance_adj = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

tp_pvals %>%
  dplyr::select(time_hours, p, p_adj, significance_adj) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# summarize mean ± SD on original scale

summary_df <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
    sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
    se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# plot on original scale

csf_spaghetti <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "SCI" = "#07668d",
    "Moderate TBI" = "#da674a",
    "Severe TBI" = "#6e3325"
  )) + 
  geom_text(
    data = tp_pvals,
    aes(x = time_hours, y = max(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1, 
        label = significance_adj),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "CSF BD-Tau (pg/ml)",
    # subtitle = paste0("Mixed-effects model: Group × Time interaction p = ", 
    #                   format.pval(p_val, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)),
    x = "Hours Post-Injury",
    y = "BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +  # Show 0, 24, 48, 72, 96, 120, 144
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

pdf(paste0(figures_path, "csf_cntr_tbi_sci_spaghetti.pdf"),
    height = 8.27/2, width = 11.69/2)
print(csf_spaghetti)
dev.off()
```

```{r [serum/CSF] Integrated Cohorts Longitudinal Visualization, fig.align='center', fig.width=11.69/2, fig.height=8.27, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# ============================================
# Matched Cohort: Serum and CSF Longitudinal Spaghetti Plots
# Panel A: TBI vs SCI (2-group)
# Panel B: Subgroups (Moderate/Severe TBI + ASIA SCI)
# ============================================

library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(data.table)

# ============================================
# PREPARE DATA - MATCHED COHORT
# ============================================

# ASIA IDs for SCI subgroups
asia_a_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[
  !is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & 
    sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA == "A", ]$Subject.ID

asia_b_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[
  !is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & 
    sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA == "B", ]$Subject.ID

asia_cd_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[
  !is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & 
    sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA %in% c("C","D"), ]$Subject.ID

# Get intersection of variables between serum and CSF
intersect_vars <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  names(sci_match_demo),
  names(tbi_match_demo)
))

match_cleaned <- rbindlist(
  list(
    sci_match_demo %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)),
    tbi_match_demo %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars))
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% match_baseline_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    # time
    mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value = 2*mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value,
    mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value),
    # 2-group classification
    Cohort2 = case_when(
      Cohort %in% c("A SCI", "B SCI", "C/D SCI") ~ "SCI",
      Cohort %in% c("Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI") ~ "TBI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cohort)
    ),
    Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = c("SCI", "TBI")),
    # Subgroup classification
    Cohort_Subgroup = case_when(
      !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_a_ids ~ "A SCI",
      !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_b_ids ~ "B SCI",
      !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_cd_ids ~ "C/D SCI",
      Cohort == "Moderate TBI" ~ "Moderate TBI",
      Cohort == "Severe TBI" ~ "Severe TBI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cohort)
    ),
    Cohort_Subgroup = factor(Cohort_Subgroup, 
                             levels = c("A SCI", "B SCI", "C/D SCI", 
                                        "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI"))
  )


# Color palettes
color_2group <- c("SCI" = "#07668d", "TBI" = "#813405")

color_subgroup <- c(
  "A SCI" = "#007382",
  "B SCI" = "#019787",
  "C/D SCI" = "#82e1cd",
  "Moderate TBI" = "#f9a03f",
  "Severe TBI" = "#d45113"
)

# ============================================
# SERUM PANEL A: TBI vs SCI (2-group)
# ============================================

# Filter to first 12 timepoints (0-144 hours)
dd_serum_2group <- match_cleaned %>% 
  mutate(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = as.numeric(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr)) %>%
  filter(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2))

# Prepare plot data
plot_data_serum_2group <- dd_serum_2group %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr), !is.na(mean)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = Cohort2,
    time_hours = as.numeric(as.character(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr)) * 12,
    subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
  )

# Summarize mean ± SE
summary_serum_2group <- plot_data_serum_2group %>%
  group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
  summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean_val = base::mean(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sd_val = stats::sd(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n))

# Count unique subjects per group
group_counts_serum_2group <- plot_data_serum_2group %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject.ID, group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  count(group) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(group, " (N=", n, ")"))

# Mixed-effects model for statistics (saved to Excel, not shown on plot)
lmm_serum_2group <- lmer(mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ group * time_hours + (1 | subject), 
                         data = plot_data_serum_2group)
anova_serum_2group <- anova(lmm_serum_2group)

# Per-timepoint statistics
tp_pvals_serum_2group <- plot_data_serum_2group %>%
  group_by(time_hours) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- try(lm(mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ group, data = .x), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
      tibble(p = NA)
    } else {
      tibble(p = anova(model)[["Pr(>F)"]][1])
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

# Create plot - NO STATISTICS
p_serum_2group <- ggplot(summary_serum_2group, aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), 
                width = 2, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = color_2group,
    labels = setNames(group_counts_serum_2group$label, group_counts_serum_2group$group)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("SCI" = "solid", "TBI" = "dashed"),
    labels = setNames(group_counts_serum_2group$label, group_counts_serum_2group$group)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Serum BD-Tau: SCI vs TBI",
    x = "Hours Post-Injury",
    y = "BD-Tau (pg/mL)",
    color = "Group",
    linetype = "Group"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
  )

# ============================================
# SERUM PANEL B: Subgroups
# ============================================

dd_serum_subgroup <- match_cleaned %>% 
  mutate(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = as.numeric(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr)) %>%
  filter(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort_Subgroup))

# Prepare plot data
plot_data_serum_subgroup <- dd_serum_subgroup %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr), !is.na(mean_serum_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = Cohort_Subgroup,
    time_hours = as.numeric(as.character(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr)) * 12,
    subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
  )

# Summarize mean ± SE
summary_serum_subgroup <- plot_data_serum_subgroup %>%
  group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_val = mean(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sd_val = sd(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE), 
    se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Count unique subjects per group

  dplyr::select(Subject.ID, group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  count(group) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(group, " (N=", n, ")"))

# Mixed-effects model for statistics
lmm_serum_subgroup <- lmer(mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ group * time_hours + (1 | subject), 
                           data = plot_data_serum_subgroup)
anova_serum_subgroup <- anova(lmm_serum_subgroup)

# Per-timepoint statistics

# Create plot - NO STATISTICS

  geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), 
                width = 2, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = color_subgroup,
    labels = setNames(group_counts_serum_subgroup$label, group_counts_serum_subgroup$group)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("A SCI" = "solid", "B SCI" = "solid", "C/D SCI" = "solid",
               "Moderate TBI" = "dashed", "Severe TBI" = "dashed"),
    labels = setNames(group_counts_serum_subgroup$label, group_counts_serum_subgroup$group)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Serum BD-Tau: Subgroups",
    x = "Hours Post-Injury",

    linetype = "Group"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top",

# ============================================
# CSF PANEL A: TBI vs SCI (2-group)
# ============================================

dd_csf_2group <- match_cleaned %>% 
  filter(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2))

# Prepare plot data
plot_data_csf_2group <- dd_csf_2group %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr), !is.na(mean_csf_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = Cohort2,
    time_hours = as.numeric(as.character(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr)) * 12,
    subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
  )

# Summarize mean ± SE
summary_csf_2group <- plot_data_csf_2group %>%
  group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_val = mean(mean_csf_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sd_val = sd(mean_csf_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE), 
    se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Count unique subjects per group
group_counts_csf_2group <- plot_data_csf_2group %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject.ID, group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  count(group) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(group, " (N=", n, ")"))

# Mixed-effects model for statistics
lmm_csf_2group <- lmer(mean_csf_log2_BDTau ~ group * time_hours + (1 | subject), 
                       data = plot_data_csf_2group)
anova_csf_2group <- anova(lmm_csf_2group)

# Per-timepoint statistics
tp_pvals_csf_2group <- plot_data_csf_2group %>%
  group_by(time_hours) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- try(lm(mean_csf_log2_BDTau ~ group, data = .x), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
      tibble(p = NA)
    } else {
      tibble(p = anova(model)[["Pr(>F)"]][1])
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

# Create plot - NO STATISTICS
p_csf_2group <- ggplot(summary_csf_2group, aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), 
                width = 2, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = color_2group,
    labels = setNames(group_counts_csf_2group$label, group_counts_csf_2group$group)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("SCI" = "solid", "TBI" = "dashed"),
    labels = setNames(group_counts_csf_2group$label, group_counts_csf_2group$group)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CSF BD-Tau: SCI vs TBI",
    x = "Hours Post-Injury",
    y = "BD-Tau (pg/mL)",
    color = "Group",
    linetype = "Group"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
  )
```
