```{r Serum-CSF Correlation Analysis, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=8.27, fig.height=11.69/3}

# ============================================
# Spearman Correlation: Serum vs CSF BD-Tau
# Matched Cohort - Raw Scale Only
# For Publication and ROC Comparison Context
# ============================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(gt)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# PREPARE MATCHED COHORT DATA
# ============================================

match_df <- match_baseline_cleaned %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2), 
         !is.na(mean_serum_BDTau), 
         !is.na(mean_csf_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = c("SCI", "TBI")),
    Cohort3 = case_when(
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_a_ids  ~ "A SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_b_ids  ~ "B SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_cd_ids ~ "C/D SCI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cohort)
    ),
    Cohort3 = factor(
      Cohort3,
      levels = c("C/D SCI", "B SCI", "A SCI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")
    )
  )

# ============================================
# SPEARMAN CORRELATION ANALYSIS
# ============================================

# Helper function to calculate Spearman CI using Fisher's Z transformation
spearman_ci <- function(x, y, conf.level = 0.95, digits = 2) {
  test_result <- cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  rho <- as.numeric(test_result$estimate)
  n <- sum(complete.cases(x, y))

  # Fisher's Z transformation
  z <- 0.5 * log((1 + rho) / (1 - rho))
  se <- 1 / sqrt(n - 3)
  z_crit <- qnorm((1 + conf.level) / 2)

  # CI on Z scale
  z_lower <- z - z_crit * se
  z_upper <- z + z_crit * se

  # Transform back
  ci_lower <- (exp(2 * z_lower) - 1) / (exp(2 * z_lower) + 1)
  ci_upper <- (exp(2 * z_upper) - 1) / (exp(2 * z_upper) + 1)

  list(
    estimate = rho,
    conf.int = c(ci_lower, ci_upper),
    p.value = test_result$p.value,                         # numeric (for stats)
    p.value_sci = formatC(test_result$p.value,             # formatted (for reporting)
                          format = "e",
                          digits = digits),
    n = n
  )
}


# Overall correlation
cor_overall <- spearman_ci(match_df$mean_serum_BDTau, 
                           match_df$mean_csf_BDTau)

# By cohort

cor_sci <- spearman_ci(
  match_df$mean_serum_BDTau[match_df$Cohort2 == "SCI"],
  match_df$mean_csf_BDTau[match_df$Cohort2 == "SCI"]
)

cor_tbi <- spearman_ci(
  match_df$mean_serum_BDTau[match_df$Cohort2 == "TBI"],
  match_df$mean_csf_BDTau[match_df$Cohort2 == "TBI"]
)

# Summary statistics by cohort

correlation_by_cohort <- match_df %>%
  group_by(Cohort2) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Serum_Mean = mean(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    Serum_SD = sd(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    Serum_Median = median(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    CSF_Mean = mean(mean_csf_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    CSF_SD = sd(mean_csf_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    CSF_Median = median(mean_csf_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(correlation_by_cohort)

# Summary by subgroup
correlation_by_subgroup <- match_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort3)) %>%
  group_by(Cohort3) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Serum_Mean = mean(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    CSF_Mean = mean(mean_csf_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    Spearman_rho = cor(mean_serum_BDTau, mean_csf_BDTau, method = "spearman"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(correlation_by_subgroup)

# ============================================
# PUBLICATION TABLE
# ============================================

# Create comprehensive correlation table
correlation_summary <- data.frame(
  Group = c("Overall", "SCI", "TBI"),
  N = c(cor_overall$n, cor_sci$n, cor_tbi$n),
  Spearman_rho = c(cor_overall$estimate, cor_sci$estimate, cor_tbi$estimate),
  CI_Lower = c(cor_overall$conf.int[1], cor_sci$conf.int[1], cor_tbi$conf.int[1]),
  CI_Upper = c(cor_overall$conf.int[2], cor_sci$conf.int[2], cor_tbi$conf.int[2]),
  P_value = c(cor_overall$p.value, cor_sci$p.value, cor_tbi$p.value)
)

# Format for publication
correlation_summary_formatted <- correlation_summary %>%
  mutate(
    `Spearman ρ (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", 
                                    Spearman_rho, CI_Lower, CI_Upper),
    `P-value` = ifelse(P_value < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                       sprintf("%.3f", P_value))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Group, N, `Spearman ρ (95% CI)`, `P-value`)

print(correlation_summary_formatted)

# Create gt table
correlation_gt <- correlation_summary_formatted %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Serum-CSF BD-Tau Correlation**"),
    subtitle = "Matched Cohort Analysis (Baseline)"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Group = "Group",
    N = "N",
    `Spearman ρ (95% CI)` = "Spearman ρ (95% CI)",
    `P-value` = "P-value"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    heading.title.font.size = 14
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Spearman rank correlation on raw BD-Tau values (pg/mL)",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = `Spearman ρ (95% CI)`)
  )

# Save table
gtsave(correlation_gt, 
       paste0(figures_path, "matched_serum_csf_correlation_table.png"))

# ============================================
# VISUALIZATION: SCATTER PLOT
# ============================================

# Define colors
cohort_colors <- c("SCI" = "#07668d", "TBI" = "#813405")

# Main scatter plot with log scales
p_correlation <- ggplot(match_df, aes(x = mean_serum_BDTau, y = mean_csf_BDTau)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Cohort2), shape = 1, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed", 
              se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cohort_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10", 
                     breaks = c(10, 30, 100, 300, 1000)) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10",
                     breaks = c(100, 300, 1000, 3000, 10000, 30000)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "bl") +
  labs(
    title = "Serum-CSF BD-Tau Correlation",
    x = "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)",
    y = "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)",
    color = "Cohort"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    #legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

print(p_correlation)

# Faceted by cohort
p_by_cohort <- ggplot(match_df %>% mutate(Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = c("TBI","SCI"))), aes(x = mean_serum_BDTau, y = mean_csf_BDTau)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Cohort2), shape = 1, size = 2, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed",
              se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Cohort2, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cohort_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "bl") +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)",
    y = "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_by_cohort)

# ============================================
# SAVE OUTPUTS
# ============================================

# Save main plot
pdf(paste0(figures_path, "matched_serum_csf_correlation_main.pdf"),
    width = 8,27, height = 11.69/3)
print(p_correlation)
dev.off()

# Save faceted plot
pdf(paste0(figures_path, "matched_serum_csf_correlation_by_cohort.pdf"),
    width = 8.27, height = 11.69/3)
print(p_by_cohort)
dev.off()

# EXTENDED DATA FIGURE

pdf("~/Desktop/Projects/manuscript writing/TBI BD-tau/figure/Extended Data Figure 1A.pdf",
    width = 8.27, height = 11.69/4)
print(p_correlation | p_by_cohort)
dev.off()

# Save to Excel

  list(
    "Correlation_Summary" = correlation_summary_formatted,
```

### GOS outcome boxplots visualization

```{r TBI Serum GOS Boxplot, eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27}

library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(gt)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")

# Color palette for outcomes (standardized)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Favorable" = "#3594cc", 
  "Unfavorable" = "#ea801c", 
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop: Serum Only
# ============================================

serum_raw_plots <- list()
serum_log_plots <- list()
serum_stats <- list()
serum_summaries <- list()

counter <- 1

for (tp in timepoints) {
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
  
  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      Outcome = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
      ),
      y_raw = mean_serum_BDTau,
      y_log2 = mean_serum_log2_BDTau
    )
  
  # -------------------- Statistical Tests --------------------
  
  # Kruskal-Wallis test on log2 values
  kruskal_all <- kruskal.test(y_log2 ~ Outcome, data = plot_data)
  
  # Dunn's post-hoc test with FDR adjustment
  dunn_results <- plot_data %>%
    dunn_test(y_log2 ~ Outcome, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj")
  
  # Extract individual comparisons - both raw and adjusted
  fav_unfav_raw <- dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Unfavorable"]
  fav_unfav_adj <- dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Unfavorable"]
  
  fav_dec_raw <- dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
  fav_dec_adj <- dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
  
  unfav_dec_raw <- dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "Unfavorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
  unfav_dec_adj <- dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Unfavorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
  
  # Handle missing comparisons
  if (length(fav_unfav_raw) == 0) { fav_unfav_raw <- NA; fav_unfav_adj <- NA }
  if (length(fav_dec_raw) == 0) { fav_dec_raw <- NA; fav_dec_adj <- NA }
  if (length(unfav_dec_raw) == 0) { unfav_dec_raw <- NA; unfav_dec_adj <- NA }
  
  # Store statistics
  serum_stats[[counter]] <- data.frame(
    Biofluid = "Serum",
    Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
    N_Favorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Favorable"),
    N_Unfavorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Unfavorable"),
    N_Deceased = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Deceased"),
    Kruskal_statistic = kruskal_all$statistic,
    Kruskal_p = kruskal_all$p.value,
    Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_raw = fav_unfav_raw,
    Dunn_FavVsDec_p_raw = fav_dec_raw,
    Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_raw = unfav_dec_raw,
    Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_adj = fav_unfav_adj,
    Dunn_FavVsDec_p_adj = fav_dec_adj,
    Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_adj = unfav_dec_adj
  )
  
  # -------------------- Summary Statistics --------------------
  
  serum_summaries[[counter]] <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(Outcome) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Mean_Raw = mean(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD_Raw = sd(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median_Raw = median(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q25_Raw = quantile(y_raw, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q75_Raw = quantile(y_raw, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Log2 = mean(y_log2, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD_Log2 = sd(y_log2, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median_Log2 = median(y_log2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Biofluid = "Serum",
      Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")
    )
  
  # -------------------- RAW SCALE PLOT --------------------
  
  y_max_raw <- max(plot_data$y_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_limits_raw <- c(0, y_max_raw * 1.5)
  
  dunn_plot_raw <- dunn_results %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "Outcome") %>%
    mutate(y.position = y_limits_raw[2] * c(0.88, 0.93, 0.98))
  
  p_raw <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Outcome, y = y_raw, fill = Outcome, color = Outcome)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = 3, outlier.color = "red", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, 
                 size = 0.4, color = "black") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      dunn_plot_raw,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      bracket.size = 0.5,
      size = 4,
      hide.ns = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "GOS") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "GOS") +
    ylim(y_limits_raw) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Serum (Raw) - ", tp, " months"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10)
    )
  
  serum_raw_plots[[tp]] <- p_raw
  
  # -------------------- LOG2 SCALE PLOT --------------------
  
  y_min_log2 <- min(plot_data$y_log2, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max_log2 <- max(plot_data$y_log2, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_limits_log2 <- c(y_min_log2 - 1, y_max_log2 + 2.5)
  
  dunn_plot_log2 <- dunn_results %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "Outcome") %>%
    mutate(y.position = y_limits_log2[2] * c(0.88, 0.93, 0.98))
  
  p_log2 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Outcome, y = y_log2, fill = Outcome, color = Outcome)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, 
                 size = 0.4, color = "black") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      dunn_plot_log2,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      bracket.size = 0.5,
      size = 4,
      hide.ns = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "GOS") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "GOS") +
    ylim(y_limits_log2) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Serum (Log2) - ", tp, " months"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "log2(Serum BD-Tau)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10)
    )
  
  serum_log_plots[[tp]] <- p_log2
  
  counter <- counter + 1
}

# ============================================
# Individual Plots for Serum
# ============================================

# Raw scale plot
serum_raw_plot <- wrap_plots(
  serum_raw_plots[["03"]], serum_raw_plots[["06"]],
  ncol = 2
) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Baseline Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL) by GOS Outcome",
    subtitle = "Pairwise comparisons: Dunn's test with FDR correction",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(serum_raw_plot)

pdf(paste0(figures_path, "GOS_outcomes_baseline_serum_raw.pdf"), 
    width = 11.69/2, height = 8.27/2)
print(serum_raw_plot)
dev.off()

# Log2 scale plot
serum_log_plot <- wrap_plots(
  serum_log_plots[["03"]] + ggtitle("3 Month"), serum_log_plots[["06"]]+ ggtitle("6 Month"),
  ncol = 2
) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = NULL, # "Baseline Serum log2(BD-Tau) by GOS Outcome",
    subtitle = NULL, # "Pairwise comparisons: Dunn's test with FDR correction",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(serum_log_plot)

pdf(paste0(figures_path, "GOS_outcomes_baseline_serum_log2.pdf"), 
    width = 11.69/2, height = 8.27/2)
print(serum_log_plot)
dev.off()

cairo_pdf("~/Desktop/Projects/manuscript writing/TBI BD-tau/figure/Supplementary Figure 2A-B.pdf",
          width = 8.27/1.5, height = 11.69/4, family = "Arial")
print(serum_log_plot)
dev.off()

# ============================================
# Save Statistics and Summaries
# ============================================

serum_stats_df <- bind_rows(serum_stats)
serum_summaries_df <- bind_rows(serum_summaries)

# Format for publication
serum_stats_formatted <- serum_stats_df %>%
  mutate(
    Kruskal_p_formatted = format.pval(Kruskal_p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
    FavVsUnfav_combined = paste0(
      format.pval(Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), " / ",
      format.pval(Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
    ),
    FavVsDec_combined = paste0(
      format.pval(Dunn_FavVsDec_p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), " / ",
      format.pval(Dunn_FavVsDec_p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
    ),
    UnfavVsDec_combined = paste0(
      format.pval(Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), " / ",
      format.pval(Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
    ),
    Any_Significant = ifelse(
      Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_adj < 0.05 | Dunn_FavVsDec_p_adj < 0.05 | Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_adj < 0.05,
      "Yes", "No"
    )
  )

serum_summaries_formatted <- serum_summaries_df %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_SD_Raw = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", Mean_Raw, SD_Raw),
    Median_IQR_Raw = sprintf("%.1f [%.1f, %.1f]", Median_Raw, Q25_Raw, Q75_Raw),
    Mean_SD_Log2 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", Mean_Log2, SD_Log2)
  )

# Save to Excel
write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Summary_Statistics" = serum_summaries_formatted,
    "Statistical_Tests_Raw" = serum_stats_df %>%
      dplyr::select(Biofluid, Timepoint, N_Favorable, N_Unfavorable, N_Deceased,
             Kruskal_p, Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_raw, Dunn_FavVsDec_p_raw, Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_raw),
    "Statistical_Tests_FDR" = serum_stats_df %>%
      dplyr::select(Biofluid, Timepoint, N_Favorable, N_Unfavorable, N_Deceased,
             Kruskal_p, Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_adj, Dunn_FavVsDec_p_adj, Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_adj),
    "Stats_Combined_Format" = serum_stats_formatted
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "TBI_GOS_serum_analysis.xlsx")
)
```

```{r TBI Serum Fav vs Unfav Boxplot}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rlang)

outcome_colors <- c(
  "Favorable" = "#3594cc", 
  "Unfavorable" = "#ea801c", 
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

timepoints <- c("03", "06")

serum_log_plots <- list()
serum_stats <- list()
serum_summaries <- list()

for (tp in timepoints) {
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
  
  plot_data <- tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned %>%
    mutate(Outcome_raw = dplyr::pull(., outcome_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Outcome_raw)) %>%
    mutate(
      Outcome = recode(Outcome_raw, "Dead" = "Deceased")
    ) %>%
    filter(Outcome %in% c("Favorable", "Unfavorable")) %>%
    mutate(
      Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable")),
      y_raw  = mean_serum_BDTau,
      y_log2 = mean_serum_log2_BDTau
    )
  
  serum_summaries[[tp]] <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(Outcome) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Cohort = Outcome,
      n      = n(),
      mean   = mean(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd     = sd(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      p25    = quantile(y_raw, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      p75    = quantile(y_raw, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      min    = min(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      max    = max(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(Cohort, n, mean, sd, median, p25, p75, min, max) %>%
    mutate(
      Biofluid  = "Serum",
      Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")
    )
  
  wilcox_res <- wilcox.test(y_log2 ~ Outcome, data = plot_data, exact = FALSE)
  
  serum_stats[[tp]] <- data.frame(
    Biofluid = "Serum",
    Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
    N_Favorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Favorable"),
    N_Unfavorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Unfavorable"),
    Test = "Wilcoxon rank-sum",
    Statistic = unname(wilcox_res$statistic),
    P_value = wilcox_res$p.value
  )
  
  serum_log_plots[[tp]] <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Outcome, y = y_log2, color = Outcome, fill = Outcome)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.62, alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = 3, 
                 outlier.color = "red", color = "black") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.2, shape = 1, alpha = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, size = 0.4, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log2(Serum BD-Tau)", title = paste0(tp, " months")) +
    # labs(x = NULL, y = "log2(BD-Tau)", title = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("Favorable", "Unfavorable")),
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.signif",
      tip.length = 0.02,
      bracket.size = 0.5,
      size = 6
    ) 
}

serum_fav_unfav_p <- serum_log_plots[[1]] + serum_log_plots[[2]]
```

```{r TBI GOS Outcome Analysis, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27}

# ============================================
# TBI GOS Outcome Analysis
# Serum and CSF BD-Tau (Raw and Log2 Scale)
# Statistical comparison: Favorable vs Deceased only
# ============================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(gt)
library(writexl)
library(tidyr)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")

# Color palette for outcomes
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Favorable" = "#7ab8d7", 
  "Unfavorable" = "#db95a0", 
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

# ============================================
# Function: Process and Plot for Each Biofluid/Scale
# ============================================

process_outcome_data <- function(data, biofluid, scale_type, timepoint) {
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", timepoint)
  
  # Select appropriate columns based on biofluid
  if (biofluid == "Serum") {
    y_col_raw <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
  } else if (biofluid == "CSF") {
    y_col_raw <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
  }
  
  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      Outcome = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
      ),
      BD_Tau_Raw = !!sym(y_col_raw),
      BD_Tau_Log2 = !!sym(y_col_log2)
    )
  
  # Select y variable based on scale
  if (scale_type == "Raw") {
    plot_data$y_value <- plot_data$BD_Tau_Raw
    y_label <- "BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
  } else {
    plot_data$y_value <- plot_data$BD_Tau_Log2
    y_label <- "log2(BD-Tau)"
  }
  
  return(plot_data)
}

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop: All Combinations
# ============================================

all_plots <- list()
all_stats <- list()
all_summaries <- list()

counter <- 1

for (biofluid in c("Serum", "CSF")) {
  for (scale_type in c("Raw", "Log2")) {
    for (tp in timepoints) {
      
      # Process data
      plot_data <- process_outcome_data(
        data = tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned,
        biofluid = biofluid,
        scale_type = scale_type,
        timepoint = tp
      )
      
      # -------------------- Statistical Tests --------------------
      # Pairwise comparisons: save both raw and FDR-corrected p-values
      
      # Kruskal-Wallis for all three groups
      kruskal_all <- kruskal.test(y_value ~ Outcome, data = plot_data)
      
      # Dunn's post-hoc test with FDR adjustment for pairwise comparisons
      dunn_results <- plot_data %>%
        dunn_test(y_value ~ Outcome, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
        add_significance("p.adj")
      
      # Extract individual comparisons - both raw and adjusted
      fav_unfav_raw <- dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Unfavorable"]
      fav_unfav_adj <- dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Unfavorable"]
      
      fav_dec_raw <- dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
      fav_dec_adj <- dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
      
      unfav_dec_raw <- dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "Unfavorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
      unfav_dec_adj <- dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Unfavorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
      
      # Handle missing comparisons
      if (length(fav_unfav_raw) == 0) { fav_unfav_raw <- NA; fav_unfav_adj <- NA }
      if (length(fav_dec_raw) == 0) { fav_dec_raw <- NA; fav_dec_adj <- NA }
      if (length(unfav_dec_raw) == 0) { unfav_dec_raw <- NA; unfav_dec_adj <- NA }
      
      # Store statistics
      all_stats[[counter]] <- data.frame(
        Biofluid = biofluid,
        Scale = scale_type,
        Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
        N_Favorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Favorable"),
        N_Unfavorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Unfavorable"),
        N_Deceased = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Deceased"),
        Kruskal_statistic = kruskal_all$statistic,
        Kruskal_p = kruskal_all$p.value,
        # Raw p-values
        Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_raw = fav_unfav_raw,
        Dunn_FavVsDec_p_raw = fav_dec_raw,
        Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_raw = unfav_dec_raw,
        # FDR-adjusted p-values
        Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_adj = fav_unfav_adj,
        Dunn_FavVsDec_p_adj = fav_dec_adj,
        Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_adj = unfav_dec_adj
      )
      
      # -------------------- Summary Statistics --------------------
      
      all_summaries[[counter]] <- plot_data %>%
        group_by(Outcome) %>%
        summarise(
          N = n(),
          Mean = mean(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
          SD = sd(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
          Median = median(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
          Q25 = quantile(y_value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
          Q75 = quantile(y_value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
          Min = min(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
          Max = max(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          Biofluid = biofluid,
          Scale = scale_type,
          Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")
        )
      
      # -------------------- Create Plot --------------------
      
      # Determine y-axis limits based on scale
      if (scale_type == "Raw") {
        if (biofluid == "Serum") {
          y_limits <- c(0, max(plot_data$y_value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.5)
        } else {
          y_limits <- c(0, max(plot_data$y_value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.5)
        }
      } else {
        y_limits <- c(min(plot_data$y_value, na.rm = TRUE) - 1,
                      max(plot_data$y_value, na.rm = TRUE) + 2.5)
      }
      
      # Prepare significance brackets for plotting
      y_max <- max(plot_data$y_value, na.rm = TRUE)
      dunn_plot <- dunn_results %>%
        add_xy_position(x = "Outcome") %>%
        mutate(y.position = y_limits[2] * c(0.88, 0.93, 0.98))
      
      # Create plot
      p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Outcome, y = y_value, fill = Outcome, color = Outcome)) +
        geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = 3, outlier.color = "red", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
        stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, 
                     size = 0.4, color = "black") +
        stat_pvalue_manual(
          dunn_plot,
          label = "p.adj.signif",
          tip.length = 0.01,
          bracket.size = 0.5,
          size = 4,
          hide.ns = TRUE
        ) +
        scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "GOS") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "GOS") +
        ylim(y_limits) +
        labs(
          title = paste0(biofluid, " (", scale_type, ") - ", tp, " months"),
          x = NULL,
          y = if (scale_type == "Raw") {
            paste0(biofluid, " BD-Tau (pg/mL)")
          } else {
            paste0("log2(", biofluid, " BD-Tau)")
          }
        ) +
        theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
        theme(
          legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10)
        )
      
      all_plots[[counter]] <- p
      counter <- counter + 1
    }
  }
}

# ============================================
# Combine All Plots: Separate by Scale
# ============================================

# Serum Log2: indices 3, 4 (03, 06 months)

    # Favorable vs Unfavorable

    FavVsUnfav_adj = format.pval(Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),

    # Favorable vs Deceased
    FavVsDec_raw = format.pval(Dunn_FavVsDec_p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
    FavVsDec_adj = format.pval(Dunn_FavVsDec_p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),

    # Unfavorable vs Deceased

    UnfavVsDec_adj = format.pval(Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
    UnfavVsDec_combined = paste0(UnfavVsDec_raw, " / ", UnfavVsDec_adj),
    # Any significant after FDR correction
    Any_Significant = ifelse(
      Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_adj < 0.05 | Dunn_FavVsDec_p_adj < 0.05 | Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_adj < 0.05,
      "Yes", "No"
    )
```

```{r TBI Fav vs Unfav Boxplot}

outcome_colors <- c(
  "Favorable" = "#3594cc", 
  "Unfavorable" = "#ea801c", 
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

timepoints <- c("03", "06")

process_outcome_data <- function(data, biofluid, scale_type, timepoint) {

  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", timepoint)

  # Select biomarker columns
  if (biofluid == "Serum") {
    y_col_raw  <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
  } else if (biofluid == "CSF") {
    y_col_raw  <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
  } else {
    stop("biofluid must be 'Serum' or 'CSF'")
  }

  plot_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      Outcome_raw = data[[outcome_col]],
      Outcome = recode(Outcome_raw, "Dead" = "Deceased")
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Outcome),
      Outcome %in% c("Favorable", "Unfavorable")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable")),
      BD_Tau_Raw  = data[[y_col_raw]],
      BD_Tau_Log2 = data[[y_col_log2]]
    )

  if (scale_type == "Raw") {
    plot_data$y_value <- plot_data$BD_Tau_Raw
  } else if (scale_type == "Log2") {
    plot_data$y_value <- plot_data$BD_Tau_Log2
  } else {
    stop("scale_type must be 'Raw' or 'Log2'")
  }

  return(plot_data)
}

all_plots <- list()
all_stats <- list()
all_summaries <- list()

counter <- 1

for (biofluid in c("Serum", "CSF")) {
  for (scale_type in c("Raw", "Log2")) {
    for (tp in timepoints) {

      plot_data <- process_outcome_data(
        data = tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned,
        biofluid = biofluid,
        scale_type = scale_type,
        timepoint = tp
      )

      # -----------------------------
      # STATISTICS (Wilcoxon only)
      # -----------------------------
      wilcox_res <- wilcox.test(
        y_value ~ Outcome,
        data = plot_data,
        exact = FALSE
      )

      all_stats[[counter]] <- data.frame(
        Biofluid = biofluid,
        Scale = scale_type,
        Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
        N_Favorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Favorable"),
        N_Unfavorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Unfavorable"),
        Test = "Wilcoxon rank-sum",
        Statistic = unname(wilcox_res$statistic),
        P_value = wilcox_res$p.value
      )

      # -----------------------------
      # SUMMARY TABLE (RAW ONLY)
      # -----------------------------
      if (scale_type == "Raw") {
        all_summaries[[counter]] <- plot_data %>%
          group_by(Outcome) %>%
          summarise(
            Cohort = Outcome,
            n      = n(),
            mean   = mean(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd     = sd(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
            p25    = quantile(y_value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            p75    = quantile(y_value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            min    = min(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
            max    = max(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            Biofluid = biofluid,
            Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")
          )
      }

      # -----------------------------
      # PLOT
      # -----------------------------
      if (scale_type == "Raw") {
        y_limits <- c(0, max(plot_data$y_value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.5)
      } else {
        y_limits <- c(
          min(plot_data$y_value, na.rm = TRUE) - 1,
          max(plot_data$y_value, na.rm = TRUE) + 2
        )
      }

      p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Outcome, y = y_value, fill = Outcome)) +
        geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
        geom_boxplot(
          width = 0.6,
          outlier.shape = NA,
          alpha = 0.7,
          color = "black"
        ) +
        stat_summary(
          fun = median,
          geom = "crossbar",
          width = 0.5,
          size = 0.4,
          color = "black"
        ) +
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = c(
            "Favorable" = "#7ab8d7",
            "Unfavorable" = "#db95a0"
          )
        ) +
        ylim(y_limits) +
        labs(
          title = paste0(biofluid, " (", scale_type, ") – ", tp, " months"),
          x = NULL,
          y = if (scale_type == "Raw") {
            paste0(biofluid, " BD-Tau (pg/mL)")
          } else {
            paste0("log2(", biofluid, " BD-Tau)")
          }
        ) +
        theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
        theme(
          legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10)
        )

      all_plots[[counter]] <- p
      counter <- counter + 1
    }
  }
}
```

```{r TBI CSF GOS Boxplot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27}
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(gt)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")

# Color palette for outcomes (standardized)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Favorable" = "#7ab8d7", 
  "Unfavorable" = "#db95a0", 
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop: CSF Only
# ============================================

csf_raw_plots <- list()
csf_log_plots <- list()
csf_stats <- list()
csf_summaries <- list()

counter <- 1

for (tp in timepoints) {
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
  
  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- tbi_csf_demo_BL_cleaned %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      Outcome = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
      ),
      y_raw = mean_csf_BDTau,
      y_log2 = mean_csf_log2_BDTau
    )
  
  # -------------------- Statistical Tests --------------------
  
  # Kruskal-Wallis test on log2 values
  kruskal_all <- kruskal.test(y_log2 ~ Outcome, data = plot_data)
  
  # Dunn's post-hoc test with FDR adjustment
  dunn_results <- plot_data %>%
    dunn_test(y_log2 ~ Outcome, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj")
  
  # Extract individual comparisons - both raw and adjusted
  fav_unfav_raw <- dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Unfavorable"]
  fav_unfav_adj <- dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Unfavorable"]
  
  fav_dec_raw <- dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
  fav_dec_adj <- dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
  
  unfav_dec_raw <- dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "Unfavorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
  unfav_dec_adj <- dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Unfavorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
  
  # Handle missing comparisons
  if (length(fav_unfav_raw) == 0) { fav_unfav_raw <- NA; fav_unfav_adj <- NA }
  if (length(fav_dec_raw) == 0) { fav_dec_raw <- NA; fav_dec_adj <- NA }
  if (length(unfav_dec_raw) == 0) { unfav_dec_raw <- NA; unfav_dec_adj <- NA }
  
  # Store statistics
  csf_stats[[counter]] <- data.frame(
    Biofluid = "CSF",
    Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
    N_Favorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Favorable"),
    N_Unfavorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Unfavorable"),
    N_Deceased = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Deceased"),
    Kruskal_statistic = kruskal_all$statistic,
    Kruskal_p = kruskal_all$p.value,
    Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_raw = fav_unfav_raw,
    Dunn_FavVsDec_p_raw = fav_dec_raw,
    Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_raw = unfav_dec_raw,
    Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p_adj = fav_unfav_adj,
    Dunn_FavVsDec_p_adj = fav_dec_adj,
    Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p_adj = unfav_dec_adj
  )
  
  # -------------------- Summary Statistics --------------------
  
  csf_summaries[[counter]] <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(Outcome) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Mean_Raw = mean(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD_Raw = sd(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median_Raw = median(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q25_Raw = quantile(y_raw, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q75_Raw = quantile(y_raw, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Log2 = mean(y_log2, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD_Log2 = sd(y_log2, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median_Log2 = median(y_log2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Biofluid = "CSF",
      Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")
    )
  
  # -------------------- RAW SCALE PLOT --------------------
  
  y_max_raw <- max(plot_data$y_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_limits_raw <- c(0, y_max_raw * 1.5)
  
  dunn_plot_raw <- dunn_results %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "Outcome") %>%
    mutate(y.position = y_limits_raw[2] * c(0.88, 0.93, 0.98))
  
  p_raw <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Outcome, y = y_raw, fill = Outcome, color = Outcome)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = 3, outlier.color = "red", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, 
                 size = 0.4, color = "black") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      dunn_plot_raw,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      bracket.size = 0.5,
      size = 4,
      hide.ns = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "GOS") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "GOS") +
    ylim(y_limits_raw) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("CSF (Raw) - ", tp, " months"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10)
    )
  
  csf_raw_plots[[tp]] <- p_raw
  
  # -------------------- LOG2 SCALE PLOT --------------------
  
  y_min_log2 <- min(plot_data$y_log2, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max_log2 <- max(plot_data$y_log2, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_limits_log2 <- c(y_min_log2 - 1, y_max_log2 + 2.5)
  
  dunn_plot_log2 <- dunn_results %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "Outcome") %>%
    mutate(y.position = y_limits_log2[2] * c(0.88, 0.93, 0.98))
  
  p_log2 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Outcome, y = y_log2, fill = Outcome, color = Outcome)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, 
                 size = 0.4, color = "black") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      dunn_plot_log2,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      bracket.size = 0.5,
      size = 4,
      hide.ns = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "GOS") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "GOS") +
    ylim(y_limits_log2) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("CSF (Log2) - ", tp, " months"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "log2(CSF BD-Tau)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10)
    )
  
  csf_log_plots[[tp]] <- p_log2
  
  counter <- counter + 1
}

# ============================================
# Individual Plots for CSF
# ============================================
```

```{r TBI [Serum/CSF] Fav vs Unfav Box}

outcome_colors <- c(
  "Favorable" = "#3594cc", 
  "Unfavorable" = "#ea801c"
)

timepoints <- c("03", "06")

process_outcome_data <- function(data, biofluid, timepoint) {
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", timepoint)
  
  if (!outcome_col %in% names(data)) {
    stop("Column not found: ", outcome_col)
  }
  
  if (biofluid == "Serum") {
    y_col_raw  <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
  } else if (biofluid == "CSF") {
    y_col_raw  <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
  } else {
    stop("biofluid must be 'Serum' or 'CSF'")
  }
  
  if (!y_col_raw %in% names(data))  stop("Column not found: ", y_col_raw)
  if (!y_col_log2 %in% names(data)) stop("Column not found: ", y_col_log2)
  
  # Extract columns safely (row-aligned vectors)
  Outcome_raw <- data[[outcome_col]]
  Outcome <- dplyr::recode(Outcome_raw, "Dead" = "Deceased")
  
  BD_Tau_Raw  <- data[[y_col_raw]]
  BD_Tau_Log2 <- data[[y_col_log2]]
  
  # Build output data.frame (no dplyr masking needed)
  plot_data <- data.frame(
    Outcome = Outcome,
    BD_Tau_Raw = BD_Tau_Raw,
    BD_Tau_Log2 = BD_Tau_Log2,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Exclude NA and Deceased; keep only Favorable/Unfavorable
  plot_data <- plot_data[!is.na(plot_data$Outcome) &
                           plot_data$Outcome %in% c("Favorable", "Unfavorable"), ]
  
  plot_data$Outcome <- factor(plot_data$Outcome, levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable"))
  
  return(plot_data)
}


all_plots <- list()
all_stats <- list()
all_summaries <- list()

counter <- 1

for (biofluid in c("Serum", "CSF")) {
  for (tp in timepoints) {
    
    plot_data <- process_outcome_data(
      data = tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned,
      biofluid = biofluid,
      timepoint = tp
    )
    
    # =====================================
    # SUMMARY TABLE — RAW SCALE ONLY
    # =====================================
    all_summaries[[counter]] <- plot_data %>%
      group_by(Outcome) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        Cohort = Outcome,
        n      = n(),
        mean   = mean(BD_Tau_Raw, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd     = sd(BD_Tau_Raw, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(BD_Tau_Raw, na.rm = TRUE),
        p25    = quantile(BD_Tau_Raw, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        p75    = quantile(BD_Tau_Raw, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        min    = min(BD_Tau_Raw, na.rm = TRUE),
        max    = max(BD_Tau_Raw, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Biofluid = biofluid,
        Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")
      )
    
    # =====================================
    # STATISTICS — LOG2 SCALE
    # =====================================
    wilcox_res <- wilcox.test(
      BD_Tau_Log2 ~ Outcome,
      data = plot_data,
      exact = FALSE
    )
    
    all_stats[[counter]] <- data.frame(
      Biofluid = biofluid,
      Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
      N_Favorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Favorable"),
      N_Unfavorable = sum(plot_data$Outcome == "Unfavorable"),
      Test = "Wilcoxon rank-sum",
      Statistic = unname(wilcox_res$statistic),
      P_value = wilcox_res$p.value
    )
    
    # =====================================
    # PLOT — LOG2 SCALE ONLY
    # =====================================
    y_limits <- c(
      min(plot_data$BD_Tau_Log2, na.rm = TRUE) - 1,
      max(plot_data$BD_Tau_Log2, na.rm = TRUE) + 2
    )
    
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Outcome, y = BD_Tau_Log2, color = Outcome, fill = Outcome)) +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.62, alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = 3, 
                   outlier.color = "red", color = "black") +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.2, shape = 1, alpha = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, guide = "none") +
      scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, guide = "none") +
      ylim(y_limits) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(tp, " months"),
        x = NULL,
        y = paste0("log2(", biofluid, " BD-Tau)")
      ) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
      ) +
      stat_compare_means(
        comparisons = list(c("Favorable", "Unfavorable")),
        method = "wilcox.test",
        label = "p.signif",
        tip.length = 0.02,
        bracket.size = 0.5,
        size = 6
      ) 
    
    all_plots[[counter]] <- p
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}
```

```{r TBI [Serum/CSF] GOS Boxplot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27, eval=FALSE}

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop: Statistics and Plotting
# ============================================

plots <- list() 
stats_results <- list()
summary_list <- list()

for (tp in timepoints) {
  
  # Define column names
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
  y_col_log2 <- "mean_log2_BDTau_Ratio"
  y_col_raw <- "mean_BDTau_Ratio"
  
  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
      ),
      y_log2 = !!sym(y_col_log2),
      y_raw = !!sym(y_col_raw)
    )
  
  # -------------------- Statistical Tests --------------------
  
  # Kruskal-Wallis test on log2 values
  kruskal_all <- kruskal.test(y_log2 ~ group, data = plot_data)
  
  # Dunn's post-hoc test with FDR adjustment
  dunn_results <- plot_data %>%
    dunn_test(y_log2 ~ group, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj")
  
  # Store statistics
  stats_results[[tp]] <- data.frame(
    Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
    N_Favorable = sum(plot_data$group == "Favorable"),
    N_Unfavorable = sum(plot_data$group == "Unfavorable"),
    N_Deceased = sum(plot_data$group == "Deceased"),
    Kruskal_statistic = kruskal_all$statistic,
    Kruskal_p = kruskal_all$p.value,
    Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p = dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Unfavorable"],
    Dunn_FavVsDec_p = dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Favorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"],
    Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p = dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "Unfavorable" & dunn_results$group2 == "Deceased"]
  )
  
  # -------------------- Summary Statistics --------------------
  
  summary_list[[tp]] <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Mean = mean(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q25 = quantile(y_raw, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q75 = quantile(y_raw, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      Min = min(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Max = max(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"))
  
  # -------------------- Create Plot --------------------
  
  # Prepare significance brackets for plotting (on raw scale)
  y_max <- max(plot_data$y_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  dunn_plot <- dunn_results %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "group") %>%
    mutate(y.position = y_max * c(1.15, 1.25, 1.35))
  
  # Create individual plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = group, y = y_raw, fill = group, color = group)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.8, outlier.shape = 3, outlier.color = "red", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      dunn_plot,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.02,
      bracket.size = 0.5,
      size = 4,
      hide.ns = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Favorable" = "#7ab8d7", 
                 "Unfavorable" = "#db95a0", 
                 "Deceased" = "#882355"),
      name = "GOS Category"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Favorable" = "#7ab8d7", 
                 "Unfavorable" = "#db95a0", 
                 "Deceased" = "#882355"),
      name = "GOS Category"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(tp, " months"),
      x = NULL,
      y = if(tp == "03") "BD-Tau (pg/mL)" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    ylim(0,2.5) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
  
  plots[[tp]] <- p
}

# ============================================
# Combine Plots
# ============================================

final_plot <- wrap_plots(plots[["03"]], plots[["06"]], plots[["12"]], plots[["24"]], 
                         ncol = 4) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Baseline BD-Tau ratio by GOS Outcome",
    # subtitle = "Statistical tests performed on log2-transformed values",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "center"
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(final_plot)

# Save plot
pdf(paste0(figures_path, "GOS_outcomes_baseline_BDTau_Ratio_Truncated.pdf"), 
    width = 11.69, height = 8.27/1.5)
print(final_plot)
dev.off()

# ============================================
# Create Combined Table: Summary Statistics + Statistical Tests
# ============================================

# Prepare statistics data
stats_table_df <- bind_rows(stats_results)

# Prepare summary data
summary_table_df <- bind_rows(summary_list) %>%
  dplyr::select(Timepoint, group, everything())

# Format summary statistics by group
summary_formatted <- summary_table_df %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_SD = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", Mean, SD),
    Median_IQR = sprintf("%.1f [%.1f, %.1f]", Median, Q25, Q75)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Timepoint, group, N, Mean_SD, Median_IQR) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = c(N, Mean_SD, Median_IQR)
  )

# Merge with statistics
combined_table <- summary_formatted %>%
  left_join(
    stats_table_df %>% dplyr::select(Timepoint, Kruskal_p, starts_with("Dunn_")),
    by = "Timepoint"
  )

# Create combined GT table
combined_gt <- combined_table %>%
  mutate(
    Kruskal_p = format.pval(Kruskal_p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
    Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p = format.pval(Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
    Dunn_FavVsDec_p = format.pval(Dunn_FavVsDec_p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
    Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p = format.pval(Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Baseline BD-Tau Ratio by GOS Outcome",
    subtitle = "Summary statistics (original scale) and statistical tests (log2-transformed, FDR-adjusted)"
  ) %>%
  
  # Column labels
  cols_label(
    Timepoint = "Follow-up",
    N_Favorable = "N",
    Mean_SD_Favorable = "Mean (SD)",
    Median_IQR_Favorable = "Median [IQR]",
    N_Unfavorable = "N",
    Mean_SD_Unfavorable = "Mean (SD)",
    Median_IQR_Unfavorable = "Median [IQR]",
    N_Deceased = "N",
    Mean_SD_Deceased = "Mean (SD)",
    Median_IQR_Deceased = "Median [IQR]",
    Kruskal_p = "Overall",
    Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p = "Fav vs Unfav",
    Dunn_FavVsDec_p = "Fav vs Dec",
    Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p = "Unfav vs Dec"
  ) %>%
  
  # Column spanners
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Favorable",
    columns = c(N_Favorable, Mean_SD_Favorable, Median_IQR_Favorable)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Unfavorable",
    columns = c(N_Unfavorable, Mean_SD_Unfavorable, Median_IQR_Unfavorable)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Deceased",
    columns = c(N_Deceased, Mean_SD_Deceased, Median_IQR_Deceased)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "P-values",
    columns = c(Kruskal_p, Dunn_FavVsUnfav_p, Dunn_FavVsDec_p, Dunn_UnfavVsDec_p)
  ) %>%
  
  # Styling
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Timepoint)
  ) %>%
  
  # Options
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 10,
    heading.title.font.size = 14,
    heading.subtitle.font.size = 10,
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  ) %>%
  
  # Footnotes
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Kruskal-Wallis (Overall) and Dunn's post-hoc tests performed on log2-transformed values",
    locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "P-values")
  )

# Print table
print(combined_gt)

# Save combined table
```

```{r TBI [Serum/CSF] Baseline Correlation, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27, eval=FALSE}
library(corrplot)

### TBI By GOS Outcome - Correlation on log2, display on raw scale

plot_list <- list()
gos_vars <- c("GOS_03", "GOS_06", "GOS_12", "GOS_24")

for (gos_var in gos_vars) {
  
  # Dynamically select and rename the GOS variable
  df_clean <- tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[gos_var]]),
           .data[[gos_var]] %in% c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Dead"),
           !is.na(mean_serum_log2_BDTau),
           !is.na(mean_csf_log2_BDTau),
           !is.na(mean_serum_BDTau),
           !is.na(mean_csf_BDTau)) %>%
    mutate(GOS_dynamic = factor(.data[[gos_var]], levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Dead")))
  
  # Correlation annotation per GOS group (on LOG2 scale)
  cor_annotations <- df_clean %>%
    group_by(GOS_dynamic) %>%
    summarise(
      rho = round(cor(mean_serum_log2_BDTau, mean_csf_log2_BDTau, 
                      method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 3),
      p_value = cor.test(mean_serum_log2_BDTau, mean_csf_log2_BDTau, 
                         method = "spearman")$p.value,
      n = n(),
      # Get max values for annotation positioning (on RAW scale)
      x_pos = max(mean_csf_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
      y_pos = max(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("ρ = ", rho, "\np = ", format.pval(p_value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), "\nn = ", n))
  
  # Extract timepoint label
  tp_label <- sub("GOS_", "", gos_var)
  
  # Plot on RAW scale
  plot_list[[gos_var]] <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = mean_csf_BDTau, y = mean_serum_BDTau)) +
    geom_point(color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.6, size = 2.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ GOS_dynamic, scales = "free") +
    geom_text(data = cor_annotations, 
              aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, 
              hjust = 1, vjust = 1, 
              size = 3.5,
              fontface = "bold") +
    labs(
      x = if(gos_var %in% c("GOS_12", "GOS_24")) "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)" else NULL,
      y = if(gos_var %in% c("GOS_03", "GOS_12")) "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)" else NULL,
      title = paste0(tp_label, " months")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# Combine plots

  (plot_list[["GOS_12"]] | plot_list[["GOS_24"]]) +

    title = "Serum vs CSF BD-Tau Correlation by GOS Outcome",
    subtitle = "Spearman correlation (ρ) calculated on log2-transformed values; raw values displayed",

    filter(!is.na(.data[[gos_var]]),
           .data[[gos_var]] %in% c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Dead"),

           !is.na(mean_csf_log2_BDTau)) %>%
    mutate(GOS_dynamic = factor(.data[[gos_var]], levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Dead")))
```

### GOS/Death outcome spaghetti visualization

```{r Serum Longitudinal GOS Analysis, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27/3, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06") 

# ============================================
# Prepare Data
# ============================================

serum_cleaned <- tbi_serum_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(serum_First_Digit_24Hr = trunc(serum_First_Digit_12Hr/2))

# Add control group
cntr_gos <- cntr %>% 
  mutate(serum_First_Digit_12Hr = 0) %>%
  mutate(GOS_03 = "Control", GOS_06 = "Control")

intersect_vars <- intersect(colnames(cntr_gos), colnames(serum_cleaned))

dd <- rbind(
  serum_cleaned %>% 
    dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)) %>%
    filter(serum_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12), 
  cntr_gos %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars))
)

# Color palette (standardized)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50",
  "Favorable" = "#7ab8d7",
  "Unfavorable" = "#db95a0", 
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

outcome_linetypes <- c(
  "Control" = "solid",
  "Favorable" = "solid",
  "Unfavorable" = "dashed",
  "Deceased" = "dotdash"
)

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop
# ============================================

serum_spaghetti_plots <- list()
all_test_results <- list()
all_pairwise_results <- list()

for (tp in timepoints) {
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
  time_col <- "serum_First_Digit_12Hr"
  y_col <- "serum_BDTau"
  log_y_col <- "serum_log2_BDTau"
  
  cat("\n=============================================\n")
  cat("Timepoint: GOS at", tp, "months\n")
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
  
  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- dd %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Control", "Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
      ),
      time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
      time_hours = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))) * 12,
      subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
    )
  
  # Mixed Effects Model (exclude Control)
  plot_data_for_model <- plot_data %>%
    filter(group != "Control") %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")))
  
  if(nrow(plot_data_for_model) >= 10 && n_distinct(plot_data_for_model$group) >= 2) {
    formula <- paste0(log_y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
    lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data_for_model)
    lmm_summary <- summary(lmm)
    coef_table <- coef(lmm_summary)
    
    interaction_unfav_p <- if("groupUnfavorable:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
      coef_table["groupUnfavorable:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    } else { NA }
    
    interaction_deceased_p <- if("groupDeceased:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
      coef_table["groupDeceased:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    } else { NA }
    
    cat("Mixed Effects Model:\n")
    cat("  Fav vs Unfav: p =", format.pval(interaction_unfav_p, digits = 4), "\n")
    cat("  Fav vs Dec: p =", format.pval(interaction_deceased_p, digits = 4), "\n\n")
  } else {
    interaction_unfav_p <- NA
    interaction_deceased_p <- NA
  }
  
  # Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons
  cat("Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons:\n\n")
  
  unique_times <- sort(unique(plot_data$time_hours))
  all_groups <- c("Control", "Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
  pairwise_comparisons <- combn(all_groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  timepoint_pairwise_results <- list()
  
  for (time_pt in unique_times) {
    time_data <- plot_data %>% filter(time_hours == time_pt)
    cat("Time:", time_pt, "hours\n")
    
    comparison_results <- map_dfr(pairwise_comparisons, function(pair) {
      data1 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[1]) %>% pull(!!sym(log_y_col))
      data2 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[2]) %>% pull(!!sym(log_y_col))
      n1 <- length(data1)
      n2 <- length(data2)
      
      if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2) {
        test_result <- try(wilcox.test(data1, data2, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
        p_val <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$p.value
        test_stat <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$statistic
      } else {
        p_val <- NA
        test_stat <- NA
      }
      
      tibble(
        time_hours = time_pt,
        group1 = pair[1],
        group2 = pair[2],
        n1 = n1,
        n2 = n2,
        test_statistic = test_stat,
        p_raw = p_val
      )
    })
    
    comparison_results <- comparison_results %>%
      mutate(
        p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
        sig_raw = case_when(
          p_raw < 0.001 ~ "***", p_raw < 0.01 ~ "**", p_raw < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
        ),
        sig_adj = case_when(
          p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**", p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
        ),
        comparison = paste0(group1, " vs ", group2),
        p_combined = paste0(format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), 
                            " / ", format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
      )
    
    timepoint_pairwise_results[[as.character(time_pt)]] <- comparison_results
    print(comparison_results %>% 
            dplyr::select(comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, p_adj, sig_adj) %>%
            mutate(p_raw = format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
                   p_adj = format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  all_pairwise_for_tp <- bind_rows(timepoint_pairwise_results)
  
  all_test_results[[tp]] <- list(
    interaction_unfav_p = interaction_unfav_p,
    interaction_deceased_p = interaction_deceased_p,
    n_favorable = sum(plot_data_for_model$group == "Favorable", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unfavorable = sum(plot_data_for_model$group == "Unfavorable", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_deceased = sum(plot_data_for_model$group == "Deceased", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  all_pairwise_results[[tp]] <- all_pairwise_for_tp
  
  # Visualization
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  sig_markers <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
    filter(group1 == "Favorable" & group2 == "Deceased") %>%
    filter(sig_adj != "ns") %>%
    dplyr::select(time_hours, sig_adj)
  
  serum_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 2, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) + 
    scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes, guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_markers,
      aes(x = time_hours, 
          y = max(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1, 
          label = sig_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("GOS at ", tp, " months"),
      x = "Hours Post-Injury",
      y = "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +  
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )
  
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
}

# ============================================
# Save Results
# ============================================

interaction_summary <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  res <- all_test_results[[tp]]
  tibble(
    GOS_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
    N_Favorable = res$n_favorable,
    N_Unfavorable = res$n_unfavorable,
    N_Deceased = res$n_deceased,
    Interaction_FavVsUnfav_p = res$interaction_unfav_p,
    Interaction_FavVsDec_p = res$interaction_deceased_p
  )
})

all_pairwise_combined <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  all_pairwise_results[[tp]] %>%
    mutate(GOS_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")) %>%
    dplyr::select(GOS_Timepoint, everything())
})

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Interaction_Tests" = interaction_summary,
    "Pairwise_Raw_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(GOS_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, sig_raw),
    "Pairwise_FDR_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(GOS_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_adj, sig_adj),
    "Pairwise_Combined" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(GOS_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_combined, sig_adj),
    "All_Results_Detailed" = all_pairwise_combined
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "serum_longitudinal_GOS_pairwise_analysis.xlsx")
)

# ============================================
# Create Publication Figure
# ============================================

# Prepare individual plots
plot_list <- list()
tp_labels <- c("03" = "3 Month", "06" = "6 Month")

for (tp in timepoints) {
  plot_list[[tp]] <- serum_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] +
    labs(title = paste0("GOS at ", tp_labels[tp])) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# Extract legend
legend <- get_legend(
  serum_spaghetti_plots[[timepoints[1]]] + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm")
    )
)

# Combine plots
combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  legend,
  plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 2, # labels = "AUTO", 
            label_size = 11, label_fontface = "bold"),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.08, 1)
)

# Save
ggsave(paste0(figures_path, "serum_bdtau_by_gos_longitudinal.pdf"), 
       combined_plot, 
       width = 11.69/2, height = 8.27/3, 
       units = "in", dpi = 600)

print(combined_plot)

cairo_pdf("~/Desktop/Projects/manuscript writing/TBI BD-tau/figure/Figure 5A-B.pdf",
          width = 8.27, height = 11.69/3, family = "Arial")
print(combined_plot)
dev.off()
```

```{r Serum Longitudinal Death Analysis, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27/3, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Analysis Loop

    filter(group != "Control") %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Survived", "Deceased")))
  
  if(nrow(plot_data_for_model) >= 10 && n_distinct(plot_data_for_model$group) >= 2) {

    interaction_deceased_p <- if("groupDeceased:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
      coef_table["groupDeceased:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    } else { NA }
    
    cat("Mixed Effects Model:\n")

  # Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons
  cat("Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons:\n\n")
  
  unique_times <- sort(unique(plot_data$time_hours))
  all_groups <- c("Control", "Survived", "Deceased")
  pairwise_comparisons <- combn(all_groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  timepoint_pairwise_results <- list()
  
  for (time_pt in unique_times) {
    time_data <- plot_data %>% filter(time_hours == time_pt)
    cat("Time:", time_pt, "hours\n")
    
    comparison_results <- map_dfr(pairwise_comparisons, function(pair) {
      data1 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[1]) %>% pull(!!sym(log_y_col))
      data2 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[2]) %>% pull(!!sym(log_y_col))
      n1 <- length(data1)
      n2 <- length(data2)
      
      if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2) {
        test_result <- try(wilcox.test(data1, data2, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
        p_val <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$p.value
        test_stat <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$statistic
      } else {
        p_val <- NA
        test_stat <- NA
      }
      
      tibble(
        time_hours = time_pt,
        group1 = pair[1],
        group2 = pair[2],
        n1 = n1,
        n2 = n2,
        test_statistic = test_stat,
        p_raw = p_val
      )
    })
    
    comparison_results <- comparison_results %>%
      mutate(
        p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
        sig_raw = case_when(
          p_raw < 0.001 ~ "***", p_raw < 0.01 ~ "**", p_raw < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
        ),
        sig_adj = case_when(
          p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**", p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
        ),
        comparison = paste0(group1, " vs ", group2),
        p_combined = paste0(format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), 
                            " / ", format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
      )
    
    timepoint_pairwise_results[[as.character(time_pt)]] <- comparison_results
    print(comparison_results %>% 
            dplyr::select(comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, p_adj, sig_adj) %>%
            mutate(p_raw = format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
                   p_adj = format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  all_pairwise_for_tp <- bind_rows(timepoint_pairwise_results)
  
  all_test_results[[tp]] <- list(
    interaction_deceased_p = interaction_deceased_p,
    n_survived = sum(plot_data_for_model$group == "Survived", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_deceased = sum(plot_data_for_model$group == "Deceased", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  all_pairwise_results[[tp]] <- all_pairwise_for_tp
  
  # Visualization
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  sig_markers <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
    filter(group1 == "Survived" & group2 == "Deceased") %>%
    filter(sig_adj != "ns") %>%
    dplyr::select(time_hours, sig_adj)
  
  serum_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 2, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) + 
    scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes, guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_markers,
      aes(x = time_hours, 
          y = max(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1, 
          label = sig_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Death at ", tp, " months"),
      x = "Hours Post-Injury",
      y = "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +  
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )
  
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
}

# ============================================
# Save Results
# ============================================

interaction_summary <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  res <- all_test_results[[tp]]
  tibble(
    Death_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
    N_Survived = res$n_survived,
    N_Deceased = res$n_deceased,
    Interaction_SurvVsDec_p = res$interaction_deceased_p
  )
})

all_pairwise_combined <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  all_pairwise_results[[tp]] %>%
    mutate(Death_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Death_Timepoint, everything())
})

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Interaction_Tests" = interaction_summary,
    "Pairwise_Raw_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Death_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, sig_raw),
    "Pairwise_FDR_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Death_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_adj, sig_adj),
    "Pairwise_Combined" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Death_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_combined, sig_adj),
    "All_Results_Detailed" = all_pairwise_combined
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "serum_longitudinal_Death_pairwise_analysis.xlsx")
)

# ============================================
# Create Publication Figure
# ============================================

plot_list <- list()
tp_labels <- c("03" = "3 months", "06" = "6 months")

for (tp in timepoints) {
  plot_list[[tp]] <- serum_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] +
    labs(title = paste0("Death at ", tp_labels[tp])) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

legend <- get_legend(
  serum_spaghetti_plots[[timepoints[1]]] + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),

    )
)

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  legend,
  plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 2, # labels = "AUTO",

)

ggsave(paste0(figures_path, "serum_bdtau_by_death_longitudinal.pdf"),
```
