```{r Serum Longitudinal Fav vs Unfav}

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")  # Only 03 and 06 months

# ============================================
# Prepare Data
# ============================================

serum_cleaned <- tbi_serum_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(serum_First_Digit_24Hr = trunc(serum_First_Digit_12Hr/2)) %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(time_since_baseline =
           serum_First_Digit_12Hr -
           min(serum_First_Digit_12Hr, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(!is.na(baseline_time))

# Add control group
cntr_death <- cntr %>%
  mutate(time_since_baseline = 0) %>%
  mutate(GOS_03 = "Control", GOS_06 = "Control")

intersect_vars <- intersect(colnames(cntr_death), colnames(serum_cleaned))

dd <- rbind(
  serum_cleaned %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)) %>%
    filter(time_since_baseline <= 12),
  cntr_death %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars))
)

# Color palette (standardized for GOS outcome)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50",
  "Favorable" = "#3594cc",
  "Unfavorable" = "#ea801c"
)

outcome_linetypes <- c(
  "Control" = "solid",
  "Favorable" = "solid",
  "Unfavorable" = "dotdash"
)

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop
# ============================================

serum_spaghetti_plots <- list()
all_test_results <- list()
all_pairwise_results <- list()

time_col  <- "time_since_baseline"
y_col     <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
log_y_col <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"

# Fail early if required columns are missing
stopifnot(all(c("Subject.ID", time_col, y_col, log_y_col) %in% names(dd)))

for (tp in timepoints) {
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
  stopifnot(outcome_col %in% names(dd))
  
  cat("\n=============================================\n")
  cat("Timepoint: GOS at", tp, "months\n")
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
  
  # --------------------------------
  # Prepare data (no tidy-eval)
  # --------------------------------
  outcome_vec <- dd[[outcome_col]]
  time_vec    <- dd[[time_col]]
  y_vec       <- dd[[y_col]]
  log_y_vec   <- dd[[log_y_col]]
  
  plot_data <- data.frame(
    Subject.ID = dd$Subject.ID,
    group_raw  = dplyr::recode(outcome_vec, "Dead" = "Deceased"),
    time       = as.numeric(time_vec),
    time_hours = as.numeric(time_vec) * 12,
    y_raw      = y_vec,
    y_log2     = log_y_vec,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(group_raw),
      group_raw %in% c("Control", "Favorable", "Unfavorable"),
      !is.na(time),
      !is.na(y_raw),
      !is.na(y_log2)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      group   = factor(group_raw, levels = c("Control", "Favorable", "Unfavorable")),
      subject = factor(Subject.ID)
    )
  
  # --------------------------------
  # Mixed Effects Model (exclude Control)
  # Outcome: y_log2; Fixed: group*time; Random: subject intercept
  # --------------------------------
  plot_data_for_model <- plot_data %>%
    filter(group != "Control") %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable")))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data_for_model) >= 10 && dplyr::n_distinct(plot_data_for_model$group) >= 2) {
    
    lmm <- lmerTest::lmer(
      y_log2 ~ group * time + (1 | subject),
      data = plot_data_for_model
    )
    
    coef_table <- summary(lmm)$coefficients
    coef_table
    
    interaction_Unfavorable_p <- if ("groupUnfavorable:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
      coef_table["groupUnfavorable:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
    
    cat("Mixed Effects Model (log2 BD-Tau; Control excluded):\n")
    cat("  Group(Unfavorable) x time interaction p =",
        format.pval(interaction_Unfavorable_p, digits = 4), "\n\n")
    
  } else {
    interaction_Unfavorable_p <- NA_real_
  }
  
  # --------------------------------
  # Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons (Wilcoxon on log2)
  # --------------------------------
  cat("Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons (Wilcoxon on log2):\n\n")
  
  unique_times <- sort(unique(plot_data$time_hours))
  all_groups <- c("Control", "Favorable", "Unfavorable")
  pairwise_comparisons <- combn(all_groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  timepoint_pairwise_results <- vector("list", length(unique_times))
  names(timepoint_pairwise_results) <- as.character(unique_times)
  
  for (time_pt in unique_times) {
    
    time_data <- plot_data %>% filter(time_hours == time_pt)
    
    comparison_results <- purrr::map_dfr(pairwise_comparisons, function(pair) {
      
      data1 <- time_data$y_log2[time_data$group == pair[1]]
      data2 <- time_data$y_log2[time_data$group == pair[2]]
      
      n1 <- length(data1)
      n2 <- length(data2)
      
      if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2) {
        test_result <- try(wilcox.test(data1, data2, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
        p_val <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA_real_ else test_result$p.value
        test_stat <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA_real_ else unname(test_result$statistic)
      } else {
        p_val <- NA_real_
        test_stat <- NA_real_
      }
      
      tibble(
        time_hours = time_pt,
        group1 = pair[1],
        group2 = pair[2],
        n1 = n1,
        n2 = n2,
        test_statistic = test_stat,
        p_raw = p_val
      )
    })
    
    comparison_results <- comparison_results %>%
      mutate(
        comparison = paste0(group1, " vs ", group2)
      )
    
    timepoint_pairwise_results[[as.character(time_pt)]] <- comparison_results
  }
  
  all_pairwise_for_tp <- bind_rows(timepoint_pairwise_results) %>%
     group_by(group1, group2) %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
           
        # p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
        sig_adj = case_when(
          p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
          p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ "ns"
        )) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  all_test_results[[tp]] <- list(
    interaction_Unfavorable_p = interaction_Unfavorable_p,
    n_Favorable = sum(plot_data_for_model$group == "Favorable", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_Unfavorable = sum(plot_data_for_model$group == "Unfavorable", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  all_pairwise_results[[tp]] <- all_pairwise_for_tp
  
  # --------------------------------
  # Visualization (mean ± SE on raw scale)
  # --------------------------------
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_val = sd(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  sig_markers <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
    filter(group1 == "Favorable", group2 == "Unfavorable", sig_adj != "ns") %>%
    select(time_hours, sig_adj)
  
  y_star <- max(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10
  
  serum_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] <-
    ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val),
                  width = 2, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes, guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_markers,
      aes(x = time_hours, y = y_star, label = sig_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(tp, " months"),
      x = "Hours Post-Injury",
      y = "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )
  
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
}

# ============================================
# Save Results
# ============================================

interaction_summary <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  res <- all_test_results[[tp]]
  tibble(
    GOS_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
    N_Favorable = res$n_Favorable,
    N_Unfavorable = res$n_Unfavorable,
    Interaction_FavVsUnfav_p = res$interaction_Unfavorable_p
  )
})

all_pairwise_combined <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  all_pairwise_results[[tp]] %>%
    mutate(GOS_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")) %>%
    select(GOS_Timepoint, everything())
})

writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Interaction_Tests" = interaction_summary,
    "Pairwise_Raw_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      select(GOS_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_raw),
    "Pairwise_FDR_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      select(GOS_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_adj, sig_adj),
    "All_Results_Detailed" = all_pairwise_combined
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "serum_longitudinal_GOS_pairwise_analysis.xlsx")
)

# ============================================
# Create Publication Figure
# ============================================

plot_list <- list()
tp_labels <- c("03" = "3 months", "06" = "6 months")

for (tp in timepoints) {
  plot_list[[tp]] <- serum_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] +
    labs(title = tp_labels[tp]) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

legend <- get_legend(
  serum_spaghetti_plots[[timepoints[1]]] +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm")
    )
)

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  legend,
  plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 2, label_size = 11, label_fontface = "bold"),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.08, 1)
)

ggsave(
  paste0(figures_path, "serum_bdtau_by_GOS_fav_vs_unfav_longitudinal.pdf"),
  combined_plot,
  width = 11.69/2, height = 8.27/3,
  units = "in", dpi = 600
)

print(combined_plot)

cairo_pdf("~/Desktop/Projects/manuscript writing/TBI BD-tau/figure/Supplementary Figure 1 GH.pdf",
          width = 8.27*1.5, height = 11.69/4, family = "Arial")
print(combined_plot)
dev.off()
```

```{r Serum Longitudinal Rate of Change Analysis, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27/3, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")  # Only 03 and 06 months

# ============================================
# Prepare Data
# ============================================

serum_rate_cleaned <- tbi_serum_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID, day_idx) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = serum_Raw_Day_Value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

dd <- serum_rate_cleaned %>% filter(day_idx <= 6)

# Color palette (standardized)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Favorable" = "#7ab8d7",
  "Unfavorable" = "#db95a0", 
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

outcome_linetypes <- c(
  "Favorable" = "solid",
  "Unfavorable" = "dashed",
  "Deceased" = "dotdash"
)

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop
# ============================================

serum_spaghetti_plots <- list()
all_test_results <- list()
all_pairwise_results <- list()

for (tp in timepoints) {
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
  time_col <- "day_idx"
  y_col <- "serum_rate_vs_baseline"
  
  cat("\n=============================================\n")
  cat("Timepoint: GOS at", tp, "months (Rate of Change)\n")
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
  
  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- dd %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
      ),
      time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
      subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
    )
  
  # Mixed Effects Model
  if(nrow(plot_data) >= 10 && n_distinct(plot_data$group) >= 2) {
    formula <- paste0(y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
    lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data)
    lmm_summary <- summary(lmm)
    coef_table <- coef(lmm_summary)
    
    interaction_unfav_p <- if("groupUnfavorable:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
      coef_table["groupUnfavorable:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    } else { NA }
    
    interaction_deceased_p <- if("groupDeceased:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
      coef_table["groupDeceased:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    } else { NA }
    
    cat("Mixed Effects Model:\n")
    cat("  Fav vs Unfav: p =", format.pval(interaction_unfav_p, digits = 4), "\n")
    cat("  Fav vs Dec: p =", format.pval(interaction_deceased_p, digits = 4), "\n\n")
  } else {
    interaction_unfav_p <- NA
    interaction_deceased_p <- NA
  }
  
  # Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons
  cat("Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons:\n\n")
  
  unique_times <- sort(unique(plot_data$time))
  all_groups <- c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
  pairwise_comparisons <- combn(all_groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  timepoint_pairwise_results <- list()
  
  for (time_pt in unique_times) {
    time_data <- plot_data %>% filter(time == time_pt)
    cat("Day:", time_pt, "\n")
    
    comparison_results <- map_dfr(pairwise_comparisons, function(pair) {
      data1 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[1]) %>% pull(!!sym(y_col))
      data2 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[2]) %>% pull(!!sym(y_col))
      n1 <- length(data1)
      n2 <- length(data2)
      
      if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2) {
        test_result <- try(wilcox.test(data1, data2, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
        p_val <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$p.value
        test_stat <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$statistic
      } else {
        p_val <- NA
        test_stat <- NA
      }
      
      tibble(
        time_days = time_pt,
        group1 = pair[1],
        group2 = pair[2],
        n1 = n1,
        n2 = n2,
        test_statistic = test_stat,
        p_raw = p_val
      )
    })
    
    comparison_results <- comparison_results %>%
      mutate(
        p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
        sig_raw = case_when(
          p_raw < 0.001 ~ "***", p_raw < 0.01 ~ "**", p_raw < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
        ),
        sig_adj = case_when(
          p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**", p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
        ),
        comparison = paste0(group1, " vs ", group2),
        p_combined = paste0(format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), 
                            " / ", format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
      )
    
    timepoint_pairwise_results[[as.character(time_pt)]] <- comparison_results
    print(comparison_results %>% 
            dplyr::select(comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, p_adj, sig_adj) %>%
            mutate(p_raw = format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
                   p_adj = format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  all_pairwise_for_tp <- bind_rows(timepoint_pairwise_results)
  
  all_test_results[[tp]] <- list(
    interaction_unfav_p = interaction_unfav_p,
    interaction_deceased_p = interaction_deceased_p,
    n_favorable = sum(plot_data$group == "Favorable", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unfavorable = sum(plot_data$group == "Unfavorable", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_deceased = sum(plot_data$group == "Deceased", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  all_pairwise_results[[tp]] <- all_pairwise_for_tp
  
  # Visualization
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  sig_markers <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
    filter(group1 == "Favorable" & group2 == "Deceased") %>%
    filter(sig_adj != "ns") %>%
    dplyr::select(time_days, sig_adj) %>%
    rename(time = time_days)
  
  serum_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 0.12) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) + 
    scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes, guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_markers,
      aes(x = time, 
          y = max(abs(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val), 
                  abs(summary_df$mean_val - summary_df$se_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15, 
          label = sig_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("GOS at ", tp, " months"),
      x = "Day Post-Injury",
      y = "Rate of Change (per day)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(summary_df$time, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)) +  
    ylim(NA, 100) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )
  
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
}

# ============================================
# Save Results
# ============================================

interaction_summary <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  res <- all_test_results[[tp]]
  tibble(
    GOS_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
    N_Favorable = res$n_favorable,
    N_Unfavorable = res$n_unfavorable,
    N_Deceased = res$n_deceased,
    Interaction_FavVsUnfav_p = res$interaction_unfav_p,
    Interaction_FavVsDec_p = res$interaction_deceased_p
  )
})

all_pairwise_combined <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  all_pairwise_results[[tp]] %>%
    mutate(GOS_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")) %>%
    dplyr::select(GOS_Timepoint, everything())
})

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Interaction_Tests" = interaction_summary,
    "Pairwise_Raw_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(GOS_Timepoint, time_days, comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, sig_raw),
    "Pairwise_FDR_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(GOS_Timepoint, time_days, comparison, n1, n2, p_adj, sig_adj),
    "Pairwise_Combined" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(GOS_Timepoint, time_days, comparison, n1, n2, p_combined, sig_adj),
    "All_Results_Detailed" = all_pairwise_combined
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "serum_longitudinal_RateOfChange_pairwise_analysis.xlsx")
)

# ============================================

# ============================================
```

```{r [Serum] Integrated Cohorts delta change Longitudinal Visualization on GOS, eval=FALSE, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
serum_rate_cleaned <- tbi_serum_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID, day_idx) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = serum_Raw_Day_Value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

### Draw longitudinal spaghetti plots

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

dd <- serum_rate_cleaned %>% 
              filter(day_idx <= 6)

hist(dd$serum_rate_per_day, breaks = 100)
# qqnorm(dd$serum_rate_per_day)
# qqline(dd$serum_rate_per_day)

serum_spaghetti_plots <- list()

for (tp in timepoints){
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
  time_col <- "day_idx"
  
  y_col <- "serum_rate_per_day"
  # No log transformation needed for rates that can be negative
  
  group_counts <- dd %>%
    dplyr::select(Subject.ID, !!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    count(!!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(!!sym(outcome_col), " (N=", n, ")"))
  
  custom_labels <- setNames(group_counts$label, group_counts[[outcome_col]])
  
  labeller_fn <- function(values) {
    unname(custom_labels[as.character(values)])
  }
  
  # subset data
  plot_data <- dd %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Control","Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
      ),
      time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
      subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
    )
  
  # fit the model on original scale, excluding control
  plot_data_for_model <- plot_data %>%
    filter(group != "Control")
  
  formula <- paste0(y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
  lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data_for_model)
  anova_result <- anova(lmm)
  p_val <- anova_result["group", "Pr(>F)"]
  p_text <- paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3))
  print(p_text)
  
  # calculate per-time point p-values on original scale
  tp_pvals <- plot_data_for_model %>%
    group_by(time) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      model <- try(lm(as.formula(paste0(y_col, " ~ group")), data = .x), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
        tibble(p = NA)
      } else {
        tibble(p = anova(model)[["Pr(>F)"]][1])
      }
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
      significance_adj = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  tp_pvals %>%
    dplyr::select(time, p, p_adj, significance_adj) %>%
    print(n = Inf)
  
  # summarize mean ± SE on original scale
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # plot on original scale
  serum_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +  # Reference line
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 0.15) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Control" = "grey50",
      "Favorable" = "forestgreen",
      "Unfavorable" = "darkorange", 
      "Deceased" = "firebrick"),
      name = NULL) + 
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
      "Control" = "solid",
      "Favorable"   = "solid",
      "Unfavorable" = "dashed",
      "Deceased"    = "dotdash"
    ), guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = tp_pvals,
      aes(x = time, 
          y = max(abs(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val), 
                  abs(summary_df$mean_val - summary_df$se_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15, 
          label = significance_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Serum BD-Tau Rate of Change",
      x = "Day Post-Injury",
      y = "Rate of Change (per day)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(summary_df$time, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)) +  
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  
}
```

```{r Serum Longitudinal Rate of Change Death Analysis, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27/3, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")  # Only 03 and 06 months

# ============================================
# Prepare Data
# ============================================

serum_rate_cleaned <- tbi_serum_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID, day_idx) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = serum_Raw_Day_Value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

dd <- serum_rate_cleaned %>% filter(day_idx <= 6)

# Color palette (standardized for Death outcome)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Survived" = "#7ab8d7",
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

outcome_linetypes <- c(
  "Survived" = "solid",
  "Deceased" = "dotdash"
)

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop
# ============================================

serum_spaghetti_plots <- list()
all_test_results <- list()
all_pairwise_results <- list()

for (tp in timepoints) {
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("Death_", tp)
  time_col <- "day_idx"
  y_col <- "serum_rate_vs_baseline"  # or "serum_rate_per_day"
  
  cat("\n=============================================\n")
  cat("Timepoint: Death at", tp, "months (Rate of Change)\n")
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
  
  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- dd %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Survived", "Deceased")
      ),
      time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
      subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
    )
  
  # Mixed Effects Model
  if(nrow(plot_data) >= 10 && n_distinct(plot_data$group) >= 2) {
    formula <- paste0(y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
    lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data)
    lmm_summary <- summary(lmm)
    coef_table <- coef(lmm_summary)
    
    interaction_deceased_p <- if("groupDeceased:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
      coef_table["groupDeceased:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    } else { NA }
    
    cat("Mixed Effects Model:\n")
    cat("  Survived vs Dec: p =", format.pval(interaction_deceased_p, digits = 4), "\n\n")
  } else {
    interaction_deceased_p <- NA
  }
  
  # Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons
  cat("Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons:\n\n")
  
  unique_times <- sort(unique(plot_data$time))
  all_groups <- c("Survived", "Deceased")
  pairwise_comparisons <- list(c("Survived", "Deceased"))
  timepoint_pairwise_results <- list()
  
  for (time_pt in unique_times) {
    time_data <- plot_data %>% filter(time == time_pt)
    cat("Day:", time_pt, "\n")
    
    comparison_results <- map_dfr(pairwise_comparisons, function(pair) {
      data1 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[1]) %>% pull(!!sym(y_col))
      data2 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[2]) %>% pull(!!sym(y_col))
      n1 <- length(data1)
      n2 <- length(data2)
      
      if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2) {
        test_result <- try(wilcox.test(data1, data2, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
        p_val <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$p.value
        test_stat <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$statistic
      } else {
        p_val <- NA
        test_stat <- NA
      }
      
      tibble(
        time_days = time_pt,
        group1 = pair[1],
        group2 = pair[2],
        n1 = n1,
        n2 = n2,
        test_statistic = test_stat,
        p_raw = p_val
      )
    })
    
    comparison_results <- comparison_results %>%
      mutate(
        p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
        sig_raw = case_when(
          p_raw < 0.001 ~ "***", p_raw < 0.01 ~ "**", p_raw < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
        ),
        sig_adj = case_when(
          p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**", p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
        ),
        comparison = paste0(group1, " vs ", group2),
        p_combined = paste0(format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), 
                            " / ", format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
      )
    
    timepoint_pairwise_results[[as.character(time_pt)]] <- comparison_results
    print(comparison_results %>% 
            dplyr::select(comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, p_adj, sig_adj) %>%
            mutate(p_raw = format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
                   p_adj = format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  all_pairwise_for_tp <- bind_rows(timepoint_pairwise_results)
  
  all_test_results[[tp]] <- list(
    interaction_deceased_p = interaction_deceased_p,
    n_survived = sum(plot_data$group == "Survived", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_deceased = sum(plot_data$group == "Deceased", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  all_pairwise_results[[tp]] <- all_pairwise_for_tp
  
  # Visualization
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  sig_markers <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
    filter(group1 == "Survived" & group2 == "Deceased") %>%
    filter(sig_adj != "ns") %>%
    dplyr::select(time_days, sig_adj) %>%
    rename(time = time_days)
  
  serum_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 0.12) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) + 
    scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes, guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_markers,
      aes(x = time, 
          y = max(abs(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val), 
                  abs(summary_df$mean_val - summary_df$se_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15, 
          label = sig_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Death at ", tp, " months"),
      x = "Day Post-Injury",
      y = "Rate of Change (per day)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(summary_df$time, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)) +  
    ylim(NA, 100) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )
  
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
}

# ============================================
# Save Results
# ============================================

interaction_summary <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  res <- all_test_results[[tp]]
  tibble(
    Death_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
    N_Survived = res$n_survived,
    N_Deceased = res$n_deceased,
    Interaction_SurvVsDec_p = res$interaction_deceased_p
  )
})

all_pairwise_combined <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  all_pairwise_results[[tp]] %>%
    mutate(Death_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Death_Timepoint, everything())
})

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Interaction_Tests" = interaction_summary,
    "Pairwise_Raw_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Death_Timepoint, time_days, comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, sig_raw),
    "Pairwise_FDR_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Death_Timepoint, time_days, comparison, n1, n2, p_adj, sig_adj),
    "Pairwise_Combined" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Death_Timepoint, time_days, comparison, n1, n2, p_combined, sig_adj),
    "All_Results_Detailed" = all_pairwise_combined
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "serum_longitudinal_RateOfChange_Death_pairwise_analysis.xlsx")
)

# ============================================
# Create Publication Figure
# ============================================

plot_list <- list()
tp_labels <- c("03" = "3 months", "06" = "6 months")

for (tp in timepoints) {
  plot_list[[tp]] <- serum_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] +
    labs(title = paste0("Death at ", tp_labels[tp])) +

}

legend <- get_legend(

ggsave(paste0(figures_path, "serum_bdtau_rate_of_change_death_longitudinal.pdf"), 
       combined_plot,

cat("Files saved:\n")
```

```{r [Serum] Integrated Cohorts delta change on baseline Longitudinal Visualization on Death, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

dd <- serum_rate_cleaned %>% 
  filter(day_idx <= 6)

serum_spaghetti_plots <- list()

for (tp in timepoints){
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("Death_", tp)
  time_col <- "day_idx"
  
  y_col <- "serum_rate_vs_baseline"
  # No log transformation needed for rates that can be negative
  
  group_counts <- dd %>%
    dplyr::select(Subject.ID, !!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    count(!!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(!!sym(outcome_col), " (N=", n, ")"))
  
  custom_labels <- setNames(group_counts$label, group_counts[[outcome_col]])
  
  labeller_fn <- function(values) {
    unname(custom_labels[as.character(values)])
  }
  
  # subset data
  plot_data <- dd %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Control","Survived", "Deceased")
      ),
      time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
      subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
    )
  
  # fit the model on original scale, excluding control
  plot_data_for_model <- plot_data %>%
    filter(group != "Control")
  
  formula <- paste0(y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
  lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data_for_model)
  anova_result <- anova(lmm)
  p_val <- anova_result["group", "Pr(>F)"]
  p_text <- paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3))
  print(p_text)
  
  # calculate per-time point p-values on original scale
  tp_pvals <- plot_data_for_model %>%
    group_by(time) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      model <- try(lm(as.formula(paste0(y_col, " ~ group")), data = .x), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
        tibble(p = NA)
      } else {
        tibble(p = anova(model)[["Pr(>F)"]][1])
      }
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
      significance_adj = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  tp_pvals %>%
    dplyr::select(time, p, p_adj, significance_adj) %>%
    print(n = Inf)
  
  # summarize mean ± SE on original scale
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # plot on original scale
  serum_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +  # Reference line
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 0.15) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Control" = "grey50",
      "Survived" = "navy",
      "Deceased" = "firebrick"),
      name = NULL) + 
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
      "Control" = "solid",
      "Survived" = "dashed",
      "Deceased" = "dotdash"
    ), guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = tp_pvals,
      aes(x = time, 
          y = max(abs(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val), 
                  abs(summary_df$mean_val - summary_df$se_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15, 
          label = significance_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Serum BD-Tau Rate of Change",
      x = "Day Post-Injury",
      y = "Rate of Change (per day)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(summary_df$time, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)) +  
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top") +
    ylim(NA, 100)
  
}
```

```{r Matched Cohort Serum and CSF Longitudinal GOS, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27*2/3, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")  # Only 03 and 06 months
biofluids <- c("Serum", "CSF")

# Color palette (standardized)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Favorable" = "#7ab8d7",
  "Unfavorable" = "#db95a0", 
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

outcome_linetypes <- c(
  "Favorable" = "solid",
  "Unfavorable" = "dashed",
  "Deceased" = "dotdash"
)

# ============================================
# Prepare Data
# ============================================

match_cleaned <- tbi_match_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value = 2*mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value,
    mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value),
    mean_csf_Raw_12Hr_Value = 2*mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value,
    mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(mean_csf_Raw_12Hr_Value)
  )

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop - Both Biofluids
# ============================================

all_plots <- list()
all_test_results <- list()
all_pairwise_results <- list()

for (biofluid in biofluids) {
  for (tp in timepoints) {
    
    # Select appropriate columns based on biofluid
    if (biofluid == "Serum") {
      time_col <- "mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr"
      y_col <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
      log_y_col <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
      dd <- match_cleaned %>% filter(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12)
    } else {
      time_col <- "mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr"
      y_col <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
      log_y_col <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
      dd <- match_cleaned %>% filter(mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12)
    }
    
    outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
    
    cat("\n=============================================\n")
    cat(biofluid, "- GOS at", tp, "months\n")
    cat("=============================================\n\n")
    
    # Prepare data
    plot_data <- dd %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
      mutate(
        group = factor(
          recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
          levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
        ),
        time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
        time_hours = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))) * 12,
        subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
      )
    
    # Mixed Effects Model
    if(nrow(plot_data) >= 10 && n_distinct(plot_data$group) >= 2) {
      formula <- paste0(log_y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
      lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data)
      lmm_summary <- summary(lmm)
      coef_table <- coef(lmm_summary)
      
      interaction_unfav_p <- if("groupUnfavorable:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
        coef_table["groupUnfavorable:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
      } else { NA }
      
      interaction_deceased_p <- if("groupDeceased:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
        coef_table["groupDeceased:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
      } else { NA }
      
      cat("Mixed Effects Model:\n")
      cat("  Fav vs Unfav: p =", format.pval(interaction_unfav_p, digits = 4), "\n")
      cat("  Fav vs Dec: p =", format.pval(interaction_deceased_p, digits = 4), "\n\n")
    } else {
      interaction_unfav_p <- NA
      interaction_deceased_p <- NA
    }
    
    # Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons
    cat("Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons:\n\n")
    
    unique_times <- sort(unique(plot_data$time_hours))
    all_groups <- c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
    pairwise_comparisons <- combn(all_groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)
    timepoint_pairwise_results <- list()
    
    for (time_pt in unique_times) {
      time_data <- plot_data %>% filter(time_hours == time_pt)
      cat("Time:", time_pt, "hours\n")
      
      comparison_results <- map_dfr(pairwise_comparisons, function(pair) {
        data1 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[1]) %>% pull(!!sym(log_y_col))
        data2 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[2]) %>% pull(!!sym(log_y_col))
        n1 <- length(data1)
        n2 <- length(data2)
        
        if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2) {
          test_result <- try(wilcox.test(data1, data2, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
          p_val <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$p.value
          test_stat <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$statistic
        } else {
          p_val <- NA
          test_stat <- NA
        }
        
        tibble(
          time_hours = time_pt,
          group1 = pair[1],
          group2 = pair[2],
          n1 = n1,
          n2 = n2,
          test_statistic = test_stat,
          p_raw = p_val
        )
      })
      
      comparison_results <- comparison_results %>%
        mutate(
          p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
          sig_raw = case_when(
            p_raw < 0.001 ~ "***", p_raw < 0.01 ~ "**", p_raw < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
          ),
          sig_adj = case_when(
            p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**", p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
          ),
          comparison = paste0(group1, " vs ", group2),
          p_combined = paste0(format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), 
                              " / ", format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
        )
      
      timepoint_pairwise_results[[as.character(time_pt)]] <- comparison_results
      print(comparison_results %>% 
              dplyr::select(comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, p_adj, sig_adj) %>%
              mutate(p_raw = format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
                     p_adj = format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))
      cat("\n")
    }
    
    all_pairwise_for_tp <- bind_rows(timepoint_pairwise_results)
    
    # Store results
    result_key <- paste0(biofluid, "_", tp)
    all_test_results[[result_key]] <- list(
      biofluid = biofluid,
      timepoint = tp,
      interaction_unfav_p = interaction_unfav_p,
      interaction_deceased_p = interaction_deceased_p,
      n_favorable = sum(plot_data$group == "Favorable", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_unfavorable = sum(plot_data$group == "Unfavorable", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_deceased = sum(plot_data$group == "Deceased", na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    all_pairwise_results[[result_key]] <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
      mutate(
        Biofluid = biofluid,
        GOS_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")
      )
    
    # Visualization
    summary_df <- plot_data %>%
      group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
        sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
        se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    sig_markers <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
      filter(group1 == "Favorable" & group2 == "Deceased") %>%
      filter(sig_adj != "ns") %>%
      dplyr::select(time_hours, sig_adj)
    
    p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
      geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 2, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_point(size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) + 
      scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes, guide = "none") +
      geom_text(
        data = sig_markers,
        aes(x = time_hours, 
            y = max(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1, 
            label = sig_adj),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(biofluid, " - GOS at ", tp, " months"),
        x = "Hours Post-Injury",
        y = paste0(biofluid, " BD-Tau (pg/mL)")
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +  
      theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
      )
    
    all_plots[[result_key]] <- p
    
    cat("=============================================\n\n")
  }
}

# ============================================
# Save Results
# ============================================

# Combine results for both biofluids
interaction_summary <- map_dfr(names(all_test_results), function(key) {
  res <- all_test_results[[key]]
  tibble(
    Biofluid = res$biofluid,
    GOS_Timepoint = paste0(res$timepoint, " months"),
    N_Favorable = res$n_favorable,
    N_Unfavorable = res$n_unfavorable,
    N_Deceased = res$n_deceased,
    Interaction_FavVsUnfav_p = res$interaction_unfav_p,
    Interaction_FavVsDec_p = res$interaction_deceased_p
  )
})

all_pairwise_combined <- bind_rows(all_pairwise_results)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Interaction_Tests" = interaction_summary,
    "Pairwise_Raw_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Biofluid, GOS_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, sig_raw),
    "Pairwise_FDR_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Biofluid, GOS_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_adj, sig_adj),
    "Pairwise_Combined" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Biofluid, GOS_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_combined, sig_adj),
    "All_Results_Detailed" = all_pairwise_combined
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "matched_serum_csf_longitudinal_GOS_pairwise_analysis.xlsx")
)

# ============================================
# Create Publication Figure (4 panels)
# ============================================

tp_labels <- c("03" = "3 months", "06" = "6 months")

# Prepare individual plots without legend
plot_list <- list()
counter <- 1

for (biofluid in biofluids) {
  for (tp in timepoints) {

    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

# Extract legend
legend <- get_legend(
  all_plots[[1]] + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm")
    )
)

# Combine all 4 plots in 2x2 grid
combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  legend,
  plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 2, # labels = "AUTO", 
            label_size = 11, label_fontface = "bold"),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.05, 1)
)

ggsave(paste0(figures_path, "matched_serum_csf_bdtau_by_gos_longitudinal.pdf"), 
       combined_plot, 
       width = 11.69/2, height = 8.27*2/3, 
       units = "in", dpi = 600)

print(combined_plot)

cairo_pdf("~/Desktop/Projects/manuscript writing/TBI BD-tau/figure/Extended Data Figure [Matched Serum-CSF by GOS Longitudinal].pdf",
          width = 8.27, height = 11.69/3, family = "Arial")
print(combined_plot)
```

```{r Matched Cohort Serum and CSF Longitudinal Fav vs Unfav}

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")
biofluids  <- c("Serum", "CSF")

# GOS color + linetype
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Favorable"   = "#3594cc",
  "Unfavorable" = "#ea801c"
)

outcome_linetypes <- c(
  "Favorable"   = "solid",
  "Unfavorable" = "dotdash"
)

# ============================================
# Prepare matched longitudinal data
# ============================================

match_cleaned <- tbi_match_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value = 2 * mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value,
    mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value),
    mean_csf_Raw_12Hr_Value = 2 * mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value,
    mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(mean_csf_Raw_12Hr_Value)
  )

# ============================================
# Containers
# ============================================

all_plots            <- list()
all_test_results     <- list()
all_pairwise_results <- list()

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop
# ============================================

for (biofluid in biofluids) {
  for (tp in timepoints) {
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Column selection
    # -----------------------------
    if (biofluid == "Serum") {
      time_col  <- "mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr"
      y_col     <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
      log_y_col <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
      dd <- match_cleaned %>% filter(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12)
    } else {
      time_col  <- "mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr"
      y_col     <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
      log_y_col <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
      dd <- match_cleaned %>% filter(mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12)
    }
    
    outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
    
    cat("\n=============================================\n")
    cat(biofluid, "- GOS at", tp, "months\n")
    cat("=============================================\n\n")
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Build analysis dataframe (no tidy-eval)
    # -----------------------------
    plot_data <- data.frame(
      Subject.ID = dd$Subject.ID,
      group_raw  = dd[[outcome_col]],
      time       = dd[[time_col]],
      time_hours = dd[[time_col]] * 12,
      y_raw      = dd[[y_col]],
      y_log2     = dd[[log_y_col]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        group_raw = recode(group_raw, "Dead" = "Unfavorable"),
        group = factor(group_raw, levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable")),
        subject = factor(Subject.ID)
      ) %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(group),
        !is.na(time),
        !is.na(y_raw),
        !is.na(y_log2)
      )
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Mixed-effects model (log2)
    # -----------------------------
    if (nrow(plot_data) >= 10 && n_distinct(plot_data$group) == 2) {
      
      lmm <- lmerTest::lmer(
        y_log2 ~ group * time + (1 | subject),
        data = plot_data
      )
      
      coef_table <- summary(lmm)$coefficients
      
      interaction_p <- coef_table["groupUnfavorable:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
      
      cat("Mixed-effects model:\n")
      cat("  group(Unfavorable) × time p =",
          format.pval(interaction_p, digits = 4), "\n\n")
      
    } else {
      interaction_p <- NA_real_
    }
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Per-timepoint Wilcoxon tests
    # -----------------------------
    unique_times <- sort(unique(plot_data$time_hours))
    
    pairwise_results <- map_dfr(unique_times, function(tpt) {
      
      td <- plot_data %>% filter(time_hours == tpt)
      
      d1 <- td %>% filter(group == "Favorable")   %>% pull(y_log2)
      d2 <- td %>% filter(group == "Unfavorable") %>% pull(y_log2)
      
      if (length(d1) >= 2 && length(d2) >= 2) {
        wt <- wilcox.test(d1, d2, exact = FALSE)
        tibble(
          time_hours = tpt,
          group1 = "Favorable",
          group2 = "Unfavorable",
          n1 = length(d1),
          n2 = length(d2),
          p_raw = wt$p.value
        )
      } else {
        tibble(
          time_hours = tpt,
          group1 = "Favorable",
          group2 = "Unfavorable",
          n1 = length(d1),
          n2 = length(d2),
          p_raw = NA_real_
        )
      }
    }) %>%
      mutate(
        p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
        sig_adj = case_when(
          p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
          p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ "ns"
        ),
        Biofluid = biofluid,
        GOS_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")
      )
    
    key <- paste0(biofluid, "_", tp)
    all_pairwise_results[[key]] <- pairwise_results
    
    all_test_results[[key]] <- tibble(
      Biofluid = biofluid,
      GOS_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months"),
      N_Favorable = sum(plot_data$group == "Favorable"),
      N_Unfavorable = sum(plot_data$group == "Unfavorable"),
      Interaction_FavVsUnfav_p = interaction_p
    )
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Plot (mean ± SE on raw scale)
    # -----------------------------
    summary_df <- plot_data %>%
      group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        mean_val = mean(y_raw),
        se_val = sd(y_raw) / sqrt(n()),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    sig_markers <- pairwise_results %>%
      filter(sig_adj != "ns") %>%
      select(time_hours, sig_adj)
    
    y_star <- max(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val) * 1.1
    
    all_plots[[key]] <-
      ggplot(summary_df, aes(time_hours, mean_val, color = group)) +
      geom_line(aes(linetype = group), linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val),
                    width = 2, linewidth = 0.6) +
      geom_point(size = 2.5) +
      geom_text(
        data = sig_markers,
        aes(x = time_hours, y = y_star, label = sig_adj),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 5, fontface = "bold"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(biofluid, " – GOS at ", tp, " months"),
        x = "Hours Post-Injury",
        y = paste0(biofluid, " BD-Tau (pg/mL)")
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, 24)) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
      theme(legend.position = "top")
  }
}

# ============================================
# Export tables
# ============================================

interaction_summary <- bind_rows(all_test_results)
pairwise_summary    <- bind_rows(all_pairwise_results)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Interaction_Tests" = interaction_summary,
    "Pairwise_Tests"    = pairwise_summary
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "matched_serum_csf_longitudinal_GOS_analysis.xlsx")
)

# ============================================
# Final 4-panel figure
# ============================================

final_plot <- plot_grid(
  get_legend(all_plots[[1]]),
  plot_grid(plotlist = all_plots, ncol = 2),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.08, 1)
)

ggsave(
  paste0(figures_path, "matched_serum_csf_bdtau_by_GOS_longitudinal.pdf"),
  final_plot,
  width = 11.69 / 2,
  height = 8.27 * 2 / 3,
  dpi = 600
)

print(final_plot)

cairo_pdf("~/Desktop/Projects/manuscript writing/TBI BD-tau/figure/Supplementary Figure 1 Serum CSF Longitudinal.pdf",
          width = 8.27*1.5, height = 11.69/2, family = "Arial")
print(final_plot)
dev.off()
```

```{r Matched Cohort Serum and CSF Longitudinal Death, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27*2/3, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")  # Only 03 and 06 months
biofluids <- c("Serum", "CSF")

# Color palette (standardized for Death outcome)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Survived" = "#7ab8d7",
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

outcome_linetypes <- c(
  "Survived" = "solid",
  "Deceased" = "dotdash"
)

# ============================================
# Prepare Data
# ============================================

match_cleaned <- tbi_match_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value = 2*mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value,
    mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value),
    mean_csf_Raw_12Hr_Value = 2*mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value,
    mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(mean_csf_Raw_12Hr_Value)
  )

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop - Both Biofluids
# ============================================

all_plots <- list()
all_test_results <- list()
all_pairwise_results <- list()

for (biofluid in biofluids) {
  for (tp in timepoints) {
    
    # Select appropriate columns based on biofluid
    if (biofluid == "Serum") {
      time_col <- "mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr"
      y_col <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
      log_y_col <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
      dd <- match_cleaned %>% filter(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12)
    } else {
      time_col <- "mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr"
      y_col <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
      log_y_col <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
      dd <- match_cleaned %>% filter(mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12)
    }
    
    outcome_col <- paste0("Death_", tp)
    
    cat("\n=============================================\n")
    cat(biofluid, "- Death at", tp, "months\n")
    cat("=============================================\n\n")
    
    # Prepare data
    plot_data <- dd %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
      mutate(
        group = factor(
          recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
          levels = c("Survived", "Deceased")
        ),
        time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
        time_hours = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))) * 12,
        subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
      )
    
    # Mixed Effects Model
    if(nrow(plot_data) >= 10 && n_distinct(plot_data$group) >= 2) {
      formula <- paste0(log_y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
      lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data)
      lmm_summary <- summary(lmm)
      coef_table <- coef(lmm_summary)
      
      interaction_deceased_p <- if("groupDeceased:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
        coef_table["groupDeceased:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
      } else { NA }
      
      cat("Mixed Effects Model:\n")
      cat("  Survived vs Dec: p =", format.pval(interaction_deceased_p, digits = 4), "\n\n")
    } else {
      interaction_deceased_p <- NA
    }
    
    # Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons
    cat("Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons:\n\n")
    
    unique_times <- sort(unique(plot_data$time_hours))
    all_groups <- c("Survived", "Deceased")
    pairwise_comparisons <- list(c("Survived", "Deceased"))
    timepoint_pairwise_results <- list()
    
    for (time_pt in unique_times) {
      time_data <- plot_data %>% filter(time_hours == time_pt)
      cat("Time:", time_pt, "hours\n")
      
      comparison_results <- map_dfr(pairwise_comparisons, function(pair) {
        data1 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[1]) %>% pull(!!sym(log_y_col))
        data2 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[2]) %>% pull(!!sym(log_y_col))
        n1 <- length(data1)
        n2 <- length(data2)
        
        if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2) {
          test_result <- try(wilcox.test(data1, data2, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
          p_val <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$p.value
          test_stat <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$statistic
        } else {
          p_val <- NA
          test_stat <- NA
        }
        
        tibble(
          time_hours = time_pt,
          group1 = pair[1],
          group2 = pair[2],
          n1 = n1,
          n2 = n2,
          test_statistic = test_stat,
          p_raw = p_val
        )
      })
      
      comparison_results <- comparison_results %>%
        mutate(
          p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
          sig_raw = case_when(
            p_raw < 0.001 ~ "***", p_raw < 0.01 ~ "**", p_raw < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
          ),
          sig_adj = case_when(
            p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**", p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
          ),
          comparison = paste0(group1, " vs ", group2),
          p_combined = paste0(format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), 
                              " / ", format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
        )
      
      timepoint_pairwise_results[[as.character(time_pt)]] <- comparison_results
      print(comparison_results %>% 
              dplyr::select(comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, p_adj, sig_adj) %>%
              mutate(p_raw = format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
                     p_adj = format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))
      cat("\n")
    }
    
    all_pairwise_for_tp <- bind_rows(timepoint_pairwise_results)
    
    # Store results
    result_key <- paste0(biofluid, "_", tp)
    all_test_results[[result_key]] <- list(
      biofluid = biofluid,
      timepoint = tp,
      interaction_deceased_p = interaction_deceased_p,
      n_survived = sum(plot_data$group == "Survived", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_deceased = sum(plot_data$group == "Deceased", na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    all_pairwise_results[[result_key]] <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
      mutate(
        Biofluid = biofluid,
        Death_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")
      )
    
    # Visualization
    summary_df <- plot_data %>%
      group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
        sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
        se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    sig_markers <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
      filter(group1 == "Survived" & group2 == "Deceased") %>%
      filter(sig_adj != "ns") %>%
      dplyr::select(time_hours, sig_adj)
    
    p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
      geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 2, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_point(size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) + 
      scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes, guide = "none") +
      geom_text(
        data = sig_markers,
        aes(x = time_hours, 
            y = max(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1, 
            label = sig_adj),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(biofluid, " - Death at ", tp, " months"),
        x = "Hours Post-Injury",
        y = paste0(biofluid, " BD-Tau (pg/mL)")
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +  
      theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
      )
    
    all_plots[[result_key]] <- p
    
    cat("=============================================\n\n")
  }
}

# ============================================
# Save Results
# ============================================

interaction_summary <- map_dfr(names(all_test_results), function(key) {
  res <- all_test_results[[key]]
  tibble(
    Biofluid = res$biofluid,
    Death_Timepoint = paste0(res$timepoint, " months"),
    N_Survived = res$n_survived,
    N_Deceased = res$n_deceased,
    Interaction_SurvVsDec_p = res$interaction_deceased_p
  )
})

all_pairwise_combined <- bind_rows(all_pairwise_results)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Interaction_Tests" = interaction_summary,
    "Pairwise_Raw_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Biofluid, Death_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, sig_raw),
    "Pairwise_FDR_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Biofluid, Death_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_adj, sig_adj),
    "Pairwise_Combined" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Biofluid, Death_Timepoint, time_hours, comparison, n1, n2, p_combined, sig_adj),
    "All_Results_Detailed" = all_pairwise_combined
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "matched_serum_csf_longitudinal_Death_pairwise_analysis.xlsx")
)

# ============================================
# Create Publication Figure (4 panels)
# ============================================

tp_labels <- c("03" = "3 months", "06" = "6 months")

# Prepare individual plots without legend
plot_list <- list()
counter <- 1

for (biofluid in biofluids) {
  for (tp in timepoints) {
    result_key <- paste0(biofluid, "_", tp)
    plot_list[[counter]] <- all_plots[[result_key]] +
      labs(title = paste0(biofluid, " - Death at ", tp_labels[tp])) +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

# Extract legend
legend <- get_legend(
  all_plots[[1]] + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm")
    )
)

# Combine all 4 plots in 2x2 grid
combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  legend,
  plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 2, # labels = "AUTO", 
            label_size = 11, label_fontface = "bold"),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.05, 1)
)

ggsave(paste0(figures_path, "matched_serum_csf_bdtau_by_death_longitudinal.pdf"), 
       combined_plot, 
       width = 11.69/2, height = 8.27*2/3, 
       units = "in", dpi = 600)

print(combined_plot)

cairo_pdf("~/Desktop/Projects/manuscript writing/TBI BD-tau/figure/Extended Data Figure [Matched Serum-CSF by Death Longitudinal].pdf",
          width = 8.27, height = 11.69/3, family = "Arial")
print(combined_plot)
dev.off()
```
