```{r Matched Cohort Rate of Change by GOS, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27*2/3, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# Calculate Day Index and Rate Variables for Matched Cohort
# ============================================

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================
# Process Serum Variables for Matched Cohort
# ============================================

DT_serum <- as.data.table(tbi_match_demo)
DT_serum[, rowid := .I]
DT_serum[, day_idx := floor(as.numeric(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value))]

# Get anchors (first measurement per subject per day)
anchors_serum <- DT_serum[order(Subject.ID, day_idx, mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value),
                          .(anchor_time = first(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value),
                            anchor_serum = first(mean_serum_BDTau)),
                          by = .(Subject.ID, day_idx)]

# Merge with rolling join to get previous day's anchor
DT_serum[, target_prev_day := day_idx - 1L]
setkey(anchors_serum, Subject.ID, day_idx)
setkey(DT_serum, Subject.ID, target_prev_day)
DT_merged_serum <- anchors_serum[DT_serum, roll = Inf]

# Calculate delta and rate vs previous day
DT_merged_serum[, delta_vs_prevday :=
                  ifelse(!is.na(anchor_serum),
                         mean_serum_BDTau - anchor_serum, NA_real_)]
DT_merged_serum[, mean_serum_rate_per_day :=
                  ifelse(!is.na(anchor_serum) &
                           (mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value > anchor_time),
                         (mean_serum_BDTau - anchor_serum) /
                           (mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value - anchor_time),
                         NA_real_)]

# Restore original order and add calculated columns
setorder(DT_merged_serum, rowid)
setorder(DT_serum, rowid)
DT_serum[, `:=`(
  anchor_day_idx = DT_merged_serum$day_idx,
  anchor_time = DT_merged_serum$anchor_time,
  anchor_serum = DT_merged_serum$anchor_serum,
  delta_vs_prevday = DT_merged_serum$delta_vs_prevday,
  mean_serum_rate_per_day = DT_merged_serum$mean_serum_rate_per_day
)]
DT_serum[, c("rowid", "target_prev_day") := NULL]

# Calculate rate by baseline (first measurement per subject)
baseline_serum <- DT_serum[order(Subject.ID, mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value),
                           .(baseline_time = first(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value),
                             baseline_serum = first(mean_serum_BDTau)),
                           by = Subject.ID]
DT_serum <- baseline_serum[DT_serum, on = "Subject.ID"]

# Calculate delta and rate from baseline
DT_serum[, delta_vs_baseline := mean_serum_BDTau - baseline_serum]
DT_serum[, mean_serum_rate_vs_baseline := 
           ifelse(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value > baseline_time,
                  (mean_serum_BDTau - baseline_serum) / 
                    (mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value - baseline_time),
                  NA_real_)]

# ============================================
# Process CSF Variables for Matched Cohort
# ============================================

DT_csf <- as.data.table(tbi_match_demo)
DT_csf[, rowid := .I]
DT_csf[, day_idx := floor(as.numeric(mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value))]

# Get anchors (first measurement per subject per day)
anchors_csf <- DT_csf[order(Subject.ID, day_idx, mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value),
                      .(anchor_time = first(mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value),
                        anchor_csf = first(mean_csf_BDTau)),
                      by = .(Subject.ID, day_idx)]

# Merge with rolling join to get previous day's anchor
DT_csf[, target_prev_day := day_idx - 1L]
setkey(anchors_csf, Subject.ID, day_idx)
setkey(DT_csf, Subject.ID, target_prev_day)
DT_merged_csf <- anchors_csf[DT_csf, roll = Inf]

# Calculate delta and rate vs previous day
DT_merged_csf[, delta_vs_prevday :=
                ifelse(!is.na(anchor_csf),
                       mean_csf_BDTau - anchor_csf, NA_real_)]
DT_merged_csf[, mean_csf_rate_per_day :=
                ifelse(!is.na(anchor_csf) &
                         (mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value > anchor_time),
                       (mean_csf_BDTau - anchor_csf) /
                         (mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value - anchor_time),
                       NA_real_)]

# Restore original order and add calculated columns
setorder(DT_merged_csf, rowid)
setorder(DT_csf, rowid)
DT_csf[, `:=`(
  anchor_day_idx = DT_merged_csf$day_idx,
  anchor_time = DT_merged_csf$anchor_time,
  anchor_csf = DT_merged_csf$anchor_csf,
  delta_vs_prevday = DT_merged_csf$delta_vs_prevday,
  mean_csf_rate_per_day = DT_merged_csf$mean_csf_rate_per_day
)]
DT_csf[, c("rowid", "target_prev_day") := NULL]

# Calculate rate by baseline (first measurement per subject)
baseline_csf <- DT_csf[order(Subject.ID, mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value),
                       .(baseline_time = first(mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value),
                         baseline_csf = first(mean_csf_BDTau)),
                       by = Subject.ID]
DT_csf <- baseline_csf[DT_csf, on = "Subject.ID"]

# Calculate delta and rate from baseline
DT_csf[, delta_vs_baseline := mean_csf_BDTau - baseline_csf]
DT_csf[, mean_csf_rate_vs_baseline := 
         ifelse(mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value > baseline_time,
                (mean_csf_BDTau - baseline_csf) / 
                  (mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value - baseline_time),
                NA_real_)]

# ============================================
# Merge Serum and CSF Results Back
# ============================================

# Extract serum-specific columns
serum_cols <- DT_serum[, .(
  Subject.ID,
  mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value,
  day_idx,
  anchor_day_idx,
  anchor_time_serum = anchor_time,
  anchor_serum,
  baseline_time_serum = baseline_time,
  baseline_serum,
  delta_vs_prevday_serum = delta_vs_prevday,
  delta_vs_baseline_serum = delta_vs_baseline,
  mean_serum_rate_per_day,
  mean_serum_rate_vs_baseline
)]

# Extract CSF-specific columns
csf_cols <- DT_csf[, .(
  Subject.ID,
  mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value,
  day_idx,
  anchor_day_idx,
  anchor_time_csf = anchor_time,
  anchor_csf,
  baseline_time_csf = baseline_time,
  baseline_csf,
  delta_vs_prevday_csf = delta_vs_prevday,
  delta_vs_baseline_csf = delta_vs_baseline,
  mean_csf_rate_per_day,
  mean_csf_rate_vs_baseline
)]

# Merge back into original tbi_match_demo
tbi_match_demo <- as.data.table(tbi_match_demo)

# Join serum columns
tbi_match_demo <- serum_cols[tbi_match_demo, 
                             on = c("Subject.ID", "mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value")]

# Join CSF columns
tbi_match_demo <- csf_cols[tbi_match_demo, 
                           on = c("Subject.ID", "mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value")]

# Convert back to tibble
tbi_match_demo <- tibble::as_tibble(tbi_match_demo)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")  # Only 03 and 06 months
biofluids <- c("Serum", "CSF")

# Color palette (standardized)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Favorable" = "#7ab8d7",
  "Unfavorable" = "#db95a0", 
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

outcome_linetypes <- c(
  "Favorable" = "solid",
  "Unfavorable" = "dashed",
  "Deceased" = "dotdash"
)

# ============================================
# Prepare Data
# ============================================

match_rate_cleaned <- tbi_match_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID, day_idx) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop - Both Biofluids
# ============================================

all_plots <- list()
all_test_results <- list()
all_pairwise_results <- list()

for (biofluid in biofluids) {
  for (tp in timepoints) {
    
    # Select appropriate columns based on biofluid
    if (biofluid == "Serum") {
      time_col <- "day_idx"
      y_col <- "mean_serum_rate_vs_baseline"
      dd <- match_rate_cleaned %>% filter(day_idx <= 6)
    } else {
      time_col <- "day_idx"
      y_col <- "mean_csf_rate_vs_baseline"
      dd <- match_rate_cleaned %>% filter(day_idx <= 6)
    }
    
    outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
    
    cat("\n=============================================\n")
    cat(biofluid, "- GOS at", tp, "months (Rate of Change)\n")
    cat("=============================================\n\n")
    
    # Prepare data
    plot_data <- dd %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
      mutate(
        group = factor(
          recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
          levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
        ),
        time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
        subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
      )
    
    # Mixed Effects Model
    if(nrow(plot_data) >= 10 && n_distinct(plot_data$group) >= 2) {
      formula <- paste0(y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
      lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data)
      lmm_summary <- summary(lmm)
      coef_table <- coef(lmm_summary)
      
      interaction_unfav_p <- if("groupUnfavorable:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
        coef_table["groupUnfavorable:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
      } else { NA }
      
      interaction_deceased_p <- if("groupDeceased:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
        coef_table["groupDeceased:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
      } else { NA }
      
      cat("Mixed Effects Model:\n")
      cat("  Fav vs Unfav: p =", format.pval(interaction_unfav_p, digits = 4), "\n")
      cat("  Fav vs Dec: p =", format.pval(interaction_deceased_p, digits = 4), "\n\n")
    } else {
      interaction_unfav_p <- NA
      interaction_deceased_p <- NA
    }
    
    # Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons
    cat("Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons:\n\n")
    
    unique_times <- sort(unique(plot_data$time))
    all_groups <- c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
    pairwise_comparisons <- combn(all_groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)
    timepoint_pairwise_results <- list()
    
    for (time_pt in unique_times) {
      time_data <- plot_data %>% filter(time == time_pt)
      cat("Day:", time_pt, "\n")
      
      comparison_results <- map_dfr(pairwise_comparisons, function(pair) {
        data1 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[1]) %>% pull(!!sym(y_col))
        data2 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[2]) %>% pull(!!sym(y_col))
        n1 <- length(data1)
        n2 <- length(data2)
        
        if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2) {
          test_result <- try(wilcox.test(data1, data2, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
          p_val <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$p.value
          test_stat <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$statistic
        } else {
          p_val <- NA
          test_stat <- NA
        }
        
        tibble(
          time_days = time_pt,
          group1 = pair[1],
          group2 = pair[2],
          n1 = n1,
          n2 = n2,
          test_statistic = test_stat,
          p_raw = p_val
        )
      })
      
      comparison_results <- comparison_results %>%
        mutate(
          p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
          sig_raw = case_when(
            p_raw < 0.001 ~ "***", p_raw < 0.01 ~ "**", p_raw < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
          ),
          sig_adj = case_when(
            p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**", p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
          ),
          comparison = paste0(group1, " vs ", group2),
          p_combined = paste0(format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), 
                              " / ", format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
        )
      
      timepoint_pairwise_results[[as.character(time_pt)]] <- comparison_results
      print(comparison_results %>% 
              dplyr::select(comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, p_adj, sig_adj) %>%
              mutate(p_raw = format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
                     p_adj = format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))
      cat("\n")
    }
    
    all_pairwise_for_tp <- bind_rows(timepoint_pairwise_results)
    
    # Store results
    result_key <- paste0(biofluid, "_", tp)
    all_test_results[[result_key]] <- list(
      biofluid = biofluid,
      timepoint = tp,
      interaction_unfav_p = interaction_unfav_p,
      interaction_deceased_p = interaction_deceased_p,
      n_favorable = sum(plot_data$group == "Favorable", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_unfavorable = sum(plot_data$group == "Unfavorable", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_deceased = sum(plot_data$group == "Deceased", na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    all_pairwise_results[[result_key]] <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
      mutate(
        Biofluid = biofluid,
        GOS_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")
      )
    
    # Visualization
    summary_df <- plot_data %>%
      group_by(group, time) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
        sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
        se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    sig_markers <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
      filter(group1 == "Favorable" & group2 == "Deceased") %>%
      filter(sig_adj != "ns") %>%
      dplyr::select(time_days, sig_adj) %>%
      rename(time = time_days)
    
    p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 0.12) +
      geom_point(size = 1.3) +
      scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) + 
      scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes, guide = "none") +
      geom_text(
        data = sig_markers,
        aes(x = time, 
            y = max(abs(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val), 
                    abs(summary_df$mean_val - summary_df$se_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15, 
            label = sig_adj),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(biofluid, " - GOS at ", tp, " months"),
        x = "Day Post-Injury",
        y = "Rate of Change (per day)"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(summary_df$time, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)) +  
      # ylim(NA, 100) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
      )
    
    all_plots[[result_key]] <- p
    
    cat("=============================================\n\n")
  }
}

# ============================================
# Save Results
# ============================================

interaction_summary <- map_dfr(names(all_test_results), function(key) {
  res <- all_test_results[[key]]
  tibble(
    Biofluid = res$biofluid,
    GOS_Timepoint = paste0(res$timepoint, " months"),
    N_Favorable = res$n_favorable,
    N_Unfavorable = res$n_unfavorable,
    N_Deceased = res$n_deceased,
    Interaction_FavVsUnfav_p = res$interaction_unfav_p,
    Interaction_FavVsDec_p = res$interaction_deceased_p
  )
})

all_pairwise_combined <- bind_rows(all_pairwise_results)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Interaction_Tests" = interaction_summary,
    "Pairwise_Raw_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Biofluid, GOS_Timepoint, time_days, comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, sig_raw),
    "Pairwise_FDR_Pvalues" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Biofluid, GOS_Timepoint, time_days, comparison, n1, n2, p_adj, sig_adj),
    "Pairwise_Combined" = all_pairwise_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Biofluid, GOS_Timepoint, time_days, comparison, n1, n2, p_combined, sig_adj),
    "All_Results_Detailed" = all_pairwise_combined
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "matched_serum_csf_rate_GOS_pairwise_analysis.xlsx")
)

# ============================================
```

```{r Matched Cohort Rate of Change by Death, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27*2/3, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ============================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06")  # Only 03 and 06 months

# Color palette (standardized for Death outcome)

  "Survived" = "#7ab8d7",
  "Deceased" = "#882355"
)

outcome_linetypes <- c(
  "Survived" = "solid",
  "Deceased" = "dotdash"
)

# ============================================
# Prepare Data
# ============================================

match_rate_cleaned <- tbi_match_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID, day_idx) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop - Both Biofluids
# ============================================

all_plots <- list()
all_test_results <- list()
all_pairwise_results <- list()

for (biofluid in biofluids) {
  for (tp in timepoints) {
    
    # Select appropriate columns based on biofluid
    if (biofluid == "Serum") {
      time_col <- "day_idx"
      y_col <- "mean_serum_rate_vs_baseline"
      dd <- match_rate_cleaned %>% filter(day_idx <= 6)
    } else {
      time_col <- "day_idx"
      y_col <- "mean_csf_rate_vs_baseline"
      dd <- match_rate_cleaned %>% filter(day_idx <= 6)
    }
    
    outcome_col <- paste0("Death_", tp)
    
    cat("\n=============================================\n")
    cat(biofluid, "- Death at", tp, "months (Rate of Change)\n")
    cat("=============================================\n\n")
    
    # Prepare data
    plot_data <- dd %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
      mutate(
        group = factor(
          recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
          levels = c("Survived", "Deceased")
        ),
        time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
        subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
      )
    
    # Mixed Effects Model
    if(nrow(plot_data) >= 10 && n_distinct(plot_data$group) >= 2) {
      formula <- paste0(y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
      lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data)
      lmm_summary <- summary(lmm)
      coef_table <- coef(lmm_summary)
      
      interaction_deceased_p <- if("groupDeceased:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
        coef_table["groupDeceased:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
      } else { NA }
      
      cat("Mixed Effects Model:\n")
      cat("  Survived vs Dec: p =", format.pval(interaction_deceased_p, digits = 4), "\n\n")
    } else {
      interaction_deceased_p <- NA
    }
    
    # Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons
    cat("Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons:\n\n")
    
    unique_times <- sort(unique(plot_data$time))
    all_groups <- c("Survived", "Deceased")
    pairwise_comparisons <- list(c("Survived", "Deceased"))
    timepoint_pairwise_results <- list()
    
    for (time_pt in unique_times) {
      time_data <- plot_data %>% filter(time == time_pt)
      cat("Day:", time_pt, "\n")
      
      comparison_results <- map_dfr(pairwise_comparisons, function(pair) {
        data1 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[1]) %>% pull(!!sym(y_col))
        data2 <- time_data %>% filter(group == pair[2]) %>% pull(!!sym(y_col))
        n1 <- length(data1)
        n2 <- length(data2)
        
        if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2) {
          test_result <- try(wilcox.test(data1, data2, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
          p_val <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$p.value
          test_stat <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA else test_result$statistic
        } else {
          p_val <- NA
          test_stat <- NA
        }
        
        tibble(

          n1 = n1,
          n2 = n2,
          test_statistic = test_stat,
          p_raw = p_val
        )
      })
      
      comparison_results <- comparison_results %>%
        mutate(
          p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
          sig_raw = case_when(
            p_raw < 0.001 ~ "***", p_raw < 0.01 ~ "**", p_raw < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
          ),

          ),
          comparison = paste0(group1, " vs ", group2),
          p_combined = paste0(format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001), 
                              " / ", format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
        )
      
      timepoint_pairwise_results[[as.character(time_pt)]] <- comparison_results
      print(comparison_results %>% 
              dplyr::select(comparison, n1, n2, p_raw, p_adj, sig_adj) %>%
              mutate(p_raw = format.pval(p_raw, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
                     p_adj = format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))
      cat("\n")
    }
    
    all_pairwise_for_tp <- bind_rows(timepoint_pairwise_results)
    
    # Store results
    result_key <- paste0(biofluid, "_", tp)
    all_test_results[[result_key]] <- list(
      biofluid = biofluid,
      timepoint = tp,
      interaction_deceased_p = interaction_deceased_p,
      n_survived = sum(plot_data$group == "Survived", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_deceased = sum(plot_data$group == "Deceased", na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    all_pairwise_results[[result_key]] <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
      mutate(
        Biofluid = biofluid,
        Death_Timepoint = paste0(tp, " months")
      )
    
    # Visualization
    summary_df <- plot_data %>%
      group_by(group, time) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
        sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
        se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    sig_markers <- all_pairwise_for_tp %>%
      filter(group1 == "Survived" & group2 == "Deceased") %>%
      filter(sig_adj != "ns") %>%
      dplyr::select(time_days, sig_adj) %>%
      rename(time = time_days)
    
    p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 0.12) +
      geom_point(size = 1.3) +
      scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) + 
      scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes, guide = "none") +
      geom_text(
        data = sig_markers,
        aes(x = time, 
            y = max(abs(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val), 
                    abs(summary_df$mean_val - summary_df$se_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15, 
            label = sig_adj),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(biofluid, " - Death at ", tp, " months"),
        x = "Day Post-Injury",
        y = "Rate of Change (per day)"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(summary_df$time, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)) +  
      # ylim(NA, 100) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
      )
    
    all_plots[[result_key]] <- p
    
    cat("=============================================\n\n")
  }
}

# ============================================
# Save Results
# ============================================

  tibble(
```

```{r [CSF] Integrated Cohorts Longitudinal Visualization on Death, eval=FALSE, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

dd <- csf_cleaned %>% 
              filter(csf_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12)

csf_spaghetti_plots <- list()

for (tp in timepoints){
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("Death_", tp)
  time_col <- "csf_First_Digit_12Hr"
  
  y_col <- "csf_BDTau"
  log_y_col <- "csf_log2_BDTau"
  
  group_counts <- dd %>%
    dplyr::select(Subject.ID, !!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    count(!!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(!!sym(outcome_col), " (N=", n, ")"))
  
  custom_labels <- setNames(group_counts$label, group_counts[[outcome_col]])
  
  labeller_fn <- function(values) {
    unname(custom_labels[as.character(values)])
  }
  
  # subset data
  plot_data <- dd %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Survived", "Deceased")
      ),
      time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
      time_hours = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))) * 12,
      subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
    )
  
  # fit the model on log-scale with random intercept per subject
  
  formula <- paste0(log_y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
  lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data)  # Use filtered data
  anova_result <- anova(lmm)
  p_val <- anova_result["group", "Pr(>F)"]
  p_text <- paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3))
  
  # calculate per-time point p-values on log scale
  
  tp_pvals <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(time_hours) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      model <- try(lm(as.formula(paste0(log_y_col, " ~ group")), data = .x), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
        tibble(p = NA)
      } else {
        tibble(p = anova(model)[["Pr(>F)"]][1])
      }
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
      significance_adj = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  tp_pvals %>%
    dplyr::select(time_hours, p, p_adj, significance_adj) %>%
    print(n = Inf)
  
  # summarize mean ± SD on original scale
  
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # plot on original scale
  
  csf_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Survived" = "navy",
      "Deceased" = "firebrick"),
      name = NULL) + 
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
      "Survived" = "dashed",
      "Deceased"    = "dotdash"
    ), guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = tp_pvals,
      aes(x = time_hours, y = max(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1, 
          label = significance_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "CSF BD-Tau (pg/ml)",
      # subtitle = paste0("Mixed-effects model: Group × Time interaction p = ", 
      #                   format.pval(p_val, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)),
      x = "Hours Post-Injury",
      y = "BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +  
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  
}
```

```{r [CSF] Integrated Cohorts delta change on baseline Longitudinal Visualization on GOS, eval=FALSE, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

dd <- csf_rate_cleaned %>% 
  filter(day_idx <= 6)

hist(dd$csf_rate_vs_baseline, breaks = 100)

csf_spaghetti_plots <- list()
all_test_results <- list()

for (tp in timepoints){
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
  time_col <- "day_idx"
  
  y_col <- "csf_rate_vs_baseline"
  # No log transformation needed for rates that can be negative
  
  # Count all groups for visualization labels
  group_counts <- dd %>%
    dplyr::select(Subject.ID, !!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    count(!!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(!!sym(outcome_col), " (N=", n, ")"))
  
  custom_labels <- setNames(group_counts$label, group_counts[[outcome_col]])
  
  # Prepare data for visualization (ALL groups)
  plot_data <- dd %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Control","Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Deceased")
      ),
      time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
      subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
    )
  
  # Prepare data for statistical testing (ONLY Favorable vs Deceased)
  plot_data_for_model <- plot_data %>%
    filter(group %in% c("Favorable", "Deceased")) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Favorable", "Deceased")))  # Re-level
  
  # Fit the model on original scale
  # Testing ONLY Favorable vs Deceased
  if(nrow(plot_data_for_model) >= 10 && n_distinct(plot_data_for_model$group) == 2) {
    
    formula <- paste0(y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
    lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data_for_model)
    lmm_summary <- summary(lmm)
    
    # Extract interaction p-value
    coef_table <- coef(lmm_summary)
    interaction_p <- if("groupDeceased:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
      coef_table["groupDeceased:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    } else {
      NA
    }
    
    cat("\n===========================================\n")
    cat("Timepoint: GOS at", tp, "months\n")
    cat("===========================================\n")
    cat("Testing: Favorable vs Deceased only\n")
    cat("Interaction p-value:", sprintf("%.4f", interaction_p), "\n")
    if(!is.na(interaction_p) && interaction_p < 0.05) {
      cat("Result: Significant difference in trajectories\n")
    } else {
      cat("Result: No significant difference in trajectories\n")
    }
    
    # Calculate per-time point p-values using Wilcoxon test (2 groups)
    tp_pvals <- plot_data_for_model %>%
      group_by(time) %>%
      group_modify(~ {
        groups_present <- unique(.x$group)
        if(length(groups_present) < 2 || nrow(.x) < 4) {
          tibble(p = NA, test_method = "insufficient_data")
        } else {
          test_result <- try(
            wilcox.test(as.formula(paste0(y_col, " ~ group")), data = .x),
            silent = TRUE
          )
          if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) {
            tibble(p = NA, test_method = "error")
          } else {
            tibble(p = test_result$p.value, test_method = "wilcoxon")
          }
        }
      }) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
        significance_raw = case_when(
          p < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p < 0.01  ~ "**",
          p < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        significance_adj = case_when(
          p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
          p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ ""
        )
      )
    
    cat("\nPer-timepoint comparisons:\n")
    print(tp_pvals %>% dplyr::select(time, p, p_adj, significance_adj, test_method))
    cat("===========================================\n")
    
    # Store results
    all_test_results[[tp]] <- list(
      interaction_p = interaction_p,
      timepoint_pvals = tp_pvals,
      n_favorable = sum(plot_data_for_model$group == "Favorable"),
      n_deceased = sum(plot_data_for_model$group == "Deceased")
    )
    
  } else {
    cat("\nInsufficient data for testing at timepoint:", tp, "\n")
    tp_pvals <- tibble(
      time = numeric(),
      p = numeric(),
      p_adj = numeric(),
      significance_adj = character()
    )
    all_test_results[[tp]] <- list(
      interaction_p = NA,
      timepoint_pvals = tp_pvals,
      n_favorable = 0,
      n_deceased = 0
    )
  }
  
  # Summarize mean ± SE on original scale (ALL groups for visualization)
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Plot on original scale with ALL groups
  # But significance markers represent Favorable vs Deceased only
  csf_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +  # Reference line
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 0.15) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Control" = "grey50",
      "Favorable" = "forestgreen",
      "Unfavorable" = "darkorange", 
      "Deceased" = "firebrick"),
      name = NULL) + 
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
      "Control" = "solid",
      "Favorable"   = "solid",
      "Unfavorable" = "dashed",
      "Deceased"    = "dotdash"
    ), guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = tp_pvals,
      aes(x = time, 
          y = max(abs(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val), 
                  abs(summary_df$mean_val - summary_df$se_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15, 
          label = significance_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "CSF BD-Tau Rate of Change",
      subtitle = paste0("Stats: Favorable vs Deceased; Interaction p = ", 
                        format.pval(all_test_results[[tp]]$interaction_p, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)),
      x = "Day Post-Injury",
      y = "Rate of Change from Baseline"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(summary_df$time, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)) +  
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray30")
    )
  
}

# Save test results to CSV
test_summary <- map_dfr(timepoints, function(tp) {
  res <- all_test_results[[tp]]
  tibble(
    Timepoint = paste0("GOS_", tp),
    N_Favorable = res$n_favorable,
    N_Deceased = res$n_deceased,
    Interaction_P = res$interaction_p,
    Significant = !is.na(res$interaction_p) && res$interaction_p < 0.05
  )
})

write.csv(test_summary, "csf_rate_favorable_vs_deceased_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save timepoint-specific p-values
for(tp in timepoints) {
  if(!is.null(all_test_results[[tp]]$timepoint_pvals) && 
     nrow(all_test_results[[tp]]$timepoint_pvals) > 0) {
    write.csv(
      all_test_results[[tp]]$timepoint_pvals,
      paste0("csf_rate_timepoint_pvals_GOS_", tp, ".csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

```{r [CSF] Integrated Cohorts delta change on baseline Longitudinal Visualization on Death, eval=FALSE, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
  custom_labels <- setNames(group_counts$label, group_counts[[outcome_col]])

  }

  plot_data <- dd %>%

    group_by(time) %>%
    group_modify(~ {

      if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
        tibble(p = NA)
      } else {
        tibble(p = anova(model)[["Pr(>F)"]][1])
      }
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%

        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",

      )
    )

    print(n = Inf)
  
  # summarize mean ± SE on original scale
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # plot on original scale
  csf_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +  # Reference line

    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 0.15) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(

      "Deceased" = "firebrick"),

      "Control" = "solid",
      "Survived" = "dashed",
      "Deceased" = "dotdash"
    ), guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = tp_pvals,
      aes(x = time, 
          y = max(abs(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val), 
                  abs(summary_df$mean_val - summary_df$se_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15, 
          label = significance_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "CSF BD-Tau Rate of Change",
      x = "Day Post-Injury",
      y = "Rate of Change from Baseline"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(summary_df$time, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)) +  
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  
}
```

```{r [CSF] Integrated Cohorts delta change Longitudinal Visualization on GOS, eval=FALSE, fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +  # Reference line
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 0.15) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Control" = "grey50",
      "Favorable" = "forestgreen",
      "Unfavorable" = "darkorange", 
      "Deceased" = "firebrick"),
      name = NULL) + 
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
      "Control" = "solid",
      "Favorable"   = "solid",
      "Unfavorable" = "dashed",
      "Deceased"    = "dotdash"
    ), guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = tp_pvals,
      aes(x = time, 
          y = max(abs(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val), 
                  abs(summary_df$mean_val - summary_df$se_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15, 
          label = significance_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "CSF BD-Tau Rate of Change",
      x = "Day Post-Injury",
      y = "Rate of Change (per day)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(summary_df$time, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)) +  
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  
}
```

```{r [CSF] Integrated Cohorts delta change Longitudinal Visualization on Death, eval=FALSE , fig.align='default', fig.width=11.69, fig.width=8.27, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

dd <- csf_rate_cleaned %>% 
  filter(day_idx <= 6)

csf_spaghetti_plots <- list()

for (tp in timepoints){
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("Death_", tp)
  time_col <- "day_idx"
  
  y_col <- "csf_rate_per_day"
  # No log transformation needed for rates that can be negative
  
  group_counts <- dd %>%
    dplyr::select(Subject.ID, !!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    count(!!sym(outcome_col)) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(!!sym(outcome_col), " (N=", n, ")"))
  
  custom_labels <- setNames(group_counts$label, group_counts[[outcome_col]])
  
  labeller_fn <- function(values) {
    unname(custom_labels[as.character(values)])
  }
  
  # subset data
  plot_data <- dd %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_col))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(
        recode(!!sym(outcome_col), "Dead" = "Deceased"), 
        levels = c("Control","Survived", "Deceased")
      ),
      time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
      subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
    )
  
  # fit the model on original scale, excluding control
  plot_data_for_model <- plot_data %>%
    filter(group != "Control")
  
  formula <- paste0(y_col, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
  lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data_for_model)
  anova_result <- anova(lmm)
  p_val <- anova_result["group", "Pr(>F)"]
  p_text <- paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3))
  print(p_text)
  
  # calculate per-time point p-values on original scale
  tp_pvals <- plot_data_for_model %>%
    group_by(time) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      model <- try(lm(as.formula(paste0(y_col, " ~ group")), data = .x), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
        tibble(p = NA)
      } else {
        tibble(p = anova(model)[["Pr(>F)"]][1])
      }
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
      significance_adj = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  tp_pvals %>%
    dplyr::select(time, p, p_adj, significance_adj) %>%
    print(n = Inf)
  
  # summarize mean ± SE on original scale
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE), 
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # plot on original scale
  csf_spaghetti_plots[[tp]] <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +  # Reference line
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val), width = 0.15) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Control" = "grey50",
      "Survived" = "navy",
      "Deceased" = "firebrick"),
      name = NULL) + 
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
      "Control" = "solid",
      "Survived" = "dashed",
      "Deceased" = "dotdash"
    ), guide = "none") +
    geom_text(
      data = tp_pvals,
      aes(x = time, 
          y = max(abs(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val), 
                  abs(summary_df$mean_val - summary_df$se_val), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15, 
          label = significance_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "CSF BD-Tau Rate of Change",
      x = "Day Post-Injury",
      y = "Rate of Change (per day)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(summary_df$time, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)) +  
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  
}
```

### Linear Mixed Model Section

```{r linear mixed model using serum BD-Tau to predict trend, eval=FALSE}

library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================================
# ANALYSIS FOR ALL FOUR TIMEPOINTS: GOS_03, GOS_06, GOS_12, GOS_24
# ============================================================================

timepoints <- c("03", "06", "12", "24")
gam_models <- list()
plot_list <- list()
statistics_list <- list()

for (tp in timepoints) {

  # ==========================================================================
  # 1. PREPARE DATA
  # ==========================================================================
  
  outcome_col <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
  
  tbi_serum_tp <- tbi_serum_demo %>% 
    filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
    filter(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12) %>%
    mutate(
      mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = as.numeric(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr),
      time_hours = mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr * 12,
      Subject.ID = as.factor(Subject.ID),
      GOS = as.factor(!!sym(outcome_col))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(GOS) & 
             !is.na(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr) & 
             !is.na(mean_serum_log2_BDTau) &
             GOS %in% c("Favorable","Unfavorable","Dead"))
  
  cat("Sample size: N =", nrow(tbi_serum_tp), "observations from", 
      n_distinct(tbi_serum_tp$Subject.ID), "subjects\n\n")
  
  # ==========================================================================
  # 2. FIT GAM MODEL
  # ==========================================================================
  
  smooth_model <- gam(
    mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ 
      s(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr, by = GOS, k = 10) +
      GOS +
      s(Subject.ID, bs = "re") +
      s(Subject.ID, mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr, bs = "re"),
    data = tbi_serum_tp, 
    method = "REML"
  )
  
  gam_models[[tp]] <- smooth_model
  
  cat("=== GAM MODEL SUMMARY ===\n")
  print(summary(smooth_model))
  
  # ==========================================================================
  # 3. TEST FOR SIGNIFICANT TRAJECTORY DIFFERENCES
  # ==========================================================================
  
  cat("\n=== TESTING IF TRAJECTORIES DIFFER BETWEEN GROUPS ===\n\n")
  
  smooth_model_null <- gam(
    mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ 
      s(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr, k = 10) +
      GOS +
      s(Subject.ID, bs = "re") +
      s(Subject.ID, mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr, bs = "re"),
    data = tbi_serum_tp, 
    method = "REML"
  )
  
  comparison <- AIC(smooth_model_null, smooth_model)
  delta_aic <- comparison[2, "AIC"] - comparison[1, "AIC"]
  
  cat("MODEL COMPARISON:\n")
  print(comparison)
  cat("\nΔAIC =", round(delta_aic, 2), "\n")
  
  lr_test <- anova(smooth_model_null, smooth_model, test = "Chisq")
  cat("\nLIKELIHOOD RATIO TEST:\n")
  print(lr_test)
  
  # Store statistics
  statistics_list[[tp]] <- list(
    aic_comparison = comparison,
    delta_aic = delta_aic,
    lr_test = lr_test
  )
  
  # ==========================================================================
  # 4. PAIRWISE COMPARISONS AT KEY TIMEPOINTS
  # ==========================================================================
  
  cat("\n=== PAIRWISE COMPARISONS AT KEY TIMEPOINTS ===\n")
  
  key_timepoints <- c(0, 3, 6, 9, 12)
  
  for (time_pt in key_timepoints) {
    hours <- time_pt * 12
    cat("\n--- At", hours, "hours post-injury ---\n")
    
    emm <- emmeans(smooth_model, 
                   specs = "GOS",
                   at = list(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = time_pt))
    
    pairs_result <- pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey")
    print(pairs_result)
  }
  
  # ==========================================================================
  # 5. CREATE PREDICTIONS FOR PLOTTING
  # ==========================================================================
  
  pred_data <- expand.grid(
    mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = seq(0, 12, by = 0.5),
    GOS = c("Dead", "Favorable", "Unfavorable"),
    Subject.ID = tbi_serum_tp$Subject.ID[1]
  ) %>%
    mutate(time_hours = mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr * 12)
  
  preds <- predict(
    smooth_model, 
    newdata = pred_data, 
    se.fit = TRUE,
    exclude = c("s(Subject.ID)", "s(Subject.ID,mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr)")
  )
  
  pred_data <- pred_data %>%
    mutate(
      fit_log2 = preds$fit,
      se_log2 = preds$se.fit,
      lower_log2 = fit_log2 - 1.96 * se_log2,
      upper_log2 = fit_log2 + 1.96 * se_log2
    )
  
  # ==========================================================================
  # 6. CALCULATE OBSERVED SUMMARIES
  # ==========================================================================
  
  obs_summary_log2 <- tbi_serum_tp %>%
    group_by(GOS, mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr) %>%
    summarise(
      time_hours = mean(time_hours),
      n = n(),
      mean_log2 = mean(mean_serum_log2_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_log2 = sd(mean_serum_log2_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n >= 3)
  
  # ==========================================================================
  # 7. CREATE PLOT
  # ==========================================================================
  
  p <- ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = time_hours, color = GOS, fill = GOS)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_log2, ymax = upper_log2), alpha = 0.1, color = NA) +
    geom_line(aes(y = fit_log2), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = obs_summary_log2, 
               aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_log2), 
               size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(data = obs_summary_log2,
                  aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_log2, 
                      ymin = mean_log2 - se_log2, 
                      ymax = mean_log2 + se_log2),
                  width = 3, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Dead" = "firebrick", 
                 "Favorable" = "forestgreen", 
                 "Unfavorable" = "darkorange"),
      name = "GOS Outcome"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Dead" = "firebrick", 
                 "Favorable" = "forestgreen", 
                 "Unfavorable" = "darkorange"),
      name = "GOS Outcome"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 48)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("GOS at ", tp, " months"),
      x = "Hours Post-Injury",
      y = "Log2 BD-Tau"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  plot_list[[tp]] <- p
}

# ============================================================================
# 8. COMBINE ALL PLOTS INTO 2x2 FIGURE WITH SHARED LEGEND
# ============================================================================

# Extract legend from one plot (temporarily add it back)
plot_with_legend <- plot_list[["03"]] + 
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.5)))

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(plot_with_legend)

# Combine plots in 2x2 grid with shared legend
combined_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  legend,
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    plot_list[["03"]], plot_list[["06"]],
    plot_list[["12"]], plot_list[["24"]],
    ncol = 2, 
    labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    label_size = 12,
    label_fontface = "bold"
  ),
  ncol = 1, 
  rel_heights = c(0.1, 1)
)

# Display
print(combined_plot)

# ============================================================================
# 9. SAVE PUBLICATION FIGURE
# ============================================================================

ggsave(paste0(figures_path, "serum_bdtau_gam_all_timepoints.pdf"), combined_plot, 
       width = 11.69, height = 8.27, dpi = 600)

# ============================================================================
# 10. SUMMARY TABLES OF STATISTICS
# ============================================================================

# TABLE 1: OVERALL MODEL COMPARISON (Do trajectories differ between groups?)
# ============================================================================

cat("\n\n========================================================================\n")
cat("TABLE 1: OVERALL TRAJECTORY DIFFERENCES BY OUTCOME GROUP\n")
cat("========================================================================\n\n")

summary_table_overall <- data.frame(
  Timepoint = paste0("GOS at ", timepoints, " months"),
  Delta_AIC = sapply(timepoints, function(tp) {
    round(statistics_list[[tp]]$delta_aic, 2)
  }),
  LR_Chisq = sapply(timepoints, function(tp) {
    lr_res <- statistics_list[[tp]]$lr_test
    if (nrow(lr_res) >= 2) {
      return(round(lr_res[2, "Deviance"], 2))
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
  }),
  LR_df = sapply(timepoints, function(tp) {
    lr_res <- statistics_list[[tp]]$lr_test
    if (nrow(lr_res) >= 2) {
      return(lr_res[2, "Df"])
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
  }),
  LR_p_value = sapply(timepoints, function(tp) {
    lr_res <- as.data.frame(statistics_list[[tp]]$lr_test)
    pval <- lr_res$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]
  }),
  Interpretation = sapply(timepoints, function(tp) {
    delta <- statistics_list[[tp]]$delta_aic
    if (is.na(delta)) return("Unable to compare")
    if (delta < -10) return("Strong evidence for different trajectories")
    if (delta < -2) return("Some evidence for different trajectories")
    return("No evidence for different trajectories")
  })
)

print(summary_table_overall)

# TABLE 2: PAIRWISE COMPARISONS AT EACH TIMEPOINT
# ============================================================================

# Extract and compile pairwise comparisons for all GOS timepoints
key_hours <- c(0, 36, 72, 108, 144)

for (tp in timepoints) {
  
  cat("\n--- GOS at", tp, "months ---\n\n")
  
  # Re-run pairwise comparisons and store in organized table
  smooth_model <- gam_models[[tp]]
  
  pairwise_table <- data.frame()
  
  for (time_pt in c(0, 3, 6, 9, 12)) {
    hours <- time_pt * 12
    
    tryCatch({
      emm <- emmeans(smooth_model, 
                     specs = "GOS",
                     at = list(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = time_pt))
      
      pairs_result <- as.data.frame(pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey"))
      
      # Format results
      pairs_result$Hours <- hours
      pairs_result$Timepoint <- paste0(hours, "h")
      pairs_result$Estimate <- round(pairs_result$estimate, 3)
      pairs_result$SE <- round(pairs_result$SE, 3)
      pairs_result$p_value <- ifelse(pairs_result$p.value < 0.001, 
                                     "<0.001", 
                                     sprintf("%.3f", pairs_result$p.value))
      pairs_result$Significance <- case_when(
        pairs_result$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pairs_result$p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
        pairs_result$p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
      
      pairwise_table <- rbind(pairwise_table, pairs_result)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error at", hours, "hours:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  if (nrow(pairwise_table) > 0) {
    # Create clean output table
    output_table <- pairwise_table %>%
      dplyr::select(Timepoint, contrast, Estimate, SE, p_value, Significance) %>%
      arrange(Timepoint)
    
    print(output_table, row.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("No pairwise comparisons available.\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# TABLE 3: SIMPLIFIED SUMMARY - WHEN DO GROUPS SIGNIFICANTLY DIFFER?
# ============================================================================

significance_summary <- data.frame()

for (tp in timepoints) {
  smooth_model <- gam_models[[tp]]
  
  for (time_pt in c(0, 3, 6, 9, 12)) {
    hours <- time_pt * 12
    
    tryCatch({
      emm <- emmeans(smooth_model, 
                     specs = "GOS",
                     at = list(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = time_pt))
      
      pairs_result <- as.data.frame(pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey"))
      
      # Check which comparisons are significant
      sig_comparisons <- pairs_result %>%
        filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
        pull(contrast)
      
      if (length(sig_comparisons) > 0) {
        min_p <- min(pairs_result$p.value, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        significance_summary <- rbind(
          significance_summary,
          data.frame(
            GOS_Timepoint = paste0("GOS_", tp),
            Hours_Post_Injury = hours,
            Significant_Differences = paste(sig_comparisons, collapse = "; "),
            Min_p_value = ifelse(min_p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", min_p))
          )
        )
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      # Skip if error
    })
  }
}

significance_summary

# SAVE TABLES TO CSV
# ============================================================================

write.csv(summary_table_overall, 
          "table1_overall_trajectory_comparison.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: table1_overall_trajectory_comparison.csv\n")

      emm <- emmeans(smooth_model, 
                     specs = "GOS",

      pairs_result$GOS_Timepoint <- paste0("GOS_", tp)
      pairs_result$Hours_Post_Injury <- hours
      
      all_pairwise <- rbind(all_pairwise, pairs_result)

      # Skip if error
    })
  }
}

# Clean up and save

  all_pairwise_clean <- all_pairwise %>%
    dplyr::select(GOS_Timepoint, Hours_Post_Injury, contrast, 
           estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value) %>%
    arrange(GOS_Timepoint, Hours_Post_Injury)
  
  write.csv(all_pairwise_clean, 
            "table2_pairwise_comparisons_all_timepoints.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE)
```

### Segmented regression with turning point estimation

```{r segmented model, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}

library(segmented)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

# ==============================================================================
# PUBLICATION SETTINGS
# ==============================================================================

theme_publication <- function(base_size = 10, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 1, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size - 1, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5, unit = "pt")
    )
}

outcome_colors <- c(
  "Favorable" = "forestgreen",
  "Unfavorable" = "darkorange",
  "Dead" = "firebrick"
)

grouping_labels <- c(
  "GOS_03" = "3 Months",
  "GOS_06" = "6 Months",
  "GOS_12" = "12 Months",
  "GOS_24" = "24 Months"
)

# ==============================================================================
# DATA PREPARATION
# ==============================================================================

types <- c("serum", "csf")
grouping_outcomes <- c("GOS_03", "GOS_06", "GOS_12", "GOS_24")
outcomes <- c("Favorable", "Unfavorable", "Dead")

serum_cleaned <- tbi_serum_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID)

csf_cleaned <- tbi_csf_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_csf_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID)

all_grouping_plots <- list()
all_comparisons <- list()
all_model_diagnostics <- list()

# ==============================================================================
# IMPROVED BOOTSTRAP FUNCTION
# ==============================================================================

# OPTION 1: Standard bootstrap (if observations are independent)
bootstrap_breakpoint_standard <- function(data, n_boot = 1000, initial_psi = 3) {
  bp_list <- numeric(n_boot)
  success_count <- 0
  
  for (i in 1:n_boot) {
    dd_boot <- data %>% sample_frac(replace = TRUE)
    tryCatch({
      lm_fit <- lm(tau_log2 ~ time_numeric, data = dd_boot)
      seg_fit <- segmented(lm_fit, seg.Z = ~time_numeric, psi = list(time_numeric = initial_psi))
      bp_list[i] <- seg_fit$psi[2]
      success_count <- success_count + 1
    }, error = function(e) {
      bp_list[i] <- NA
    })
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("  Bootstrap success rate: %d/%d (%.1f%%)\n", 
              success_count, n_boot, 100*success_count/n_boot))
  return(na.omit(bp_list))
}

# OPTION 2: Cluster bootstrap (if you have repeated measures per subject)
bootstrap_breakpoint_clustered <- function(data, n_boot = 1000, initial_psi = 3) {
  bp_list <- numeric(n_boot)
  success_count <- 0
  subjects <- unique(data$Subject.ID)
  
  for (i in 1:n_boot) {
    # Resample subjects with replacement
    boot_subjects <- sample(subjects, size = length(subjects), replace = TRUE)
    dd_boot <- data %>% filter(Subject.ID %in% boot_subjects)
    
    tryCatch({
      lm_fit <- lm(tau_log2 ~ time_numeric, data = dd_boot)
      seg_fit <- segmented(lm_fit, seg.Z = ~time_numeric, psi = list(time_numeric = initial_psi))
      bp_list[i] <- seg_fit$psi[2]
      success_count <- success_count + 1
    }, error = function(e) {
      bp_list[i] <- NA
    })
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("  Bootstrap success rate: %d/%d (%.1f%%)\n", 
              success_count, n_boot, 100*success_count/n_boot))
  return(na.omit(bp_list))
}

# Choose which bootstrap method to use
# Set to TRUE if you have repeated measures per subject
USE_CLUSTER_BOOTSTRAP <- FALSE

# ==============================================================================
# MAIN ANALYSIS LOOP
# ==============================================================================

for (type in types) {
  
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("ANALYZING:", toupper(type), "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  grouping_plots <- list()
  comparison <- list()
  diagnostics <- list()
  
  for (grouping in grouping_outcomes) {
    
    cat("\nTime point:", grouping_labels[[grouping]], "\n")
    
    local({
      current_grouping <- grouping  
      
      outcome_plots <- list()
      results <- list()
      
      # ---- Individual Outcome Analysis ----
      for (outcome in outcomes) {
        
        cat(sprintf("  Processing %s group...\n", outcome))
        
        dd <- if (type == "serum") {
          serum_cleaned %>%
            filter(.data[[current_grouping]] == outcome) %>%
            mutate(
              time_numeric = as.numeric(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value),
              tau_log2 = mean_serum_log2_BDTau
            )
        } else {
          csf_cleaned %>%
            filter(.data[[current_grouping]] == outcome) %>%
            mutate(
              time_numeric = as.numeric(mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value),
              tau_log2 = mean_csf_log2_BDTau
            )
        }
        
        # Report data completeness
        n_total <- nrow(dd)
        dd <- dd %>% filter(!is.na(time_numeric), !is.na(tau_log2))
        n_complete <- nrow(dd)
        n_subjects <- length(unique(dd$Subject.ID))
        
        cat(sprintf("    N subjects = %d, N observations = %d (excluded %d with missing data)\n",
                    n_subjects, n_complete, n_total - n_complete))
        
        if (n_complete < 10) {
          warning(sprintf("Insufficient data for %s in %s", outcome, grouping))
          next
        }
        
        # Fit segmented regression
        lm_fit <- lm(tau_log2 ~ time_numeric, data = dd)
        seg_fit <- try(segmented(lm_fit, seg.Z = ~time_numeric, psi = list(time_numeric = 3)), silent = TRUE)
        
        if (inherits(seg_fit, "try-error")) {
          message(sprintf("    Segmented model failed for %s", outcome))
          next
        }
        
        # Extract results
        breakpoint <- seg_fit$psi[2]
        bp_ci <- confint(seg_fit)
        bp_ci_low <- bp_ci[,"CI(95%).low"]
        bp_ci_up <- bp_ci[,"CI(95%).up"]
        slopes <- slope(seg_fit)$time_numeric
        
        results[[outcome]] <- list(
          model = seg_fit,
          breakpoint = breakpoint,
          confint.low = bp_ci_low,
          confint.up = bp_ci_up,
          slope_before = slopes[1, "Est."],
          slope_after = slopes[2, "Est."],
          n_subjects = n_subjects,
          n_obs = n_complete
        )
        
        cat(sprintf("    Breakpoint: %.2f days (95%% CI: %.2f-%.2f)\n",
                    breakpoint, bp_ci_low, bp_ci_up))
        cat(sprintf("    Slope before: %.3f, Slope after: %.3f\n",
                    slopes[1, "Est."], slopes[2, "Est."]))
        
        # Predictions
        dd$pred <- predict(seg_fit)
        dd$residuals <- residuals(seg_fit)
        
        # Create plot
        outcome_plots[[outcome]] <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = time_numeric, y = tau_log2)) +
          geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = outcome_colors[[outcome]], size = 1.5, stroke = 0) +
          geom_line(aes(y = pred), linewidth = 1, color = outcome_colors[[outcome]]) +
          geom_vline(xintercept = breakpoint, linetype = "dashed", 
                     color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("rect", xmin = bp_ci_low, xmax = bp_ci_up,
                   ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.1, fill = "gray50") +
          labs(
            title = bquote(bold(.(outcome)) ~ 
                             "(N =" ~ .(n_subjects) * ", obs =" ~ .(n_complete) * ")"),
            x = "Time from Injury (days)", 
            y = bquote(log[2] * "(BD-Tau)")
          ) +
          annotate("text", x = breakpoint, y = max(dd$tau_log2, na.rm = TRUE),
                   label = sprintf("BP = %.1f d\n(95%% CI: %.1f–%.1f)", 
                                   breakpoint, bp_ci_low, bp_ci_up),
                   hjust = ifelse(breakpoint > mean(dd$time_numeric), 1.1, -0.1),
                   vjust = 1, size = 2.5, color = "black") +
          theme_publication() +
          scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(dd$time_numeric, na.rm = TRUE), by = 2))
      }
      
      # Combine plots
      if (all(outcomes %in% names(outcome_plots))) {
        combined_plot <- outcome_plots[["Favorable"]] + 
          outcome_plots[["Unfavorable"]] + 
          outcome_plots[["Dead"]] +
          plot_layout(ncol = 3) +
          plot_annotation(
            title = sprintf("Segmented Regression: %s BD-Tau (%s Outcome)", 
                            toupper(type), grouping_labels[[current_grouping]]),
            theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
          )
        
        grouping_plots[[current_grouping]] <<- combined_plot
        
        # Store diagnostics
        diagnostics[[current_grouping]] <<- results
      }
    })
    
    # ---- CORRECTED BOOTSTRAPPING SECTION ----
    set.seed(123)
    
    cat("\n  Running bootstrap analysis (1000 iterations)...\n")
    
    boot_results <- list()
    for (outcome in outcomes) {
      cat(sprintf("    Bootstrapping %s group:\n", outcome))
      
      dd <- if (type == "serum") {
        serum_cleaned %>%
          filter(.data[[grouping]] == outcome) %>%
          mutate(time_numeric = as.numeric(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value),
                 tau_log2 = mean_serum_log2_BDTau) %>%
          filter(!is.na(time_numeric), !is.na(tau_log2))
      } else {
        csf_cleaned %>%
          filter(.data[[grouping]] == outcome) %>%
          mutate(time_numeric = as.numeric(mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value),
                 tau_log2 = mean_csf_log2_BDTau) %>%
          filter(!is.na(time_numeric), !is.na(tau_log2))
      }
      
      if (nrow(dd) < 10) {
        warning(sprintf("Insufficient data for bootstrap: %s", outcome))
        next
      }
      
      # Choose bootstrap method
      if (USE_CLUSTER_BOOTSTRAP) {
        boot_results[[outcome]] <- bootstrap_breakpoint_clustered(dd, n_boot = 1000)
      } else {
        boot_results[[outcome]] <- bootstrap_breakpoint_standard(dd, n_boot = 1000)
      }
    }
    
    # ---- CORRECTED PAIRWISE COMPARISONS ----
    group_pairs <- combn(outcomes, 2, simplify = FALSE)
    comparison_results <- list()
    
    cat("\n  Pairwise comparisons:\n")
    
    for (pair in group_pairs) {
      g1 <- pair[1]
      g2 <- pair[2]
      
      if (is.null(boot_results[[g1]]) || is.null(boot_results[[g2]])) {
        warning(sprintf("Skipping comparison %s vs %s: missing bootstrap results", g1, g2))
        next
      }
      
      # Calculate differences
      diffs <- boot_results[[g1]] - boot_results[[g2]]
      diffs <- na.omit(diffs)
      
      # Bootstrap CI for difference
      ci <- quantile(diffs, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
      
      # CORRECTED P-VALUE: Two-sided test if CI includes zero
      # Proportion of bootstrap samples where difference crosses zero
      p_val <- 2 * min(mean(diffs > 0), mean(diffs < 0))
      
      # Alternative: permutation-based p-value (more conservative)
      # p_val_perm <- mean(abs(diffs) >= abs(median(diffs)))
      
      comparison_results[[paste(g1, "vs", g2)]] <- data.frame(
        Group1 = g1, 
        Group2 = g2,
        Median_Diff = ci[2], 
        CI_Low = ci[1], 
        CI_High = ci[3],
        P_Value = p_val,
        Significant = ifelse(ci[1] > 0 | ci[3] < 0, "Yes", "No")
      )
      
      cat(sprintf("    %s vs %s: Δ = %.2f (95%% CI: %.2f to %.2f), p = %.4f\n",
                  g1, g2, ci[2], ci[1], ci[3], p_val))
    }
    
    if (length(comparison_results) > 0) {
      comparison_df <- do.call(rbind, comparison_results)
      rownames(comparison_df) <- NULL
      
      # Add Bonferroni-corrected p-values
      comparison_df$P_Value_Bonferroni <- p.adjust(comparison_df$P_Value, method = "bonferroni")
      
      comparison[[grouping]] <- comparison_df %>% mutate(Outcome = grouping)
    }
  }
  
  all_grouping_plots[[type]] <- grouping_plots
  all_model_diagnostics[[type]] <- diagnostics
  
  if (length(comparison) > 0) {
    final_comparison <- do.call(rbind, comparison) %>%
      dplyr::select(Outcome, everything())
    rownames(final_comparison) <- NULL
    all_comparisons[[type]] <- final_comparison
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# CREATE FINAL FIGURES
# ==============================================================================

final_plot_serum <- all_grouping_plots[["serum"]][["GOS_03"]] /
  all_grouping_plots[["serum"]][["GOS_06"]] /
  all_grouping_plots[["serum"]][["GOS_12"]] /
  all_grouping_plots[["serum"]][["GOS_24"]] +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Longitudinal BD-Tau Dynamics in Serum by Glasgow Outcome Scale",
    tag_levels = 'A',
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
    )
  )

final_plot_csf <- all_grouping_plots[["csf"]][["GOS_03"]] /
  all_grouping_plots[["csf"]][["GOS_06"]] /
  all_grouping_plots[["csf"]][["GOS_12"]] /
  all_grouping_plots[["csf"]][["GOS_24"]] +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Longitudinal BD-Tau Dynamics in CSF by Glasgow Outcome Scale",
    tag_levels = 'A',
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================================
# SAVE OUTPUTS
# ==============================================================================

ggsave(paste0(figures_path, "Figure_Serum_SegmentedRegression.pdf"), 
       plot = final_plot_serum, width = 11.69, height = 8.27, 
       device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")

ggsave(paste0(figures_path, "Figure_CSF_SegmentedRegression.pdf"), 
       plot = final_plot_serum, width = 11.69, height = 8.27, 
       device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")


# Save comparison tables with corrected p-values
write.csv(all_comparisons[["serum"]], paste0(results_path, "Table_Serum_Breakpoint_Comparisons.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(all_comparisons[["csf"]], paste0(results_path, "Table_CSF_Breakpoint_Comparisons.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r SCI [Serum] demographic table by GOS outcome, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
  tab_spanner = c("**Overall**","**Injury Location**", "**ASIA**", "**In-hospital Mortality**", "**6-month Mortality**"))
```

```{r SCI ASIA Boxplot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27}
    locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "P-values")
```

```{r SCI ASIA2 Baseline BD-Tau Analysis, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=11.69/2, fig.height=8.27/3}

library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(writexl)
library(cowplot)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

analyses <- c("Serum_Only","CSF_Only", "Matched_Serum", "Matched_CSF")

# Color palette (standardized - keeping original colors)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "A" = "#bc340b",
  "B" = "#c3b658", 
  "C/D" = "#1c4811"
)

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop: All Three Analyses
# ============================================

plots <- list() 
stats_results <- list()
summary_list <- list()
dunn_results_list <- list()

for (analysis in analyses) {
  
  # Select appropriate data and columns
  if (analysis == "Serum_Only") {
    data <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
    y_col_raw <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
    y_label <- "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    plot_title <- "Serum (Full Cohort)"
  } else if (analysis == "CSF_only") {
    data <- sci_csf_demo_BL_cleaned
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
    y_col_raw <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
    y_label <- "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    plot_title <- "CSF (Full Cohort)"
  } else if (analysis == "Matched_Serum") {
    data <- sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
    y_col_raw <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
    y_label <- "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    plot_title <- "Serum (Matched)"
  } else {  # Matched_CSF
    data <- sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
    y_col_raw <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
    y_label <- "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    plot_title <- "CSF (Matched)"
  }
  
  cat("\n=============================================\n")
  cat("Analysis:", analysis, "\n")
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
  
  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- data %>%
    mutate(ASIA2 = case_when(
      ASIA %in% c("A","B") ~ ASIA,
      ASIA %in% c("C","D") ~ "C/D",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ASIA2)) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(ASIA2, levels = c("A", "B", "C/D")),
      y_log2 = !!sym(y_col_log2),
      y_raw = !!sym(y_col_raw)
    )
  
  # -------------------- Statistical Tests --------------------
  
  # Kruskal-Wallis test on log2 values
  kruskal_result <- kruskal.test(y_log2 ~ group, data = plot_data)
  
  # Dunn's post-hoc test with FDR adjustment
  dunn_results <- plot_data %>%
    dunn_test(y_log2 ~ group, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    mutate(Analysis = analysis)
  
  dunn_results_list[[analysis]] <- dunn_results
  
  # Store statistics
  stats_results[[analysis]] <- data.frame(
    Analysis = analysis,
    N_A = sum(plot_data$group == "A"),
    N_B = sum(plot_data$group == "B"),
    N_CD = sum(plot_data$group == "C/D"),
    Kruskal_statistic = kruskal_result$statistic,
    Kruskal_p = kruskal_result$p.value,
    Dunn_AvsB_p_raw = dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "A" & dunn_results$group2 == "B"],
    Dunn_AvsB_p_adj = dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "A" & dunn_results$group2 == "B"],
    Dunn_AvsCD_p_raw = dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "A" & dunn_results$group2 == "C/D"],
    Dunn_AvsCD_p_adj = dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "A" & dunn_results$group2 == "C/D"],
    Dunn_BvsCD_p_raw = dunn_results$p[dunn_results$group1 == "B" & dunn_results$group2 == "C/D"],
    Dunn_BvsCD_p_adj = dunn_results$p.adj[dunn_results$group1 == "B" & dunn_results$group2 == "C/D"]
  )
  
  cat("Kruskal-Wallis p =", format.pval(kruskal_result$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
  cat("Dunn's test results:\n")
  print(dunn_results %>% dplyr::select(group1, group2, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif))
  cat("\n")
  
  # -------------------- Summary Statistics --------------------
  
  summary_list[[analysis]] <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Mean = mean(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q25 = quantile(y_raw, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q75 = quantile(y_raw, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      Min = min(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Max = max(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Analysis = analysis)
  
  # -------------------- Create Plot --------------------
  
  # Filter out non-significant comparisons for plotting
  dunn_plot <- dunn_results %>%
    filter(p.adj.signif != "ns") %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "group")
  
  # Adjust y positions based on data range
  if (nrow(dunn_plot) > 0) {
    y_max <- max(plot_data$y_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_range <- max(plot_data$y_raw, na.rm = TRUE) - min(plot_data$y_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
    dunn_plot <- dunn_plot %>%
      mutate(y.position = y_max + y_range * c(0.15, 0.25, 0.35)[1:n()])
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = group, y = y_raw, fill = group, color = group)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "ASIA") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "ASIA") +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  # Add significance brackets only if there are significant comparisons
  if (nrow(dunn_plot) > 0) {
    p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(
      dunn_plot,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.02,
      bracket.size = 0.5,
      size = 4
    )
  }
  
  plots[[analysis]] <- p
  
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
}

# ============================================
# Save Results to Excel
# ============================================

# Combine statistics
stats_table <- bind_rows(stats_results)

# Combine summary statistics
summary_table <- bind_rows(summary_list)

# Combine Dunn's test results
dunn_table <- bind_rows(dunn_results_list)

# Create formatted tables
summary_formatted <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_SD = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", Mean, SD),
    Median_IQR = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", Median, Q25, Q75)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Analysis, group, N, Mean_SD, Median_IQR, Min, Max)

# Save to Excel
write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Summary_Statistics" = summary_table,
    "Summary_Formatted" = summary_formatted,
    "Kruskal_Wallis" = stats_table %>%
      dplyr::select(Analysis, N_A, N_B, N_CD, Kruskal_statistic, Kruskal_p),
    "Dunn_Raw_Pvalues" = stats_table %>%
      dplyr::select(Analysis, ends_with("_raw")),
    "Dunn_FDR_Pvalues" = stats_table %>%
      dplyr::select(Analysis, ends_with("_adj")),
    "Dunn_Detailed" = dunn_table %>%
      dplyr::select(Analysis, group1, group2, n1, n2, statistic, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif)
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "SCI_ASIA2_baseline_BDTau_analysis.xlsx")
)

# ============================================
# Create Publication Figure
# ============================================

# Prepare individual plots
plot_list <- list()
for (analysis in analyses) {
  plot_list[[analysis]] <- plots[[analysis]] +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)

}

# Extract legend

    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +

      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),

    )
)

# Combine plots (3 columns for 3 analyses)
combined_plot <- plot_grid(

  plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 3, # labels = "AUTO", 
            label_size = 11, label_fontface = "bold"),

)

# Save figure
ggsave(paste0(figures_path, "SCI_ASIA2_baseline_BDTau.pdf"),
```
