```{r SCI Injury Location Baseline BD-Tau Analysis, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=11.69/2, fig.height=8.27/3}

library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(writexl)
library(cowplot)

# ============================================
# Configuration
# ============================================

analyses <- c("Serum_Only", "CSF_Only", "Matched_Serum", "Matched_CSF")

# Color palette (standardized - keeping original colors)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Cervical"  = "#d9b38c",
  "Thoractic" = "#afc3d8",
  "Lumbar"    = "#1e242c"
)

# ============================================
# Analysis Loop: All Four Analyses (NO .data / NO !!sym)
# ============================================

plots <- list()
stats_results <- list()
summary_list <- list()
dunn_results_list <- list()

for (analysis in analyses) {
  
  # Select appropriate data and columns
  if (analysis == "Serum_Only") {
    df <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
    y_col_raw  <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
    y_label <- "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    plot_title <- "Serum (Full Cohort)"
    
  } else if (analysis == "CSF_Only") {
    df <- sci_csf_demo_BL_cleaned
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
    y_col_raw  <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
    y_label <- "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    plot_title <- "CSF (Full Cohort)"
    
  } else if (analysis == "Matched_Serum") {
    df <- sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
    y_col_raw  <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
    y_label <- "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    plot_title <- "Serum (Matched)"
    
  } else {  # Matched_CSF
    df <- sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned
    y_col_log2 <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
    y_col_raw  <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
    y_label <- "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    plot_title <- "CSF (Matched)"
  }
  
  # Fail fast if columns are missing
  needed <- c("Location_Group", y_col_log2, y_col_raw)
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(df))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop("Missing columns in ", analysis, ": ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # --------------------
  # Prepare data (base indexing to avoid masking errors)
  # --------------------
  plot_data <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Location_Group)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      group = factor(Location_Group, levels = c("Cervical", "Thoractic", "Lumbar"))
    )
  
  # Add dynamic columns safely (no recycling / no .data)
  plot_data$y_log2 <- plot_data[[y_col_log2]]
  plot_data$y_raw  <- plot_data[[y_col_raw]]
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(y_log2), !is.na(y_raw))
  
  # -------------------- Statistical Tests --------------------
  kruskal_result <- kruskal.test(y_log2 ~ group, data = plot_data)
  
  dunn_results <- plot_data %>%
    rstatix::dunn_test(y_log2 ~ group, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>%
    rstatix::add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Analysis = analysis)
  
  dunn_results_list[[analysis]] <- dunn_results
  
  get_pair <- function(tab, a, b, col) {
    v <- tab[[col]][(tab$group1 == a & tab$group2 == b) | (tab$group1 == b & tab$group2 == a)]
    if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else v[1]
  }
  
  stats_results[[analysis]] <- data.frame(
    Analysis = analysis,
    N_Cervical  = sum(plot_data$group == "Cervical"),
    N_Thoractic = sum(plot_data$group == "Thoractic"),
    N_Lumbar    = sum(plot_data$group == "Lumbar"),
    Kruskal_statistic = unname(kruskal_result$statistic),
    Kruskal_p = kruskal_result$p.value,
    Dunn_CervVsLumb_p_raw  = get_pair(dunn_results, "Cervical",  "Lumbar",    "p"),
    Dunn_CervVsLumb_p_adj  = get_pair(dunn_results, "Cervical",  "Lumbar",    "p.adj"),
    Dunn_CervVsThora_p_raw = get_pair(dunn_results, "Cervical",  "Thoractic", "p"),
    Dunn_CervVsThora_p_adj = get_pair(dunn_results, "Cervical",  "Thoractic", "p.adj"),
    Dunn_LumbVsThora_p_raw = get_pair(dunn_results, "Lumbar",    "Thoractic", "p"),
    Dunn_LumbVsThora_p_adj = get_pair(dunn_results, "Lumbar",    "Thoractic", "p.adj")
  )
  
  # -------------------- Summary Statistics (RAW) --------------------
  summary_list[[analysis]] <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      N = dplyr::n(),
      Mean = mean(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q25 = quantile(y_raw, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q75 = quantile(y_raw, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      Min = min(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      Max = max(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Analysis = analysis)
  
  # -------------------- Plot --------------------
  dunn_plot <- dunn_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(p.adj.signif), p.adj.signif != "ns") %>%
    rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "group")
  
  if (nrow(dunn_plot) > 0) {
    y_max <- max(plot_data$y_log2, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_rng <- diff(range(plot_data$y_log2, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (y_rng == 0) y_rng <- 1
    dunn_plot$y.position <- y_max + y_rng * seq(0.15, 0.35, length.out = nrow(dunn_plot))
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = group, y = y_log2, fill = group, color = group)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = 3, outlier.color = "red",
                 alpha = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "Injury Location") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "Injury Location") +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  if (nrow(dunn_plot) > 0) {
    p <- p + ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      dunn_plot,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.02,
      bracket.size = 0.5,
      size = 4
    )
  }
  
  plots[[analysis]] <- p
}

# ============================================
# Save Results to Excel
# ============================================

stats_table   <- bind_rows(stats_results)
summary_table <- bind_rows(summary_list)
dunn_table    <- bind_rows(dunn_results_list)

summary_formatted <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_SD = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", Mean, SD),
    Median_IQR = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", Median, Q25, Q75)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Analysis, group, N, Mean_SD, Median_IQR, Min, Max)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Summary_Statistics" = summary_table,
    "Summary_Formatted"  = summary_formatted,
    "Kruskal_Wallis"     = stats_table %>%
      dplyr::select(Analysis, N_Cervical, N_Thoractic, N_Lumbar, Kruskal_statistic, Kruskal_p),
    "Dunn_Raw_Pvalues"   = stats_table %>%
      dplyr::select(Analysis, ends_with("_raw")),
    "Dunn_FDR_Pvalues"   = stats_table %>%
      dplyr::select(Analysis, ends_with("_adj")),
    "Dunn_Detailed"      = dunn_table %>%
      dplyr::select(Analysis, group1, group2, n1, n2, statistic, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif)
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "SCI_Injury_Location_baseline_BDTau_analysis.xlsx")
)

# ============================================
# Create Publication Figure (2x2)
# ============================================

plot_list <- lapply(analyses, function(a) {
  plots[[a]] + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))
})
names(plot_list) <- analyses

# Legend (make a temp plot with legend ON)
p_leg <- ggplot(
  (if ("Serum_Only" %in% names(plots)) sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned else sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Location_Group)) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(Location_Group, levels = c("Cervical", "Thoractic", "Lumbar"))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group)),
  aes(x = group, y = 1, fill = group)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

legend <- get_legend(
  p_leg +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme(
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )
)

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  legend,
  plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 2, labels = "AUTO",
            label_size = 11, label_fontface = "bold"),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.10, 1)
)

ggsave(
  paste0(figures_path, "SCI_Injury_Location_baseline_BDTau.pdf"),
  combined_plot,
  width = 11.69/2,
  height = 8.27/2,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600
)

print(combined_plot)

# Individual exports (optional)
pdf("~/Desktop/Projects/manuscript writing/TBI BD-tau/figure/Extended Data Figure [Serum BD-tau by Location Box].pdf",
    height = 11.69/4, width = 8.27/4)
print(plots[["Serum_Only"]] + ggtitle(NULL))
dev.off()

    height = 11.69/4, width = 8.27/4)
```

```{r SCI [Serum/CSF] Baseline Correlation, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=11.69, fig.height=8.27}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(gt)

### TBI By GOS Outcome - Correlation on log2, display on both raw and log2 scales

# Define colors for GOS outcomes
asia2_colors <- c("A" = "#1c4811", 
                "B" = "#c3b658", 
                "C/D" = "#bc340b")

# ============================================
# RAW SCALE PLOTS
# ============================================

df_clean <- sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned %>%
  mutate(ASIA2 = case_when(ASIA %in% c("A","B") ~ ASIA,
                           ASIA %in% c("C","D") ~ "C/D",
                           TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ASIA2))

# Plot on RAW scale
asia_raw <- ggplot(df_clean, 
                   aes(x = mean_csf_BDTau,
                       y = mean_serum_BDTau)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", 
              fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = ASIA2), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = asia2_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)",
    y = "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)",
    title = NULL,
    color = "ASIA Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# ============================================
# LOG2 SCALE PLOTS
# ============================================

asia_log2 <- ggplot(df_clean, 
                   aes(x = mean_csf_log2_BDTau,
                       y = mean_serum_log2_BDTau)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", 
              fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = ASIA2), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = asia2_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "CSF log2(BD-Tau)",
    y = "Serum log2(BD-Tau)",
    title = NULL,
    color = "ASIA Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Combine log2 scale plots
combined_sci_cor <- (asia_raw | asia_log2)  +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Serum vs CSF BD-Tau Correlation",
    theme = theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

cairo_pdf(paste0(figures_path, "SCI_Serum_CSF_correlation.pdf"), 
          width = 11.69/2, height = 8.27/2, family = "sans")
print(combined_sci_cor)
dev.off()

# ============================================
# Create Summary Table of Correlations
# ============================================

# Overall correlation (on LOG2 scale)
overall_cor <- cor.test(df_clean$mean_serum_log2_BDTau, 
                        df_clean$mean_csf_log2_BDTau, 
                        method = "spearman")

overall_row <- data.frame(
  ASIA2 = "Overall",
  N = nrow(df_clean),
  Spearman_rho = overall_cor$estimate,
  P_value = overall_cor$p.value
)

# Calculate correlations by group (on LOG2 scale)
cor_by_group <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(ASIA2) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Spearman_rho = cor(mean_serum_log2_BDTau, mean_csf_log2_BDTau, 
                       method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    P_value = cor.test(mean_serum_log2_BDTau, mean_csf_log2_BDTau, 
                       method = "spearman")$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

cor_summary_sci <- bind_rows(overall_row, cor_by_group)

# Create GT table
cor_table <- cor_summary_sci %>%
  mutate(
    Spearman_rho = round(Spearman_rho, 3),
    P_value = format.pval(P_value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
    ASIA2 = factor(ASIA2, 
                         levels = c("Overall", "A", "B", "C/D"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(ASIA2) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = ASIA2,
    values_from = c(N, Spearman_rho, P_value)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Spearman Correlation: Serum vs CSF BD-Tau by ASIA",
    subtitle = "Correlations calculated on log2-transformed values"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    N_Overall = "N",
    Spearman_rho_Overall = "ρ",
    P_value_Overall = "p",
    N_A = "N",
    Spearman_rho_A = "ρ",
    P_value_A = "p",
    N_B = "N",
    Spearman_rho_B = "ρ",
    P_value_B = "p",
    `N_C/D` = "N",
    `Spearman_rho_C/D` = "ρ",
    `P_value_C/D` = "p"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Overall",
    columns = c(N_Overall, Spearman_rho_Overall, P_value_Overall)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "A",
    columns = c(N_A, Spearman_rho_A, P_value_A)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "B",
    columns = c(N_B, Spearman_rho_B, P_value_B)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "C/D",
    columns = c(`N_C/D`, `Spearman_rho_C/D`, `P_value_C/D`)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "lightgrey"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = c(N_Overall, Spearman_rho_Overall, P_value_Overall))
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 11,
    heading.title.font.size = 14
  )

print(cor_table)

# Save table
gtsave(cor_table, 
       paste0(figures_path, "SCI_Serum_CSF_correlation_table.png"))

# Also save as CSV
write.xlsx(cor_summary_sci, 
           paste0(figures_path, "SCI_Serum_CSF_correlation_summary.xlsx"),
           row.names = FALSE)
```

### ASIA outcome spaghetti visualization

```{r SCI ASIA2 Complete Longitudinal Analysis, fig.align='default', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(data.table)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# STEP 1: Calculate day_idx and rate_vs_baseline for SCI Matched Cohort
# ============================================

cat("\n=== CALCULATING RATE VARIABLES FOR SCI MATCHED COHORT ===\n\n")

# Process Serum Variables
DT_serum <- as.data.table(sci_match_demo)
DT_serum[, rowid := .I]
DT_serum[, day_idx_serum := floor(as.numeric(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value))]

# Calculate rate by baseline (first measurement per subject)
baseline_serum <- DT_serum[order(Subject.ID, mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value),
                           .(baseline_time = first(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value),
                             baseline_serum = first(mean_serum_BDTau)),
                           by = Subject.ID]
DT_serum <- baseline_serum[DT_serum, on = "Subject.ID"]

DT_serum[, mean_serum_rate_vs_baseline := 
           ifelse(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value == baseline_time,
                  0,  # At baseline, rate is 0
                  ifelse(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value > baseline_time,
                         (mean_serum_BDTau - baseline_serum) / 
                           (mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value - baseline_time),
                         NA_real_))]

# Process CSF Variables
DT_csf <- as.data.table(sci_match_demo)
DT_csf[, rowid := .I]
DT_csf[, day_idx_csf := floor(as.numeric(mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value))]

baseline_csf <- DT_csf[order(Subject.ID, mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value),
                       .(baseline_time = first(mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value),
                         baseline_csf = first(mean_csf_BDTau)),
                       by = Subject.ID]
DT_csf <- baseline_csf[DT_csf, on = "Subject.ID"]

DT_csf[, mean_csf_rate_vs_baseline := 
         ifelse(mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value == baseline_time,
                0,  # At baseline, rate is 0
                ifelse(mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value > baseline_time,
                       (mean_csf_BDTau - baseline_csf) / 
                         (mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value - baseline_time),
                       NA_real_))]

# Create unified day_idx and add rate variables to original data
sci_match_demo <- sci_match_demo %>%
  mutate(
    day_idx_serum = floor(as.numeric(mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value)),
    day_idx_csf = floor(as.numeric(mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value)),
    day_idx = ifelse(!is.na(day_idx_serum), day_idx_serum, day_idx_csf)
  )

# Add serum rates using direct indexing
sci_match_demo$mean_serum_rate_vs_baseline <- DT_serum$mean_serum_rate_vs_baseline

# Add CSF rates using direct indexing  
sci_match_demo$mean_csf_rate_vs_baseline <- DT_csf$mean_csf_rate_vs_baseline

cat("Rate variables calculated successfully!\n\n")

# ============================================
# STEP 2: Configuration
# ============================================

outcome_colors <- c(
  "A" = "#bc340b", 
  "B" = "#c3b658", 
  "C/D" = "#1c4811"
)

outcome_linetypes <- c(
  "A" = "solid",
  "B" = "dashed",
  "C/D" = "dotdash"
)

all_plots <- list()
all_test_results <- list()
all_timepoint_pvals <- list()

# ============================================
# STEP 3: Analysis Loop - 3 Analyses (Absolute Values Only)
# ============================================

analyses <- c("Serum_Full", "Matched_Serum", "Matched_CSF")

for (analysis in analyses) {
  
  cat("\n=============================================\n")
  cat("Analysis:", analysis, "\n")
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
  
  # Configure data source and variables
  if (analysis == "Serum_Full") {
    dd <- sci_serum_demo %>%
      mutate(ASIA2 = case_when(ASIA %in% c("A","B") ~ ASIA,
                               ASIA %in% c("C","D") ~ "C/D",
                               TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
      filter(Subject.ID %in% sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
      filter(serum_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12)
    
    time_col <- "serum_First_Digit_12Hr"
    y_col <- "serum_BDTau"
    log_y_col <- "serum_log2_BDTau"
    y_label <- "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    plot_title <- "Serum (Full Cohort)"
    
  } else if (analysis == "Matched_Serum") {
    dd <- sci_match_demo %>%
      mutate(ASIA2 = case_when(ASIA %in% c("A","B") ~ ASIA,
                               ASIA %in% c("C","D") ~ "C/D",
                               TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
      filter(Subject.ID %in% sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
      mutate(
        mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value = 2*mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value,
        mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(mean_serum_Raw_12Hr_Value)
      ) %>%
      filter(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12)
    
    time_col <- "mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr"
    y_col <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
    log_y_col <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
    y_label <- "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    plot_title <- "Serum (Matched)"
    
  } else if (analysis == "Matched_CSF") {
    dd <- sci_match_demo %>%
      mutate(ASIA2 = case_when(ASIA %in% c("A","B") ~ ASIA,
                               ASIA %in% c("C","D") ~ "C/D",
                               TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
      filter(Subject.ID %in% sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
      mutate(
        mean_csf_Raw_12Hr_Value = 2*mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value,
        mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(mean_csf_Raw_12Hr_Value)
      ) %>%
      filter(mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr <= 12)
    
    time_col <- "mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr"
    y_col <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
    log_y_col <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
    y_label <- "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    plot_title <- "CSF (Matched)"
  }
  
  # Prepare plot data
  plot_data <- dd %>%
    filter(!is.na(ASIA2)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(time_col)), !is.na(!!sym(y_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(ASIA2, levels = c("A", "B", "C/D")),
      time = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))),
      time_hours = as.numeric(as.character(!!sym(time_col))) * 12,
      subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
    )
  
  # Mixed effects model
  if (nrow(plot_data) >= 10 && n_distinct(plot_data$group) >= 2) {
    test_var <- log_y_col
    formula <- paste0(test_var, " ~ group * time + (1 | subject)")
    lmm <- lmer(as.formula(formula), data = plot_data)
    anova_result <- anova(lmm)
    interaction_p <- anova_result["group:time", "Pr(>F)"]
  } else {
    interaction_p <- NA
  }
  
  cat("Mixed effects model interaction p =", format.pval(interaction_p, digits = 3), "\n\n")
  
  # Per-timepoint testing on log2 scale
  tp_pvals <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(time_hours) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      if (n_distinct(.x$group) >= 2 && nrow(.x) >= 4) {
        model <- try(lm(as.formula(paste0(log_y_col, " ~ group")), data = .x), silent = TRUE)
        if (!inherits(model, "try-error")) {
          anova_res <- anova(model)
          return(tibble(p = anova_res[["Pr(>F)"]][1]))
        }
      }
      tibble(p = NA_real_)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
      sig_adj = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  print(tp_pvals %>% dplyr::select(time_hours, p, p_adj, sig_adj))
  
  # Store results
  all_test_results[[analysis]] <- list(
    analysis = analysis,
    interaction_p = interaction_p,
    n_a = sum(plot_data$group == "A", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_b = sum(plot_data$group == "B", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_cd = sum(plot_data$group == "C/D", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  all_timepoint_pvals[[analysis]] <- tp_pvals %>%
    mutate(Analysis = analysis)
  
  # Visualization
  summary_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_val = sd(!!sym(y_col), na.rm = TRUE),
      se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # IMPORTANT: Use SE for error bars consistently
  summary_df <- summary_df %>%
    mutate(error_val = se_val)
  
  sig_markers <- tp_pvals %>% filter(sig_adj != "")
  
  p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - error_val, ymax = mean_val + error_val), width = 2, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes, guide = "none") +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Hours Post-Injury", y = y_label) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  if (nrow(sig_markers) > 0) {
    y_pos <- max(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$error_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = sig_markers,
      aes(x = time_hours, y = y_pos, label = sig_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
    )
  }
  
  all_plots[[analysis]] <- p
  
  cat("=============================================\n\n")
}

# ============================================
# STEP 4: Save Results to Excel
# ============================================

interaction_summary <- map_dfr(names(all_test_results), function(key) {
  res <- all_test_results[[key]]
  tibble(
    Analysis = res$analysis,
    N_A = res$n_a,
    N_B = res$n_b,
    N_CD = res$n_cd,
    Interaction_p = res$interaction_p
  )
})

timepoint_pvals_combined <- bind_rows(all_timepoint_pvals)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Interaction_Tests" = interaction_summary,
    "Timepoint_Pvalues" = timepoint_pvals_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Analysis, time_hours, p, p_adj, sig_adj)
  ),
  path = paste0(results_path, "SCI_ASIA2_longitudinal_complete_analysis.xlsx")
)

cat("\n=== Excel file saved ===\n")

# ============================================
# STEP 5: Create Single Publication Figure (3 panels)
# ============================================

plot_list <- list()
for (analysis in c("Serum_Full", "Matched_CSF", "Matched_Serum")) {
  plot_list[[analysis]] <- all_plots[[analysis]] +
    theme(legend.position = "none") + ggtitle(NULL)
}

legend <- get_legend(
  all_plots[["Serum_Full"]] +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
    )
)

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  legend,
  plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 2, # labels = "AUTO",
            label_size = 12, label_fontface = "bold"),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.08, 1)
)

ggsave(paste0(figures_path, "SCI_ASIA2_longitudinal.pdf"),
       combined_plot,
       width = 11.69, height = 8.27/2,
       units = "in", dpi = 600)

print(combined_plot)

cairo_pdf("~/Desktop/Projects/manuscript writing/TBI BD-tau/figure/Extended Data Figure [Matched Serum-CSF by ASIA Longitudinal].pdf",
          width = 8.27, height = 2*11.69/3, family = "Arial")
print(combined_plot)
dev.off()
```

```{r SCI Location_Group Complete Longitudinal Analysis, fig.align='default', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(data.table)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)
library(grid)

# Keep names consistent with the factor labels in plot_data$location_group
location_colors <- c(
  "Cervical"  = "#d9b38c",
  "Lumbar"    = "#1e242c",
  "Thoractic" = "#afc3d8"
)

location_linetypes <- c(
  "Cervical"  = "solid",
  "Lumbar"    = "dashed",
  "Thoractic" = "dotdash"
)

all_plots <- list()
all_test_results <- list()
all_timepoint_pvals <- list()
summary_plot <- list()
summary_stats <- list()

analyses <- c("Serum_Full", "Matched_Serum", "Matched_CSF")

for (analysis in analyses) {

  cat("\n=============================================\n")
  cat("Analysis:", analysis, "\n")
  cat("=============================================\n\n")

  # -------------------------------
  # Configure data source
  # -------------------------------
  if (analysis == "Serum_Full") {

    dd <- sci_serum_demo %>%
      filter(
        Subject.ID %in% sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID,
        !is.na(serum_First_Digit_12Hr)
      ) %>%
      group_by(Subject.ID) %>%
      mutate(time_since_baseline =
               serum_First_Digit_12Hr -
               min(serum_First_Digit_12Hr, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(time_since_baseline <= 12)

    time_col   <- "time_since_baseline"
    y_col      <- "serum_BDTau"
    log_y_col  <- "serum_log2_BDTau"
    plot_title <- "Serum (Full Cohort)"
    y_label    <- "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    x_label    <- "Hours Post-Baseline"

  } else if (analysis == "Matched_Serum") {

    dd <- sci_match_demo %>%
      filter(Subject.ID %in% sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
      mutate(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(2 * mean_serum_Raw_Day_Value)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr)) %>%
      group_by(Subject.ID) %>%
      mutate(time_since_baseline =
               mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr -
               min(mean_serum_First_Digit_12Hr, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(time_since_baseline <= 12)

    time_col   <- "time_since_baseline"
    y_col      <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
    log_y_col  <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"
    plot_title <- "Serum (Matched)"
    y_label    <- "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    x_label    <- "Hours Post-Baseline"

  } else {

    dd <- sci_match_demo %>%
      filter(Subject.ID %in% sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
      mutate(mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr = trunc(2 * mean_csf_Raw_Day_Value)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr)) %>%
      group_by(Subject.ID) %>%
      mutate(time_since_baseline =
               mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr -
               min(mean_csf_First_Digit_12Hr, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(time_since_baseline <= 12)

    time_col   <- "time_since_baseline"
    y_col      <- "mean_csf_BDTau"
    log_y_col  <- "mean_csf_log2_BDTau"
    plot_title <- "CSF (Matched)"
    y_label    <- "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)"
    x_label    <- "Hours Post-Baseline"
  }

  # Optional: require that each subject actually has baseline (time_since_baseline == 0)
  dd <- dd %>%
    group_by(Subject.ID) %>%
    filter(any(.data[[time_col]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # -------------------------------
  # Prepare data
  # -------------------------------
  plot_data <- dd %>%
    filter(!is.na(Location_Group)) %>%
    transmute(
      Subject.ID,
      location_group = factor(
        Location_Group,
        levels = c("Cervical", "Lumbar", "Thoractic")
      ),
      time       = as.numeric(.data[[time_col]]),
      time_hours = as.numeric(.data[[time_col]]) * 12,
      y_raw      = .data[[y_col]],
      y_log2     = .data[[log_y_col]],
      subject    = factor(Subject.ID)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(location_group), !is.na(time), !is.na(y_raw), !is.na(y_log2))

  plot_data_infer <- plot_data %>%
  filter(location_group %in% c("Cervical", "Thoractic"))

  # -------------------------------
  # Mixed effects model (log2)
  # -------------------------------
  interaction_p <- NA_real_

  if (nrow(plot_data_infer) >= 10 &&
      dplyr::n_distinct(plot_data_infer$location_group) >= 2 &&
      dplyr::n_distinct(plot_data_infer$subject) >= 5) {

    lmm <- lmer(
      y_log2 ~ location_group * time + (1 | subject),
      data = plot_data_infer,
      REML = FALSE
    )

    aov_tab <- anova(lmm)
    if ("location_group:time" %in% rownames(aov_tab)) {
      interaction_p <- aov_tab["location_group:time", "Pr(>F)"]
    }
  }

  cat("Interaction p =", format.pval(interaction_p, digits = 3), "\n\n")

  # -------------------------------
  # Pairwise Wilcoxon per timepoint (log2)
  # BH within each pair across timepoints
  # -------------------------------
  tp_pairwise_raw <- plot_data_infer %>%
    group_by(time_hours) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      grp_counts <- table(.x$location_group)
      eligible <- names(grp_counts[grp_counts >= 2])

      if (length(eligible) < 2) return(tibble())

      dat <- .x %>% filter(location_group %in% eligible)
      pairs <- combn(sort(unique(dat$location_group)), 2, simplify = FALSE)

      bind_rows(lapply(pairs, function(pr) {
        x1 <- dat$y_log2[dat$location_group == pr[1]]
        x2 <- dat$y_log2[dat$location_group == pr[2]]

        tibble(
          time_hours = unique(dat$time_hours),
          group1 = as.character(pr[1]),
          group2 = as.character(pr[2]),
          n1 = length(x1),
          n2 = length(x2),
          p_raw = wilcox.test(x1, x2, exact = FALSE)$p.value
        )
      }))
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  tp_pairwise_adj <- tp_pairwise_raw %>%
    group_by(group1, group2) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
      sig_adj = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Analysis = analysis)

  all_timepoint_pvals[[analysis]] <- tp_pairwise_adj

  # -------------------------------
  # Summaries (RAW scale)
  # 1) plot summary (mean + SE)
  # 2) full descriptive stats (your requested columns)
  # -------------------------------
  summary_plot_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(time_hours, location_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(y_raw)),
      mean_val = mean(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_val = sd(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  summary_stats_df <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(time_hours, location_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n      = sum(!is.na(y_raw)),
      mean   = mean(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd     = sd(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25    = quantile(y_raw, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
      q75    = quantile(y_raw, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
      min    = min(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      max    = max(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(group = location_group) %>%
    arrange(time_hours, group)

  summary_plot[[analysis]] <- summary_plot_df %>% mutate(Analysis = analysis)
  summary_stats[[analysis]] <- summary_stats_df %>% mutate(Analysis = analysis)

  # -------------------------------
  # Plot
  # -------------------------------
  p <- ggplot(summary_plot_df,
              aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val,
                  color = location_group,
                  linetype = location_group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val),
      width = 2, alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = location_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = location_linetypes, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = x_label, y = y_label) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, 24)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )

  # Optional significance markers (example: only non-"ns")
  sig_markers <- tp_pairwise_adj %>% filter(sig_adj != "ns")
  if (nrow(sig_markers) > 0) {
    y_star <- max(summary_plot_df$mean_val + summary_plot_df$se_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10

    sig_markers_one <- sig_markers %>%
      group_by(time_hours) %>%
      summarise(
        sig_adj = dplyr::first(sig_adj[order(p_adj)]),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = sig_markers_one,
      aes(x = time_hours, y = y_star, label = sig_adj),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 5, fontface = "bold"
    )
  }

  all_plots[[analysis]] <- p
  all_test_results[[analysis]] <- tibble(
    Analysis = analysis,
    Interaction_p = interaction_p
  )
}

# Combined results objects (create AFTER the loop)
summary_plot_results  <- bind_rows(summary_plot)
summary_stats_results <- bind_rows(summary_stats)
interaction_results   <- bind_rows(all_test_results)
pairwise_results      <- bind_rows(all_timepoint_pvals)

# Optional: write summaries to Excel
write_xlsx(list(
  summary_stats = summary_stats_results,
  interaction_results = interaction_results,
  pairwise_results = pairwise_results), path = paste0(results_path, "SCI_LocationGroup_Longitudinal_Summaries.xlsx"))

# Combined multi-panel plot
plot_list <- list()
for (analysis in c("Serum_Full", "Matched_CSF", "Matched_Serum")) {
  plot_list[[analysis]] <- all_plots[[analysis]] +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    ggtitle(NULL)
}

legend <- get_legend(
  all_plots[["Serum_Full"]] +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
    )
)

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  legend,
  plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 2, label_size = 12, label_fontface = "bold"),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.08, 1)
)

combined_plot

cairo_pdf("~/Desktop/Projects/manuscript writing/TBI BD-tau/figure/Extended Data Figure [Matched Serum-CSF by Injury Location Longitudinal].pdf",
          width = 8.27*1.5, height = 11.69/2, family = "Arial")
print(combined_plot)
dev.off()
```
